jobs.title: Egov Select - IT Security Architect
jobs.description:
De Federale Overheidsdienst Beleid en Ondersteuning (FOD BOSA) speelt binnen de federale administratie een sleutelrol in het uitbouwen van een moderne overheid ten dienste van burgers en ondernemingen.

Opgericht op 1 maart 2017 ondersteunt FOD BOSA de federale regering en overheidsorganisaties in diverse domeinen, waaronder IT, HR, organisatiebeheer, integriteitsbeleid, begroting, boekhouding en overheidsopdrachten.

FOD BOSA draagt actief bij aan een moderne, efficiënte en digitale administratie die burgers en bedrijven optimaal ondersteunt.

De Directie-generaal Vereenvoudiging en Digitalisering (DG Vd) heeft als opdracht de dienstverlening aan burgers en ondernemingen te digitaliseren en te vereenvoudigen, en digitale diensten te ontwikkelen voor de overheid.

Binnen DG Vd is het domein Infrastructure, Operations & Service Support (iOS) verantwoordelijk voor de infrastructuur, operationele ondersteuning en dienstverlening van diverse federale digitale platformen en toepassingen, waaronder eBox, FAS (Federal Authentication Service), Mygov.be, de Federal Service Bus (FSB) en andere kritieke digitale diensten.

Als medewerker maak je deel uit van het Security Team binnen iOS. Je werkt mee aan het beveiligen van essentiële digitale diensten die dagelijks door burgers, ondernemingen en overheidsinstellingen worden gebruikt. Je komt terecht in een uitdagende omgeving waar cybersecurity, innovatie, betrouwbaarheid en maatschappelijke impact centraal staan.

Taakomschrijving

Als IT Architect, zult u een waaier van taken hebben waaronder
  • Een veilige architectuur ontwerpen en voorstellen om de strategie van de organisatie te implementeren.
  • De cyberbeveiligingsarchitectuur van de organisatie ontwikkelen om te voldoen aan de beveiligings- en privacyvereisten.
  • Architectuurdocumentatie en specificaties opstellen.
  • Het ontwerp van de beveiligingsarchitectuur op hoog niveau presenteren aan belanghebbenden.
  • Een veilige omgeving tot stand brengen tijdens de ontwikkelingscyclus van systemen, diensten en producten.
  • De ontwikkeling, integratie en het onderhoud van cyberbeveiligingscomponenten coördineren en ervoor zorgen dat aan de cyberbeveiligingsspecificaties wordt voldaan.
  • De cyberbeveiliging van de architectuur van de organisatie analyseren en evalueren.
  • De beveiliging van oplossingsarchitecturen waarborgen door middel van beveiligingsbeoordelingen en certificering.
  • Samenwerken met andere teams, domeinen en collega's.
  • De impact van cyberbeveiligingsoplossingen op het ontwerp en de prestaties van de architectuur van de organisatie evalueren.
  • De architectuur van de organisatie aanpassen aan opkomende bedreigingen.
  • De geïmplementeerde architectuur beoordelen om een passend beveiligingsniveau te handhaven.
  • Fungeren als derdelijnsondersteuning door technische ondersteuning en begeleiding te bieden aan het SecOps-team.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een bachelor of een Master in IT of gelijkaardig door ervaring
  • Je vertoont tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een gelijkaardige positie
  • Je vertoont een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands en een goede kennis van het Frans. Kennis van het Engels is onmisbare voor deze functie

Technische vaardigheden:
Kennis van onderstaande technologieën, met minstens 3 jaar effectieve ervaring in een of meerdere van deze domeinen
  • Python scripting
  • Ansible Playbooks (Infrastructure as Code - IaC)
  • Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
  • OpenShift / Kubernetes
  • F5 BIG-IP (ASM)
  • ELK Suite (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
  • Entrust HSM (Hardware Security Modules)
  • Ossec
  • Wazuh
  • MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform)
  • HashiCorp Vault
  • Forensische analyse- en onderzoekstools:
  • WireShark
  • Velociraptor
  • Autopsy

jobs.title: Senior Finance & FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
Mission

Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there.

As our first dedicated Senior Finance & FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build.

 

Your Tasks

  • Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic.

  • Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds.

  • Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early.

  • IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials.

  • GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix.

  • Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions.

  • Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable.

  • Operational Finance: Own accounts payable and receivable, and drive timely, accurate month-end and year-end closes together with our tax advisory team.

 

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, accounting/controlling, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure.

  • Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions.

  • Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions.

  • Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning, DATEV and AI tooling a strong plus.

  • Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English.

  • Mindset: Hands-on, structured, comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-role ownership in a scaling environment.

  • Agentic mindset: You default to AI and agentic tools to automate the repetitive and build leverage - you think in reusable processes and systems, not one-off spreadsheets, so finance scales faster than headcount.

  • Qualification: Degree in finance, business or a quantitative field; CFA, MBA or qualified-accountant background welcome.

What we're not looking for

  • People who wait to be told what to do.

  • "That's not my job" energy at the handoff between teams.

  • Anyone who treats compliance and documentation as red tape to skip rather than the thing that protects the client.

 

Process

We move fast. For the right candidate the whole process takes less than two weeks.

  1. Virtual call ​with our Talent Team

  2. Virtual Case Study based on a real challenge we're facing that you'd solve

  3. Invitation to our office to meet the team, product, and run through your case study

  4. Reference call

 

Our Offer

  • Direct line to the CFO and Co-Founder/CEO exposure

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Sachbezüge/Coupons to over 200 partners or a Deutschland Ticket

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern equipment setup for your needs to succeed

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8 p.m.

  • A team of 50+ (and growing) ambitious, diverse experts, 20%+ ex-founders, learning and building together

  • A category-defining growth story in a large, underserved market, with an AI-enabled operating model.

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

Jsme malotřídní škola v krásném prostředí Lužických hor. Zakládáme si na respektujících vztazích, individuálním přístupu a prostředí, kde se děti i dospělí cítí dobře. Hledáme člověka, který dokáže dětem nabídnout bezpečný prostor pro odpočinek, hru, pohyb i objevování.
Koho hledáme?
- člověka s laskavým a respektujícím přístupem k dětem,
- aktivního kolegu či kolegyni, který/á rád/a tráví čas venku a přichází s vlastními nápady,
- týmového hráče, který se chce podílet na životě školy,
- kvalifikaci pro výkon pozice vychovatele/ky vítáme, ale rádi se potkáme i se zájemci, kteří si vzdělání doplňují nebo mají zkušenosti s prací s dětmi.
Co bude Vaší náplní práce?
- vedení školní družiny,
- příprava a realizace zájmových, tvořivých a pohybových aktivit,
- podpora příjemného a bezpečného prostředí pro děti,
- spolupráce s pedagogy a rodiči,
- podíl na školních akcích a aktivitách.
Co nabízíme?
- pracovní úvazek 0,9–1,0,
- nástup od srpna 2026 nebo dle dohody,
- zařazení do platové třídy dle dosaženého vzdělání a započitatelné praxe,
- notebook k pracovnímu využití,
- podporu vedení školy a přátelský kolektiv,
- možnost dalšího vzdělávání,
- práci v malé škole, kde jsou důležité vztahy, důvěra a spolupráce,
- každodenní kontakt s přírodou a prostředí Lužických hor.
Pokud hledáte místo, kde můžete dětem zpříjemňovat odpoledne, rozvíjet jejich zájmy a být součástí školy, která staví na dobrých vztazích, rádi Vás poznáme.

Kontakt e-mailem nebo telefonicky v dopoledních hodinách.

o    Zájem o profesní růst v oblasti auditu

Co nabízíme?
o    Nástupní ohodnocení 40 000 - 50 000 Kč

o    Zázemí stabilní a zavedené společnosti
o    Odborný mentoring a profesní rozvoj

o    Flexibilní pracovní doba

jobs.description:
Kontakt: Svěrkošová Jana, tel.: 724 315 450, e-mail: jana.sverkosova@hotelis.cz

Hotelis Spa & Wellness Hotels hledá člověka, který dá našemu marketingu jasný směr, styl a výsledky.
Do našeho týmu hledáme zkušeného a kreativního Marketing Managera / Marketingovou manažerku, který/á bude zodpovědný/á za rozvoj značky Hotelis, marketingovou strategii a podporu prodeje našich hotelů.
Hledáme někoho, kdo umí spojit kreativitu s čísly, má přehled v online marketingu, chápe hotelové prostředí a dokáže proměnit nápady v reálné kampaně, které přivádějí hosty.

Co vás u nás čeká
Budete mít na starosti marketingovou komunikaci značky Hotelis a našich hotelů. Vaší rolí bude především:
• tvořit a realizovat marketingovou strategii v souladu s obchodními cíli společnosti,
• podílet se na budování značky, image hotelů a firemní identity,
• připravovat a koordinovat marketingové kampaně, promoakce, balíčky a speciální nabídky,
• spravovat a rozvíjet online komunikaci, webové stránky a sociální sítě,
• spolupracovat s obchodním a revenue týmem na podpoře prodeje,
• koordinovat grafické a propagační materiály,
• sledovat konkurenci, trh a zákaznické segmenty,
• vyhodnocovat efektivitu kampaní a připravovat reporting pro vedení společnosti,
• přicházet s návrhy, jak marketing dále zlepšovat a posouvat.

Koho hledáme
Hledáme člověka, který má:
• zkušenosti s marketingem, ideálně v hotelnictví, cestovním ruchu, wellness nebo službách,
• přehled v online marketingu a správě sociálních sítí,
• schopnost připravit marketingovou kampaň od nápadu po realizaci,
• cit pro značku, vizuální styl a kvalitní obsah,
• analytické myšlení a schopnost vyhodnocovat výsledky,
• dobré organizační a komunikační schopnosti,
• samostatnost, spolehlivost a proaktivní přístup,
• chuť přinášet nové nápady a dotahovat věci do konce.

Co je pro nás důležité
Nechceme jen správce sociálních sítí. Hledáme partnera pro marketing, který bude rozumět tomu, že dobrý marketing musí být nejen hezký, ale hlavně funkční.
Očekáváme profesionální přístup, odpovědnost, férovou komunikaci a schopnost spolupracovat s obchodem, revenue, provozem i vedením společnosti.

Co nabízíme
• mzda 60.000 Kč/měsíčně,
• zajímavou a samostatnou marketingovou pozici v hotelové skupině,
• prostor pro kreativitu a vlastní nápady,

• práci v prostředí lázeňství, wellness a hotelových služeb,
• možnost reálně ovlivnit podobu marketingu a komunikace značky.

jobs.title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

jobs.title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!

Develop yourself!

jobs.title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
jobs.description:
Your mission

IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte.
Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität.

  • Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife.
  • Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden.
  • Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab.
  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch.
  • Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten.
  • Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk.


Your profile

  • Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität.
  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung der Umsetzung komplexer Infrastruktur-, Bau-, Energie-, Mobilitäts-, Telekommunikations- oder vergleichbarer Rollout-Programme über mehrere Standorte hinweg, ideralerweise im Bereich HPC Ladeinfrastruktur.
  • Du kannst eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Übernahme von Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Umsetzungslebenszyklus vorweisen – und nicht nur für einzelne Projektaufgaben oder Arbeitspakete.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in Programm- und Projektsteuerung, einschließlich integrierter Planung, Risikomanagement, Abhängigkeitsmanagement, Änderungssteuerung und Reporting auf Senior-Ebene.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner sowie in der Einflussnahme auf interne Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation. Du trittst sicher auf, stellst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv infrage, triffst Entscheidungen und eskalierst Themen, wenn dies erforderlich ist.
  • Du verfügst über ein fundiertes praktisches Verständnis der Schnittstellen zwischen Standortentwicklung, Genehmigungsplanung, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und bist bereit, regelmäßig mit Teams an den Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien oder anderer dezentraler, kundenorientierter Infrastruktur.
  • Du verfügst über etablierte Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern und Baupartnern in einem oder mehreren DACH-Märkten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen zu Hochspannungs- oder elektrotechnischer Infrastruktur sowie mit der Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in ein operatives Netzwerk.
  • Du verfügst über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in AutoCAD und Microsoft Office, einschließlich fortgeschrittener Excel-Kenntnisse oder vergleichbarer Projektsteuerungs-Tools.
  • Du hast ein einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, eine technische Qualifikation oder vergleichbare berufliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Bauwesen, Infrastruktur oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.

Want to build and operate reliable platforms that help teams deliver great products? You’ll join a collaborative engineering team working at the intersection of development, operations, and architecture. 

As a Senior DevOps Engineer (m/f/d), you will help shape our cloud platform, solve complex technical problems, and turn ambiguous challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You will work closely with engineers and stakeholders across the domain and help raise our engineering standards through knowledge sharing and mentoring. 


What you can expect:

  • Architecture and ownership: You contribute to architectural decisions, address technical debt, and make pragmatic trade-offs across reliability, scalability, security, and cost.
  • Reliable platforms: You design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and maintainable cloud platforms and services.
  • Automation and delivery: You improve automation, infrastructure, deployment processes, observability, and operational efficiency.
  • Distributed systems: You work with distributed software, event-driven architectures, and event streaming.
  • Incremental delivery: You break complex initiatives into smaller workstreams and deliver value step by step.
  • Root-cause problem solving: You investigate recurring issues and create lasting solutions instead of relying on short-term fixes.
  • Team enablement: You share knowledge, mentor less experienced engineers, and promote collaboration, transparency, and shared responsibility.


Your profile

  • Professional experience: You have several years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, SRE, or a related field.
  • AWS expertise: You have strong hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Go experience: You have professional experience with Go (Golang), ideally for automation, platform tooling, or backend services.
  • Distributed systems: You understand distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and event streaming.
  • Engineering excellence: You are experienced with automation, infrastructure as code, continuous delivery, observability, security, and reliability.
  • Technical leadership: You can make sound architectural decisions and explain technical trade-offs clearly
  • Delivery mindset: You have experience leading technical initiatives and delivering complex work incrementally.
  • Collaboration and mentoring: You enjoy working with others, sharing knowledge, and supporting the growth of your colleagues.
  • Ownership and learning: You take responsibility for outcomes and continuously look for better long-term solutions.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.
 
Your Perspective: You will help shape how we build and run reliable technology at auxmoney. Your work will enable teams to deliver faster and more safely while improving platform reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency. You will have the autonomy to own meaningful technical decisions, lead challenging initiatives, and make a lasting impact through better systems, better processes, and stronger engineering teams.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process.

jobs.description:
Das erwartet Dich

Du bist kommunikationsstark und interessierst Dich für die neuesten Entwicklungen in der IT, wie zum Beispiel künstliche Intelligenz oder Cloud?

Dann ist die Ausbildung Fachinformatiker:in (m/w/d) für Systemintegration genau das Richtige für Dich. Innerhalb Deiner 2,5-jährigen Ausbildung durchläufst Du unterschiedliche Abteilungen und lernst so unsere Software von Grund auf kennen.
Ausbildungsstart: 01.09.2027

  • Während Deiner Ausbildung wirst Du in zwei Abteilungen, Support und Corporate IT, fokussiert eingearbeitet. Darüber hinaus erhältst Du spannende unternehmensweite Einblicke.
  • Im Bereich Support hilfst Du bei der Lösung von Problemfällen. Dabei verfolgst und dokumentierst Du diese in unserem Ticketsystem. Tagtäglich kommunizierst Du via Telefon oder E-Mail und stellst per Fernwartung sicher, dass unsere Kund:innen und Partner:innen reibungslos mit unserer Software arbeiten können.
  • Im Bereich Corporate IT unterstützt Du alle Mitarbeitende bei deren auftretenden Problemen im Hard- und Softwarebereich. Du analysierst die via Ticketsystem eingehende Fehlermeldungen und IT-Sicherheitsfragen, bearbeitest diese und sorgst somit dafür, dass die IT im Unternehmen läuft. Die Betreuung verschiedener Softwarelösungen und der IT-Infrastruktur gehören ebenfalls zu den täglichen Aufgaben.
  • Außerdem gewinnst du weitere Einblicke in anderen Abteilungen, um so den Produktlebenszyklus von DocuWare verstehen zu können.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast einen Mittleren Schulabschluss oder Abitur.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und auch englische Termine stellen keine allzu große Herausforderung dar. 
  • Technik und IT sind deine Leidenschaft.
  • Du bist neugierig und motiviert Lösungen mit den neuesten Technologien zu finden.
  • Du kommunizierst gerne und hast Spaß am Kundenkontakt via E-Mail und/oder Telefon.
  • Du gehst strukturiert und überlegt an deine Aufgaben heran und man kann sich auf Dich verlassen.
  • Du freust dich in einem großen Team von über 20 Auszubildenden zu arbeiten und gemeinsam zu lernen.


Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon. 
Im Team von DocuWare profitierst auch Du von diesen Vorteilen: 

  • Praxisorientierte Ausbildung mit intensivem Kennenlernen vieler Fachabteilungen durch interne Rotation.
  • Persönliche und umfangreiche Betreuung: Unsere speziell für Ausbildung geschaffene Abteilung, der Education Hub, mit einem qualifizierten Ausbilderteam und hilfsbereite Kolleg*innen unterstützt Dich während Deiner gesamten Ausbildung.
  • Team-Spirit: Regelmäßige Mitarbeitende- und Teamevents sorgen für Zusammenhalt. 
  • Attraktive Ausbildungsanreize: 
    • Ausbildungsgehalt (1.125€ im 1. Jahr/ 1.225€ im 2. Jahr/ 1.335€ im 3. Jahr)
    • 5 Personal Education Days
    • English Conversation 
  • Weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams: Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden aus Germering, New York, Sofia oder vielen anderen Locations.
  • Arbeitsort: Du arbeitest überwiegend in unserem modernen Büro, aber auch als Azubi bis zu einmal die Woche im Home Office. 
  • Gelebte Work-Life-Balance: Neben 30 Urlaubstagen im Jahr bieten wir Dir ein breites Sport- und Massageangebot, Kicker-Tisch und einen entspannenden Lounge-Bereich. 
  • Einzigartige Vorteile: Wähle eine von drei großartigen Optionen (Bonago, E-Gym oder Deutschlandticket) nach Deinen Bedürfnissen.

  • Du sorgst vor & wir unterstützen Dich dabei: DocuWare bezuschusst Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Und nicht zuletzt ein stabiler Arbeitsplatz: In unserem langjährig bestehenden und stetig wachsenden Unternehmen mit sehr guten Chancen auf eine Übernahme nach der Ausbildung.

jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Mercanis bist du der zentrale Umsatztreiber für unser bestehendes Kundenportfolio im gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise-Segment. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Vertriebs-Restrukturierung trennen wir "Hunting" und "Farming" konsequent: Du übernimmst die volle Vertriebs- und Deal-Verantwortung für ein exklusives Territory von ca. 60–70 bestehenden Accounts.

Deine Mission: Du identifizierst ungenutzte Cross- und Upsell-Potenziale, navigierst souverän durch komplexe C-Level-Buying-Center, steuerst vielschichtige Deal-Zyklen bis zum Verhandlungsabschluss und maximierst so nachhaltig unsere Net Revenue Retention (NRR). Wenn du ein tiefes Verständnis für B2B-SaaS-Vertriebsmethodiken mitbringst und Bestandskunden nicht nur betreuen, sondern durch echten Mehrwert strategisch ausbauen willst, ist dies deine perfekte Gelegenheit.


Dein Aufgabenbereich

  • Expansion & ARR-Wachstum: Du steuerst den gesamten Verkaufszyklus für Upsell-, Cross-Sell- und Modul-Erweiterungen in einem Portfolio von ca. 60–70 Bestandskunden und triffst deine eigenen Quota-Ziele.

  • Pipeline-Generierung im Bestand: Du analysierst deine Accounts eigenständig auf White Spots, identifizierst neue Anwendungsfälle im Bereich Einkauf & Supply Chain Management und generierst aktiv qualifizierte Expansion-Pipeline.

  • Strategisches Closing & C-Level Selling: Du navigierst komplexe Buying Center (CPO, CFO, IT-Leitung), baust Belieber- & Champion-Netzwerke auf Executive-Ebene auf und führst kommerzielle Verhandlungen (Preisgestaltung, Lizenzerweiterungen, Vertragsverlängerungen) eigenständig zum Abschluss.

  • Executive Relationship & Account Planning: Du erstellst strategische Account-Pläne für deine Top-Kunden, führst regelmäßige Business Reviews (QBRs) auf C-Level durch und positionierst Mercanis als unverzichtbaren Software-Partner.

  • Vorhersagbarkeit & Deal Execution: Du steuerst deine Deals anhand etablierter B2B-Sales-Methodiken (z. B. MEDDPICC), pflegst deine Pipeline im CRM mit hoher Forecasting-Genauigkeit und arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Success Team zusammen.


Dein Profil

  • B2B SaaS Closing-Erfahrung: Du bringst nachweisbare Erfolge im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb (als Account Executive, Enterprise AM oder Senior Closing Role) mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von Procurement-, SCM- oder komplexen B2B-Enterprise-Lösungen.

  • Track Record in Deal Execution: Du hast eine nachweisliche Historie im Erreichen oder Übertreffen deiner Umsatzziele (Quota) und bist vertraut mit komplexen Verkaufszyklen und mehrstufigen Decision-Making-Prozessen.

  • Sales Methodik & Value Selling: Du beherrschst Value-Based Selling, kannst ROI-Analysen auf C-Level überzeugend präsentieren und bist geübt im Umgang mit Sales-Frameworks (z. B. MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger).

  • Verhandlungssicherheit & C-Level-Flüssigkeit: Du verhandelst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau oder seit mindestens 10 Jahren im deutschen Geschäftsumfeld verankert) sowie verhandlungssicher auf Englisch.

  • Präsenz & Skalierungs-Drive: Du wohnst in Berlin (oder bist umzugsbereit) für unser Office-First/Hybrid-Modell, arbeitest datengetrieben und bringst die Motivation mit, in einem schnell skalierenden Tech-Startup Verantwortung zu übernehmen.


Warum wir?

  • Mentoring & persönliches Wachstum: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Seriengründern zusammen, die dich in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung aktiv begleiten und fördern.
  • Compensation: Kompetitives Fixgehalt + attraktiver, ungedeckelter Bonus & VSOP (Beteiligungsmodell).
  • Perks: Lebe das Scale-up-Life, regelmäßige Team Events & Offsites, und natürlich: kostenlose Uber-Eats-Meals & Uber-Rides, wenn’s mal wieder länger dauert.
  • Room for Ideas: Wir leben eine offene Kultur mit echtem Sparring, du übernimmst Verantwortung und bekommst den Freiraum, deine Ideen voranzutreiben.
  • Team Mindset: Werde Teil eines neugierigen, motivierten Teams, das mutig experimentiert, offen kommuniziert und sich stetig weiterentwickelt, gemeinsam und individuell.
  • Central Location: Unser Büro liegt im Herzen von Berlins Startup-Ökosystem, mit bester Anbindung, großartiger Energie und tollen Menschen.

Join us in reshaping the future of golf! With a team of over 85 passionate people, we're dedicated to our mission in revolutionizing the golf industry one swing at a time. Our international team, based in Munich, is seeking a motivated Head of Business Operations or Senior Business Operations Manager to become part of our company in a dynamic and innovative environment. In this role, you help translate our revenue targets into an operational plan and bring five independent teams together along this plan. You are the central interface for planning, timing, and alignment in the revenue and marketing area, holding everything together. Ready to embrace your Vice?


Skip the copy paste. Show us your swing

Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.


Responsibilities

  • Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
  • Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
  • Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
  • Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
  • Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
  • Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
  • Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.
  • Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.
  • Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.
  • Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the founders


Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company
  • You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them
  • Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers
  • Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
  • Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
  • Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
  • Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe
  • Fluent English (German is a very big plus)
  • Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sites
Nice to Have
  • An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators
  • Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics
  • Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The systems underneath that experience must support safe production changes, measurable reliability, and predictable performance as usage grows.

This Engineering Manager will lead SRE across observability, incident management, load testing, performance engineering, cloud cost and capacity, and rollout infrastructure. You'll lead and grow an existing team that builds and operates production platforms and works hands-on across application and infrastructure boundaries.

This is a software-building leadership role, not simply an incident-management function. You'll help teams ship safely, understand production behavior, and remove performance bottlenecks through concrete engineering improvements. You should be comfortable going deep on a rollout failure or performance investigation while developing technical leaders and sustainable ownership across a distributed team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Observability. Build and operate metrics, logs, traces, and alerting capabilities. Help teams establish meaningful SLOs and use production telemetry to diagnose problems and verify improvements.

 - Incident Management. Own incident tooling and practices, coordinate cross-team response, and turn incident reviews into engineering improvements that reduce recovery time and repeat failures.

 - Load Testing. Build and maintain load/failure testing capabilities. Validate critical paths under expected demand, quantify headroom, and test recovery and production readiness with service owners.

 - Performance Engineering. Lead deep engagements with internal teams on SLOs and end-to-end performance. Use profiling, telemetry, and load tests to identify bottlenecks and deliver improvements with service owners—not just recommendations.

 - Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated changes.

 - Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Make distributed collaboration, mentoring, and backup coverage deliberate rather than relying on a few permanent escalation points.

 - Measure outcomes and close the loop. Track rollout safety, recovery time, repeat incidents, critical-path latency/throughput, test coverage, and improvements arising from cost/capacity analysis. Agree success measures and continuing ownership with partner teams.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

 - Software-oriented production systems depth. You have built and operated distributed systems or reliability platforms and can reason across deployment behavior, Kubernetes, telemetry, service dependencies, and recovery mechanisms.

 - Safe-change and performance judgment. You have led consequential migrations or incidents and used measurement to diagnose reliability or performance problems. You can distinguish symptoms from causes and validate fixes under realistic conditions.

 - Platform-product and cross-team judgment. You can build capabilities other teams adopt, lead hands-on engagements without absorbing every service's operations, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, performance, engineering effort, and cost.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with GitOps or progressive-delivery platforms such as Harness, ArgoCD, or Kargo.

 - Experience with observability, profiling, load-testing, and failure-testing systems, including OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling.

 - Experience with cloud cost attribution, capacity planning, and provider coordination, particularly on GCP.

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

Integrated Marketing France orchestrates major marketing moments, brand initiatives and local activations, working closely with central functional teams.

The Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager translates central marketing direction, France business priorities, and consumer and performance insights into an integrated 360° marketing plan tailored to the French market. They bring local and central expertise together, make prioritisation recommendations, coordinate delivery and measure the plan's effectiveness against Deliveroo France's marketing and business objectives.

This is a hybrid role, based in Paris.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Integrated Marketing Planning & Business Performance — France

  • Analyse business priorities, performance data, consumer insights and previous campaign results to identify opportunities and risks for the French market.

  • Lead France quarterly planning, from kick-off through approval of priorities, objectives and the calendar.

  • Translate central direction and French market needs into one coherent integrated 360° marketing plan.

  • Develop prioritisation recommendations and trade-off scenarios based on expected impact, capacity, investment and dependencies.

  • Partner with the relevant teams to define campaign objectives and KPIs, then feed campaign learnings into future plans.

  • Act as PMO for key marketing moments, including Back-to-School and Black Friday, and build the overarching narrative.

2. Orchestrating 360° Campaigns

  • Bring local and central teams together around a shared delivery plan and build integrated timelines.

  • Lead the localisation of global campaigns and align media plans with the mix defined by Brand Marketing, ensuring they are tailored to the French market.

  • Coordinate local campaigns and partner activations with the Promo & Partnerships teams.

  • Clarify ownership, dependencies, decision dates and success criteria; resolve friction and escalate issues requiring a trade-off decision.

3. Tracking, Performance & Governance

  • Track deliverables, analyse gaps against objectives and the France brief, and run coordination check-ins.

  • Maintain campaign documentation and prepare the memos required for decisions and trade-offs.

  • Ensure legal requirements and local market considerations are reflected.

  • Consolidate visibility over marketing investment, identify gaps or constraints that could affect the plan, and facilitate trade-off decisions with budget owners.

  • Run campaign reviews with Measurement teams, analyse results and turn learnings into recommendations for future plans.

4. Agencies & Partnerships

  • Consolidate and prioritise French market feedback for the Creative team, coordinate deadlines and ensure deliverables meet the France brief. The Creative team retains ownership of creative development and approval.

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for agencies on execution, deliverables and planning.

  • Coordinate major brand partnerships, such as Top Chef, with the Promo & Partnerships teams, media owners and relevant partners.

Ways of Working

  • Works across multiple functional teams without direct authority over most contributors, leading through influence.

  • Distinguishes what can be resolved independently from what requires escalation, and arbitrates competing local and central priorities.

  • Maintains visibility through one shared, up-to-date campaign calendar that serves as the reference point for all stakeholders.

Success in this role depends equally on the quality of relationships and the quality of organisation.

 

Key Skills

  • Strategic thinking, intellectual curiosity and business orientation, with the ability to understand complex topics quickly and connect marketing choices to market priorities and objectives.

  • Data fluency and strong analytical skills to interpret performance, challenge assumptions and make recommendations.

  • Integrated marketing planning and complex programme management, from setting priorities through 360° campaign execution.

  • Stakeholder management and influence in a matrix environment, with the ability to simplify complex topics and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • Prioritisation, trade-off decision-making and operational rigour, including risk anticipation, agency management and dependency management.

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience in integrated marketing, marketing planning, marketing strategy or marketing programme management, either client-side or in an agency.

  • Demonstrated experience turning business priorities and performance data into plans, trade-off scenarios and marketing recommendations.

  • Experience orchestrating 360° campaigns in a matrix environment, working with local teams, central teams and agencies.

  • Strong understanding of the main marketing levers, their contribution to business and brand objectives, and the French market.

Success Measures

  • One integrated 360° France marketing plan, aligned with business priorities and recognised as the reference point by local and central teams.

  • Data-driven recommendations and trade-off decisions based on expected impact and available capacity.

  • Clear campaign objectives and KPIs, with results analysed and applied to future plans.

  • Coherent 360° campaigns delivered without major surprises and with risks anticipated.

  • Local execution that contributes to Deliveroo France's marketing and business objectives.

  • Clear stakeholder visibility on priorities, risks, decisions and results.

Why This Role?

This role offers unique exposure to Deliveroo France's strategic marketing challenges, working directly with local leadership and central functional teams. It provides a strong platform for progression into broader Integrated Marketing responsibilities.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Thruster CAD and Stress Analyst
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented CAD & Stress Analyst to help us in our mission by designing and structurally justifying the hardware that makes up our propulsion systems, with a particular focus on the Thrust Chamber Assembly(TCA). You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design.

Key responsibilities

In your capacity as a CAD & Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Design the thrust chamber & injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design.

  • Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads.

  • Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints.

  • Work closely with propulsion, thermal and fluidic system engineers to translate functional requirements into part-level design and load cases.

  • Establish and maintain interface definitions, drawings and part datasets, ensuring configuration control and traceability.

  • Conduct trade studies on design options (geometry, material, manufacturing route) and justify design decisions with analysis.

  • Elaborate and maintain structural analysis reports supporting design reviews and qualification.

  • Support the definition of test requirements needed to validate analytical models and structural assumptions.

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation of design choices and trade-offs, to a high standard, capturing analysis methods and results as to serve as reference justification for the design.

During Manufacturing, Assembly and Test Phase:

  • Support manufacturing and inspection of parts, resolving design or tolerance issues as they arise.

  • Support root-cause investigations of any structural anomaly or test finding, correlating analysis with hardware behaviour.

  • Update and correlate stress models and analyses based on test and inspection results.

  • Support design iterations and upgrades based on test campaign outcomes.

What we would love to see from you

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering or similar degrees.

About the role:

We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX) — the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures & cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure).

This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts side — building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. You'll be fully embedded in that area day-to-day, but you'll work alongside the reference-architecture side of the team regularly, and SMX is actively working toward enabling every engineer to review and contribute across both stacks over time.

SMX is also shifting from a purely artifact- and ops-focused team toward one in which engineers bring customer judgment and product sense alongside technical depth. That means engaging directly with the teams closest to customers — Support, Consulting, Presales — and using that signal to help shape what we prioritize, not just executing a fully-specced ticket.

You'll find plenty of room to leave your own footprint: deployment automation, software and infrastructure testing, multi-region setups, and developer experience are all live areas of investment as the team matures from "basic install" toward full-lifecycle ownership (upgrades, backup/restore, disaster recovery).

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build, maintain, and release C8 distribution artifacts for self-managed customers — Helm Charts (Kubernetes), C8Run, and Docker Compose — along with their documentation.

  • Improve the reliability and usability of deployment artifacts across the full customer lifecycle: installation, upgrades, and day-2 operations, not just initial deployment.

  • Engage directly with internal customer-facing teams (Support, Consulting, Presales) to understand real deployment problems, and use that signal to help shape what gets prioritized — not just how it gets built. Collaborate with Development Teams, Product Management, QA, and Documentation to ship integrated, tested, and documented releases.

  • Take part in the team's shared medic rotation and resolve engineering-level support cases, feeding learnings back into development.

  • Contribute to the shared tooling (review, deployment, and test tooling) that SMX is building so other Camunda teams can adopt it — this is one of the team's current investment areas.

What success looks like (first ~3 months):

  • Taken on your first medic rotation slot and support tickets to understand the stack, customer challenges, and deployment environments.

  • Improved onboarding or documentation, turning your own ramp-up experience into concrete improvements.

  • Contributed to artifact fixes, CI/CD enhancements, or test automation that strengthens release quality.

  • Deliver structural improvement initiatives — a feature request, or a test/release improvement.

  • Built working relationships with engineering, QA, and product peers, and started building context on the reference-architecture side of the team.

  • Started forming your own view of a customer pain point from firsthand signal (support tickets, consulting feedback), not just from a ticket description.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product, with genuine curiosity about the customer problem behind a ticket — comfortable asking "should we build this" as well as "how do we build this."

  • Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining Helm Charts; deploying applications on Kubernetes; implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).

  • Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively across teams.

  • A pragmatic and autonomous approach to programming and problem-solving.

  • You thrive as a manager of one — you build it, you own it — and take pride in delivering maintainable, operable software.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience running and operating on-prem/self-hosted software on Docker.

  • Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools.

  • Working knowledge of the Go programming language.

  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure/IaC (Terraform, Crossplane) — useful as SMX moves toward shared review capability across installation artifacts and reference architectures.

jobs.title: Ingénieur·e en médiation scientifique et valorisation de la recherche
jobs.description:
1-     ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE

Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est rattaché au Département interdisciplinaire en sciences sociales (DI2S) rassemblant des enseignants chercheurs et enseignantes chercheuses en sciences de gestion, sociologie, économie et droit. Sur le campus de Nantes, les recherches sont focalisées sur l’analyse des transformations des organisations et des métiers dans des systèmes sociotechniques. Trois domaines d’investigation sont privilégiés : l’industrie, la santé et l’environnement. Le ou la candidate sera affilé·e au LEMNA (Laboratoire Économie et Management Nantes Atlantique).

Plus précisément, le poste sera rattaché à la chaire RESOH [Recherche en Sécurité Organisations Hommes]. Les travaux de recherche, à l’interface de la sociologie et de la gestion, portent sur le fonctionnement des organisations à hauts risques. Partant de l’analyse du travail et des organisations de travail, il s’agit d’éclairer les dimensions socio-organisationnelles, managériales et institutionnelles contribuant à (ou empêchant) le maintien d’un niveau de fiabilité compatible avec les exigences de sécurité et de production. Les recherches de la chaire sont conduites en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et institutionnels. Elles visent à produire des connaissances scientifiques fondées sur des enquêtes de terrain, mais également à favoriser leur mise en discussion, leur appropriation et leur mobilisation par les acteurs concernés. Dans ce contexte, la chaire souhaite renforcer ses capacités de valorisation, de diffusion et d’appropriation de ses travaux, auprès de ses partenaires actuels comme, plus largement, du monde socio-économique.

 

2-     MISSIONS

En collaboration avec l’ensemble des enseignants-chercheurs de l’équipe (permanents et associés), les missions sont :

1-     Participer à la dynamique collective de recherche au sein de la chaire

2-     Structurer et valoriser les résultats des recherches de la chaire

3-     En favoriser l’appropriation par les partenaires industriels et institutionnels de la chaire (volet interne)

4-     Contribuer au rayonnement de la chaire auprès du monde socio-économique (volet externe)

 

 

3-     ACTIVITÉS : Activité par mission

 

  1.     Participer à la dynamique collective de recherche au sein de la chaire

·     contribue activement aux réunions de coordination, espaces de discussion et séminaires de recherche (au sein de l’équipe de recherche RESOH et avec les partenaires)

 

2.     Valoriser et diffuser les résultats des recherches de la chaire

·     cartographie les principaux travaux, résultats et productions de la chaire ;

·     identifie les publics susceptibles d’être intéressés par ces résultats ;

·     analyse leurs besoins et leurs attentes ;

·     contribue à définir des stratégies de valorisation et de communication adaptées aux différents projets ;

·     contribue à l’organisation des événements scientifiques (journée d’étude, colloque, etc.) ;

·     transforme les résultats scientifiques en ressources accessibles à des publics non spécialistes, sans en perdre la rigueur, la nuance ni la portée scientifique (synthèses, notes de recherche, fiches thématiques, supports de présentation, contenus numériques ou autres formats adaptés aux publics visés).

 

3.     Favoriser l’appropriation des travaux de recherche par les partenaires industriels et institutionnels de la chaire (volet interne)

·     prépare et organise des restitutions de travaux ;

·     conçoit et anime des ateliers ou temps d’échange ;

·     prépare des supports adaptés aux préoccupations des partenaires ;

·     recueille leurs réactions, questions et besoins ;

·     fait remonter vers les chercheurs les questions et attentes exprimées par les partenaires ;

·     contribue à identifier les conditions favorisant l’appropriation des résultats.

 

4.     Contribuer au rayonnement de la chaire auprès du monde socio-économique (volet externe)

·     identifie des organisations, réseaux et acteurs susceptibles d’être intéressés par les travaux de la chaire ;

·     développe et entretient des relations avec des acteurs industriels, institutionnels et professionnels ;

·     identifie des événements pertinents ;

·     prépare la participation de la chaire à des événements professionnels et scientifiques ;

·     participe à l’organisation d’événements scientifiques de la chaire (colloque, conférence, journée d’étude)

·     contribue à développer de nouveaux formats de rencontre entre chercheurs et praticiens ;

·     participe à la constitution de communautés d’intérêt autour de certaines thématiques de recherche.


Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums souhaité :
