jobs.title: Regional Operations Director
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Regional Operations Director (EMEA)

Location: London, United Kingdom (3 days a week from our London offices)

About the role: 

The Regional Operations Director is accountable for the operational effectiveness of the EMEA region. Reporting to the Global Chief Transformation and Operations Officer, you'll translate the global operating model into practical, market-specific execution — building the structure, governance and performance focus needed to strengthen operational control and support scalable growth.

You'll lead a regional operations team, partner closely with regional and global leadership, and act as the key connector between regional execution and global capability. The role calls for a leader equally comfortable setting strategic direction and solving complex operational problems hands-on — someone who turns data into action, builds high-performing teams, and keeps commercial performance firmly in focus.

What you will be doing: 

 

Regional operational leadership

  • Set clear priorities, accountabilities and ways of working for the EMEA Regional Operations function.
  • Build the structure, rhythm and capability needed to improve client delivery, business performance and regional growth.
  • Act as the senior operational partner to Regional Leadership on risks, performance, capacity and improvement priorities.

Client delivery operations

  • Own the operational run model for EMEA clients — including cadence, governance, issue resolution and escalation management.
  • Partner with Account Leadership to ensure delivery risks are visible, blockers are resolved quickly and client teams are set up to deliver effectively.
  • Ensure regional clients are mobilised and supported through consistent operating standards and reliable delivery controls.

Governance, cadence and decision management

  • Own the regional governance rhythm: forums, communications, decision-making and performance reviews.
  • Ensure decisions are made at the right level, escalations are routed effectively and regional context is represented in relevant global and regional forums.
  • Drive clear actions, accountability and follow-through across the function.

Operating model execution

  • Embed the global operating model across EMEA, ensuring standards, processes, tools and governance expectations are adopted consistently.
  • Translate enterprise-level standards into practical, market-specific ways of working.

Resource and capacity management

  • Own the regional view of demand, supply, utilisation, resource mix and capacity gaps.
  • Partner with Global Capacity Management, Account Teams, Delivery Leads and Offshore Operations to optimise deployment, resolve constraints and improve utilisation.
  • Provide regional input into enterprise workforce planning and future capacity needs.

Business and client enablement

  • Ensure regional client teams have the operational foundations needed to mobilise and deliver work effectively.
  • Coordinate core business processes including client onboarding, timesheeting, billing readiness, interagency set-ups, compliance and headcount approvals.
  • Act as the regional operational point of coordination for enablement issues, working across Finance, HR, Technology and Implementation to unblock dependencies.

Commercial performance and margin management

  • Manage the operational levers that affect cost-to-serve across the region, including scope leakage, resource efficiency, rework and avoidable cost.
  • Partner with Account Leadership and Finance to improve margin visibility and ensure practical actions are in place to protect profitable delivery.
  • Oversee regional budget performance and present financial outcomes to regional and global stakeholders.

Regional insight and continuous improvement

  • Use performance data to identify risks, issues and improvement opportunities across the region.
  • Translate insight into action — ensuring key issues have clear owners, measurable outcomes and appropriate escalation routes.
  • Identify recurring operational bottlenecks and lead remediation, including regional adoption of global improvement initiatives.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Act as the key operational connector between EMEA and global operations capabilities.
  • Partner across Sales, Account, Implementation, Finance, HR, Technology and Offshore functions to drive client outcomes and operational consistency.
  • Provide regional operational input into sales pursuits, client mobilisation, scope expansions and solution design — ensuring proposed models are deliverable and scalable.
  • Interface with Global Programme Directors where regional and global client contexts intersect, aligning on dependencies, escalations and capacity impacts.

Team leadership and development

  • Lead, coach and develop the Regional Operations team, building a high-performing function with clear roles, standards and ways of working.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational discipline and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure the team has the skills, confidence and behaviours needed to support a more mature, insight-led and scalable delivery model. 

What you need to be great in this role: 

Essential

  • Senior operations leadership experience within, advertising, consulting, creative production, media agency or professional services.
  • Deep understanding of agency operating models — including client delivery, workflow, resource planning, utilisation, scopes of work, billing, compliance and margin management.
  • Proven experience leading regional or multi-market operations teams in a people-led, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with confidence managing the operational levers that affect profitability.
  • Experience owning or improving resource and capacity management, including demand and supply visibility, workforce mix and deployment planning.
  • Ability to use operational data, KPIs and reporting to identify risks, drive action and improve performance.
  • Track record embedding governance, process discipline and ways of working across complex teams or markets.
  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder skills — with experience partnering across regional and global functions including Finance, HR, Technology, Account and Delivery.
  • Proven people leadership: building capable teams, strengthening operational performance and creating a culture of accountability.
  • Comfortable moving between strategic direction and hands-on operational problem-solving.

Desirable

  • Experience in a global matrix organisation with regional, global and offshore delivery models.
  • Background in an in-house agency, embedded agency, creative production or complex marketing ecosystem.
  • Exposure to client mobilisation, implementation, transition or new operating model design.
  • Experience contributing to RFPs, commercial modelling, solution design or delivery model development.
  • Exposure to automation, AI-enabled operations, workflow optimisation or digital transformation in a marketing or agency environment.

Commercial and budget accountability

  • Experience overseeing regional or annual operational budgets and presenting financial performance to senior stakeholders.
  • Track record of driving margin discipline — reducing leakage, rework and avoidable cost across complex delivery environments.
  • Ability to connect operational decisions to commercial outcomes and communicate financial performance clearly to leadership.

jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?"

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential.

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast: ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. OpenAI for Government (OAI4G) helps public-sector institutions understand, adopt, and deploy highly capable AI products in support of their missions. The team brings together Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, and other cross-functional partners to help governments use AI responsibly and effectively.

As part of OAI4G’s International Public Sector team, you will help public institutions in the UK, Middle East (ME) and Latin America (LATAM) translate frontier AI into secure, compliant, mission-aligned outcomes. We work across varied procurement, regulatory, security, sovereignty, and commercial environments, while maintaining a consistent commitment to safety, reliability, and public benefit.

About the role

We are seeking a Global Account Director (GAD) to lead OpenAI’s public-sector work across the UK, ME and LATAM. You will build trusted relationships with government leaders, develop and execute account strategies, create and close complex opportunities, and help customers move from initial interest to successful adoption.

This is a full-cycle, highly cross-functional sales role that combines technical understanding, strategic vision, partnership management, and value-driven execution. You will work with senior government, operational, technical, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders to identify high-impact AI use cases and translate them into credible commercial and deployment pathways across the OpenAI Platform API and Codex and ChatGPT Enterprise.

You will also be an accountable customer leader after signature, working alongside specialist delivery and technical teams to keep customer outcomes, milestones, adoption, risks, and executive alignment on track. The role requires excellent judgement, executive presence, local fluency, and the ability to move between strategy, discovery, capture, procurement, delivery governance, and relationship management without day-to-day direction.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will

  • Own a focused portfolio of UK, ME and LATAM public-sector accounts.

  • Build and execute comprehensive account plans that map mission priorities, stakeholders, procurement paths, partners, use cases, risks, and long-term expansion opportunities.

  • Work closely with the Partnerships team, global and regional system integrators, cloud and technology providers, local delivery partners, resellers, and strategic international partners to shape joint pursuits, deployment models, and purchasing paths.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior government executives and decision-makers, while staying close to operational users and technical stakeholders whose workflows determine successful adoption.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, account records, customer follow-up, and executive reporting, with disciplined follow-through across markets and time zones.

  • Monitor the government, technology, procurement, partner, and competitive landscape across UK, ME and LATAM markets, surfacing insights that inform product roadmaps and go-to-market strategy.

  • Represent OpenAI at government, partner, and industry forums, strengthening networks and identifying opportunities that advance responsible public-sector adoption of AI.


We’re seeking someone with experience including

  • 10+ years in government, diplomacy, national security, international development, multilateral institutions, public-sector technology sales, business development, consulting, transformation, systems integration, or a closely related field, with meaningful ownership of complex customer outcomes.

  • Direct experience in government, diplomacy, national security, foreign affairs, or international organisations, or very significant experience working with those customers in sensitive, regulated, or high-consequence environments.

  • Material experience operating credibly in sensitive or national-security-adjacent settings; an active or recently held government security clearance is valuable, and the ability to obtain or maintain any clearance required for the portfolio may be necessary.

  • A strong record of shaping and closing complex cross-border deals: account planning, discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, capture, proposal development, negotiations, forecasting, closure, adoption, and expansion.

  • Executive presence with senior diplomats, ministers, multilateral executives, government leaders, and decision-makers, alongside credibility with technical, operational, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders.

  • Sound understanding of multilateral and public-sector procurement, funding, contracting, security, privacy, data-residency, sovereignty, and compliance requirements across more than one ME or LATAM market.

  • Ability to orchestrate regional and international partners, including system integrators, resellers, cloud providers, development institutions, advisory partners, and delivery partners.

  • Enough AI and enterprise-technology fluency to explain OpenAI’s products, capabilities, limitations, and responsible-use trade-offs clearly to diplomatic, multilateral, and government audiences, and to engage the right specialists early.

  • High ownership, exceptional written and verbal communication, diplomatic judgement under ambiguity, strong capacity management across regions and time zones, and willingness to travel across ME and LATAM, and internationally as needed.

Nice to have

  • Deep relationships across international organisations, regional bodies, development institutions, foreign affairs, defence, national security, or other sensitive public-sector communities.

  • Experience developing opportunities across more than one ME or LATAM market, ideally with exposure to international organisations or regional bodies.

  • Experience with AI/ML, cloud, data platforms, cybersecurity, API-based products, public-sector digital transformation, or regulated cross-border technology deployments.

  • Experience moving a complex cross-border opportunity from early mission discovery through procurement, deployment governance, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

The Commercial Field Engineer’s primary role is to serve as a technical advisor and champion for CodeRabbit customers in the Commercial tier throughout their post-sales journey. In this function, you will play a crucial role in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing success by partnering with Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Support teams to ensure customers realize the full value of CodeRabbit.

jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The Role:

We're looking for a dedicated, organised Senior Complaints Specialist to join us as we build our Complaints function in EMEA from the ground up - this is our first dedicated complaints hire in the region. You'll spend the majority of your time as a proactive, high-energy complaint handler: resolving complex disputes and keeping pace with our regulatory deadlines. This is much more than a standard complaint handler role: alongside resolving complex disputes, you'll lead our monthly complaints reviews, drive root cause analysis, and step up complaints handling processes for the region.

Who you are:

  • You're a natural complaint handler – you take ownership of a steady caseload, resolve issues objectively and fairly, and can turn a messy, technical problem into a clear explanation for the customer. You also have extensive knowledge of UK regulations including DISP and the FOS complaints handling process.

  • You're organised and deadline-driven – you manage your own schedule to make sure every case is resolved within the required legal timeframes, without needing to be chased

  • You're detailed-orientated– you can prepare thorough case files, gather evidence, and represent Airwallex professionally in front of the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • You're ready to step up – you’ll run our monthly complaints meetings and drive root cause analysis across EMEA.

  • You're a great collaborator – you'll work closely with internal teams to fix the root cause of issues.

  • You’re ambitious – you're excited by the idea of shaping how we run complaints across EMEA as our first hire in the function, and by helping us build how we use AI to handle complaints at scale

Responsibilities

  • Manage your caseload: Take ownership of a steady stream of complaints, meeting daily targets while maintaining high standards.

  • Meet regulatory timelines: Manage your own schedule to ensure every case is resolved within the required legal timeframes

  • Lead on regulator escalations: Manage cases that reach the Financial Ombudsman Service, preparing thorough case files, gathering evidence, and drafting Airwallex's final position

  • Own the regulator relationship: Act as the day-to-day point of contact with the Ombudsman, keeping our responses professional, timely and factual

  • Lead our EMEA complaints reviews: Run our monthly complaints meetings, bringing visibility to trends, volumes and priorities across the region

  • Drive root cause analysis: Work cross-functionally with internal teams to identify why issues occur, and lead the push for long-term fixes rather than one-off resolutions

  • Help build our complaints AI capability: As volumes grow, help shape how we use AI to handle complaints more efficiently at scale

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years' experience handling regulated complaints, ideally within financial services

  • Strong working knowledge of DISP and other relevant complaints-handling regulation

  • Experience preparing cases for, and liaising with, regulators such as the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • A track record of meeting productivity and quality targets in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

  • Experience driving root cause analysis or process improvement cross-functionally

  • Confidence using AI-driven tools to automate manual processes and improve efficiency

jobs.title: Sjuksköterska, Gynekologisk och urologisk avdelning, Umeå
jobs.description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Kirurgcentrum Umeås främsta mål och uppgift är att bedriva högspecialiserad och högkvalitativ vård och forskning för patienter inom den norra sjukvårdsregionen. Kliniken är indelad i sektionerna urologi, bröst, endokrin, kärl, kolorektal samt övre gastroenterologisk kirurgi, som bedrivs inom både öppen- och slutenvård.

Vi söker nu dig som vill jobba som sjuksköterska på urologiska och gynekologiska avdelningen. På avdelning utreder vi, behandlar och opererar människor med gynekologisk och urologisk cancer. Vi hanterar även ett stort antal akuta inläggningar, exempelvis infektioner, blödningar från urinvägarna, graviditetskomplikationer och även allmänkirurgiska patienter när vi har plats. Omvårdnaden hos oss präglas av en helhetssyn där många olika yrkeskategorier är engagerade och samarbetar i team för att nå bästa möjliga resultat.

Vi är en mindre personalgrupp med god samhållning och gott samarbete. Hos oss har vi lätt till skratt men kan samtidigt dela komplexa situationer. För oss är det viktigt att ha en god och öppen kommunikation mellan varandra samt att alla känner sig välkomna. Vårt motto är att vi är varandras arbetsmiljö och frågan vi ställer oss är- Hur gör vi varandra bra?

Hos oss erbjuds du att arbeta enligt en arbetstidsmodell, så kallad modifierad 3–3, som är skapad för att öka möjligheten till återhämtning. Den innebär i praktiken att du arbetar cirka 88%, med bibehållen heltidslön.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som sjuksköterska hos oss bidrar du till att ta väl hand om andra och få människor att må bättre.

Du kommer att arbeta inom ett brett kirurgiskt område med högspecialiserad kirurgi och akutsjukvård där du har en viktig roll vad gäller att leda, prioritera och samordna vårdarbetet inom ditt omvårdnadsteam på avdelningen. Vi arbetar teambaserat och du har ett nära samarbete med sjuksköterskekollegor, undersköterskor, läkare och andra specialiserade funktioner.

Vi vill att du ska få en trygg start hos oss därför kommer vi att utforma en individuell inskolning så att du kan känna att du får en god möjlighet att lära dig arbetet hos oss. Vi anpassar inskolningens längd efter dina kunskaper och behov.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Du är legitimerad sjuksköterska. Vi ser det som meriterande med erfarenhet inom sjukhusvård.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta i ett spännande och varierande arbete i en organisation under utveckling. Du har ett genuint intresse för människor och har patienten i fokus. Vi värdesätter att du är engagerad och flexibel som person med en uttalad samarbetsförmåga. Tillsammans med dina kollegor bidrar du till att utveckla verksamheten och skapar en trivsam arbetsmiljö.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde snarast enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Schema.

Läs mer om våra förmåner för dig som jobbar med oss på webbsidan

https://www.regionvasterbotten.se/nar-du-jobbar-hos-oss/formaner

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Om du har skyddad identitet och vill ansöka så kontaktar du rekryterande chef och skickar sedan in dina ansökningshandlingar via post.

jobs.title: Timvikarier sökes till högstadiet - Härryda kommun
jobs.description:
Välkommen till Härryda, en kommun som vågar!

Här siktar vi mot att ha Sveriges bästa skolor och näringslivsklimat, omsorg av högsta kvalitet och attraktivt samhällsbyggande. Tillsammans är vi 3000 medarbetare som gör mötet med Härryda kommun enkelt. Med mod, nytänkande och handlingskraft inspirerar vi varandra och levererar service med kompetens och kvalitet. Härryda kommun har de fyra senaste åren placerat sig i topp i Dagens Samhälles årliga ranking av Årets superkommun.

Vi söker dig som är engagerad, öppen för olika perspektiv och vill skapa lösningar som håller för kommande generationer. Du hittar oss mellan Göteborg och Borås med Landvetter flygplats mitt i kommunen. Tillsammans åstadkommer vi mer!

15 plats(er).


Har du intresse, vilja och engagemang att arbeta tillsammans med ungdomar? Tycker du om att ta ansvar, och kan ställa upp med kort varsel även om du får en bokning från skolan tidigt på morgonen?

Vid sjukdom, vård av barn och andra ledigheter behöver vi timvikarier. Som timvikarie i högstadiet hamnar du mitt i verksamheten där det förutsätts att du är flexibel och snabbt kan sätta dig in i olika rutiner. Skolans första lektion börjar runt kl 8.00, vilket kräver att man behöver vara nåbar från ca 6:30.

I Härryda kommuns skolor ska elevernas lust till lärande stimuleras. Lärandet ska präglas av samarbete, delaktighet och inflytande för barn och unga. Omsorg och lärande ska bilda en helhet och skolan ska ta hand om eleven på bästa tänkbara sätt. I Härryda kommun finns det 18 kommunala grundskolor från Mölnlycke i väst till Rävlanda i öst.

Som lärarvikarie ersätter du ordinarie personal vilket innebär att du ska kunna bedriva undervisning för en hel klass i särskilda ämnen (årskurs 7-9). Under skoldagen är du med i klassrummet och stöttar ordinarie lärare.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta i högstadiet på våra grundskolor i Härryda kommun under höst- och vårterminen. Som person är du ansvarsfull , engagerad, lugn och empatisk med ett genuint intresse att arbeta med barn/ungdomar. Du är även trygg i dig själv och kan ta kommandot i klassrummet samt skapa en god undervisningsmiljö.

För att vara aktuell i denna rekrytering behöver du uppfylla nedan:

    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska språket, muntligt och skriftligt
    Goda datorkunskaper
    Utdrag från polisens belastningsregister som heter Kontroll av egna uppgifter och Utdrag för arbete i skola eller förskola

    Kunna arbeta i högstadiet

Meriterande

    Kan arbeta i  alla områden: Mölnlycke, Landvetter, Hindås och Rävlanda
    Relevant arbetslivserfarenhet
    Relevant utbildning för yrket
    Några års arbetslivserfarenhet
    Erfarenhet av att handleda/undervisa grupper
    B körkort

Vi lägger stor vikt vid bemötande och personlig lämplighet.

För att erhålla anställning ska utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister uppvisas. Belastningsregister beställer du på polisens hemsida. Blir du kallad på intervju ska du ha med dig två belastningsregister, Kontroll av egna uppgifter, i oöppnat kuvert och visa upp Utdrag för arbete inom skolväsendet.

Till denna ansökan behöver du svara på ett antal urvalsfrågor i samband när du ansöker. Svar på frågorna används som en del i urvalsprocessen. Ditt CV och svaren på frågorna ska vara formulerade på svenska. Vårt behov varierar och utifrån aktuellt behov kallar vi till intervju.

jobs.title: Vedlikeholdsleder til Isbjørn Is – operativ nøkkelrolle
jobs.description:
Vi søker en erfaren og handlekraftig Vedlikeholdsleder til en nyopprettet stilling ved fabrikken vår på Follese.

Rollen er operativ og skal sikre stabil drift og høy produktivitet på våre produksjonslinjer, samt utvikling av både prosesser og mennesker i produksjonen. Du får en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle hvordan vi jobber med vedlikehold, og vil være tett på både produksjonsutstyret og menneskene som bruker det hver dag.

Innføring av standarder og preventivt vedlikehold er viktige nøkkeloppgaver. Vi ser derfor etter en Vedlikeholdsleder som tar eierskap, skaper struktur og fremdrift og samtidig trives med å være operativ når det er behov for det.

Stillingen rapporterer til fabrikksjef og har tett samarbeid med øvrige tekniske funksjoner og produksjon.


Dine ansvarsområder

Du får en sentral rolle i den daglige driften og i den videre utviklingen av vedlikeholdsarbeidet. Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være å:

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre vedlikehold av vårt produksjonsutstyr

  • Utvikle struktur og systematikk rundt preventivt vedlikehold

  • Bistå på produksjonslinjene ved problemer og bidra til å sikre stabil drift

  • Bidra til forbedringsarbeid og optimalisering av prosesser

  • Følge opp vedlikeholdsaktiviteter og sikre fremdrift i planlagte tiltak

  • Lære opp ansatte i operatørstyrt vedlikehold og bidra til å bygge kompetanse i produksjonen

  • Samarbeide tett med produksjon og øvrige tekniske funksjoner om løsninger og forbedringer


Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

Vi søker deg som har en sterk teknisk forståelse og som trives i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker, maskiner og produksjon.

Du liker å skape struktur, men er samtidig handlekraftig når situasjonen krever det. Du tar initiativ, følger opp og motiveres av å finne løsninger som bidrar til bedre drift og høyere produktivitet.

Vi ser gjerne at du:

  • Har teknisk utdanning og erfaring fra industrielt vedlikehold

  • Har erfaring med planlegging og oppfølging av vedlikehold, struktur og systemer

  • Har erfaring med preventivt vedlikehold og forbedringsarbeid

  • Trives i et operativt produksjonsmiljø og liker å være tett på driften

  • Arbeider strukturert og selvstendig og tar eierskap til dine ansvarsområder

  • Har forståelse for at maskiner og mennesker er like viktige


Hvorfor velge Isbjørn Is AS?

  • Vi har blitt en del av verdens nest største iskremprodusent, Froneri, og vi har en ambisiøs vekststrategi, der fabrikken på Follese skal utvikles videre

  • Froneri er en global produsent og markedsleder av iskrem, med en visjon om å bli verdens beste iskremselskap

  • Froneri har en unik forretningsmodell basert på en kultur for <<excellence>>

  • Du får en nyopprettet rolle med mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi videreutvikler vedlikeholdsarbeidet på fabrikken

  • Vi legger til rette for utvikling og læring gjennom samarbeid med andre fabrikker i Froneri

  • Vi tilbyr gode betingelser


Praktisk

Arbeidssted: Follese, Askøy

Ansettelsesform: Fast

Søknadsfrist: Snarest mulig -- søkere vurderes fortløpende


Spørsmål til stillingen?

Har du spørsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte fabrikksjef Roar Moss på telefon 917 15 442 eller e-post roar.moss@isbjornis.no.


Ønsker du å søke stillingen, sender du inn din søknad via søknadslinken.

Søkere vurderes fortløpende, så vi oppfordrer deg til å søke så snart som mulig.

Mer informasjon om selskapene finner du på Froneri.com og Isbjornis.no.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi mener vi har Norges koseligste jobb!

I Den Norske Isbilen tror vi på å skape glede, både på arbeidsplassen og ute hos kundene våre.

Vi tror at varierte og inkluderende team gjør at alle føler seg velkomne på arbeidsplassen. Derfor tilbyr vi alt fra sommerjobber til faste stillinger, om du er ung eller godt voksen spiller ingen rolle, så lenge du ønsker å jobbe med is og glede. Vi er stolte over at hos oss starter noen karriere sin, og andre starter den på nytt etter mange år i arbeidslivet.


Få en pangstart for karrieren din

I 30 år har Den Norske Isbilen appellert til både barn og voksne i hele Norge. Når lyden av <<Norge rundt>> høres i gaten, vekkes lysten på is hos store og små.

Nå kan det være deg vi ser etter. Hos Isbilen søker vi selgere til godt betalte jobber, slik at vår kvalitets-is kan bringes til norske hjem.

Vi våger å kalle det en av Norges koseligste jobber.

jobs.title: Elektriker/automatiker med mekanisk interesse
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en variert og selvstendig hverdag hvor du jobber tett på avansert teknisk utstyr? Vil du utvikle deg faglig i et solid selskap med gode karrieremuligheter? Da kan dette være rollen for deg, søk i dag!

Arbeidsområdet vil være Stavangerregionen.

Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer:

  • Montasje og sertifisering av nye og eksisterende installasjoner

  • Feilsøking på mekaniske, elektriske og automasjonsrelaterte systemer

  • Arbeid i høyden, ofte ved bruk av lift

  • En aktiv rolle i å sikre trygg og effektiv drift hos industrikunder

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du har:

  • Fagbrev som elektriker, automatiker, industrimekaniker eller tilsvarende

  • Erfaring fra industrioppdrag og oppfølging av kunder

KIS Gruppen er markedsleder i Norge innen kontroll og vedlikehold av kraner, løfteutstyr og industriell opplæring. jobs.title: Handy medarbeider søkes – fleksibel arbeidstid og stor frihet
jobs.description:
Handy medarbeider søkes – fleksibel arbeidstid og stor frihet

Alt innen og rundt det som er å oppgrader, vedlikehold av bruktoboliger.

Hva vi ser etter

Handy medarbeider søkes -- fleksibel arbeidstid og stor frihet- god arebeidmoral. Alt innen vedlikehold av eiendom.

Arbeidsoppgaver Handy medarbeider søkes -- fleksibel arbeidstid og stor frihet

Jeg søker en praktisk og arbeidsvillig person til varierte oppgaver innen enkel oppgradering og vedlikehold av boliger.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere og kan blant annet være maling, legging av gulv, montering av panel og lister, enklere snekkerarbeid, noe flislegging og andre praktiske oppgaver som dukker opp i forbindelse med oppussing av boliger.

Det viktigste for meg er ikke at du er faglært eller bruker unødvendig lang tid på hver minste detalj. Du må være handy, like å jobbe og være opptatt av å få oppgavene gjennomført på en god og effektiv måte.

Stillingen passer godt for deg som liker frihet under ansvar. Du får oppgavene dine og styrer i stor grad arbeidsdagen selv. Om du ønsker å jobbe tidlig, sent eller enkelte dager mer enn andre, spiller mindre rolle -- så lenge avtalte jobber blir gjennomført innen fristen.

Du må være selvstendig og pliktoppfyllende, ha førerkort, og kunne dra og handle maling, byggevarer og annet materiell selv når det er nødvendig.

Stillingen kan tilpasses fra ca. 30--100 %, og det er gode muligheter for fleksibilitet og avtalte friperioder.

Kort sagt søker jeg en person som ser hva som må gjøres, tar ansvar og får jobben gjort -- uten behov for at noen følger opp hele tiden.

Vi tilbyr Frihet under ansvar -- varierte arbeidsdager

Her får du stor frihet under eget ansvar. Ingen dager eller oppgaver er helt like, og du har ikke et fast arbeidssted du møter opp på hver dag.

Oppdragene er hovedsakelig i Tønsberg, Nøtterøy og Sandefjord, så det er en fordel at du bor i eller i nærheten av disse områdene.

Jeg ser først og fremst etter en person med god arbeidsmoral, som liker å stå på og som kan jobbe selvstendig. Du må kunne få en oppgave og ta ansvar for å gjennomføre den uten behov for tett oppfølging.

Oppgavene er i utgangspunktet ikke kompliserte. Det viktigste er at du tar tak, finner løsninger og får jobben gjort. Det er også rom for å gjøre feil underve

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er en bedrift som jobber bredt innen eiendom. Vi driver med utleie og forvaltning av boliger, kjøp og oppgradering av brukte boliger, samt utvikling og bygging av nye boliger.

Det betyr at arbeidsoppgavene er varierte. Det kan være alt fra mindre vedlikehold og klargjøring av utleieboliger til oppussing, maling, gulvlegging, panel, enklere snekkerarbeid og arbeid på nye boligprosjekter.

Vi har flere eiendommer og prosjekter i Tønsberg, Nøtterøy og Sandefjord, og arbeidsstedet vil derfor variere fra oppdrag til oppdrag.

jobs.description:
Vil du bruke salgserfaringen din til å hjelpe virksomheter med å finne folkene de trenger? AllCare søker en telefonsterk B2B-selger i Stavanger. Du jobber fra hjemmekontor, med prioriterte leads og ansvar fra første samtale til signert avtale.

Dette selger du

Du tilbyr rekrutteringstjenester til virksomheter med konkrete bemanningsbehov. Gjennom telefon og oppfølging avklarer du behovet, presenterer AllCares løsning og følger kunden frem til en beslutning. Du får bruke både evnen til å åpne dører og ferdighetene som skal til for å lande en avtale.

Dette får du hos oss

  • Prioriterte leads fra virksomheter med aktive rekrutteringsbehov.

  • Tydelige prisrammer og ferdige tilbudsmaler.

  • Veiledning og løpende sparring om kundedialog og oppfølging.

  • Hjemmekontor og avtalt stillingsomfang på 20--60 %.

Du får et konkret utgangspunkt for salgsarbeidet, samtidig som du selv tar ansvar for aktivitet, fremdrift og resultater. Arbeidet foregår på dagtid i ukedagene, når kundene er tilgjengelige. Oppstart og omfang avtales med deg.

Hvem passer rollen for?

Du er trygg på utgående telefonsamtaler, stiller gode spørsmål og følger opp systematisk. Du tåler avslag, holder avtaler og trives med å arbeide selvstendig. Erfaring fra B2B-salg, forsikring, telekom eller annet telefonbasert salg er relevant. Du trenger ikke erfaring fra rekruttering.

Stillingen innebærer ordinær ansettelse i AllCare Solutions AS, med innmelding i Aa-registeret og lønn gjennom selskapets ordinære lønnssystem.

Søk med en kort søknad

Trykk <<Gå til søknad>> for å se hvordan rollen fungerer og lese lønnsmodellen før du søker. Fortell kort om salgserfaringen din, gjerne et konkret resultat, og hvor mye du ønsker å jobbe. Du trenger ikke skrive en tradisjonell søknad. Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

AllCare leverer rekruttering og bemanning innen helse og omsorg til private og offentlige virksomheter i hele Norge. Vi kombinerer målrettet kandidatsøk, grundig kvalifisering og tett oppfølging for å hjelpe kundene med å dekke kompetansebehov.

Vil du bruke salgserfaringen din til å hjelpe virksomheter med å finne folkene de trenger? AllCare søker en telefonsterk B2B-selger i Oslo. Du jobber fra hjemmekontor, med prioriterte leads og ansvar fra første samtale til signert avtale.

Du tilbyr rekrutteringstjenester til virksomheter med konkrete bemanningsbehov. Gjennom telefon og oppfølging avklarer du behovet, presenterer AllCares løsning og følger kunden frem til en beslutning. Du får bruke både evnen til å åpne dører og ferdighetene som skal til for å lande en avtale.

Du er trygg på utgående telefonsamtaler, stiller gode spørsmål og følger opp systematisk. Du tåler avslag, holder avtaler og trives med å arbeide selvstendig. Erfaring fra B2B-salg, forsikring, telekom eller annet telefonbasert salg er relevant. Du trenger ikke erfaring fra rekruttering.

Stillingen innebærer ordinær ansettelse i AllCare Solutions AS, med innmelding i Aa-registeret og lønn gjennom selskapets ordinære lønnssystem.

AllCare leverer rekruttering og bemanning innen helse og omsorg til private og offentlige virksomheter i hele Norge. Vi kombinerer målrettet kandidatsøk, grundig kvalifisering og tett oppfølging for å hjelpe kundene med å dekke kompetansebehov.

Hva vi ser etter

Ønsker du å jobbe i en liten og koselig familiebarnehage hvor du virkelig får tid til å se hvert enkelt barn?

Om jobben

Som assistent i Småvenner får du en viktig rolle i barnas hverdag. Fordi barnegruppen består av bare fire barn, får du gode muligheter til å bli godt kjent med hvert enkelt barn og følge deres utvikling, interesser og behov.

Du vil ha det daglige ansvaret i avdelingen og får jevnlig oppfølging og veiledning fra pedagogisk leder.

  • er trygg, varm og omsorgsfull

  • er ansvarsbevisst og selvstendig

  • liker å være aktiv og ute i all slags vær

  • tar initiativ og ser hva som trenger å gjøres

Arbeidsdagen består blant annet av lek og aktiviteter, måltider, stell, hvile, påkledning, turer og utelek. Vi ønsker at du er en voksen som er til stede sammen med barna, leker, snakker, synger, leser, utforsker og skaper gode opplevelser sammen med dem.

Vi tilbyr et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø, veiledning fra pedagogisk leder og mulighet til å utvikle deg i arbeidet med de aller minste.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Småvenner familiebarnehage på Ullern søker en trygg, omsorgsfull og engasjert barnehageassistent til 100 % vikariat.

Småvenner er en liten familiebarnehage med kun fire barn i alderen 8 måneder til 3 år. Hos oss tror vi på at små barnegrupper og hjemmekoselige omgivelser gir de minste barna en trygg og rolig start på barnehagelivet.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst (Financial Crime & KYC)
jobs.description:
Role Overview:

Job Type - Fixed Term Contract - 6 months

Location: London (Hybrid)

We are seeking a Data Analyst (Financial Crime & KYC) to support Financial Crime Middle Office (FCMO) change initiatives within a leading global banking environment.

This role combines business analysis, project delivery, management information reporting, process improvement, and SQL-based data analysis. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting Financial Crime change programmes, enhancing MI reporting and data quality, documenting business processes, and ensuring regulatory and operational requirements are effectively implemented across the function.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Change Delivery

  • Support Financial Crime and bank-wide change initiatives from inception through implementation.

  • Gather, analyse, and document business requirements and translate them into clear process and operational solutions.

  • Produce current-state and future-state process documentation, process maps, and business requirements.

  • Assist in the identification, assessment, and delivery of change initiatives impacting Financial Crime operations.

  • Support project governance activities, stakeholder engagement, training delivery, and implementation activities.

  • Ensure procedures, controls, guidance documents, and training materials are updated following process or system changes.

Management Information (MI) & Reporting

  • Develop, automate, maintain, and enhance Management Information (MI) reporting capabilities.

  • Produce regular and ad-hoc management reports for operational teams, governance committees, and senior management.

  • Analyse reporting outputs to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.

  • Improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and data quality through automation and enhanced controls.

  • Deliver insightful data analysis to support business decision-making and operational performance monitoring.

SQL & Data Analysis

  • Write and execute SQL queries to extract, join, aggregate, and analyse data from multiple sources.

  • Support reporting and business initiatives through detailed data analysis.

  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and trend analysis activities.

  • Identify data quality issues and support root-cause investigations.

  • Utilise advanced Excel techniques to analyse large and complex datasets and generate meaningful insights.

Financial Crime Operations Support

  • Support Reverse KYC activities, including customer correspondence and record management.

  • Maintain accurate information and documentation relating to Financial Crime processes.

  • Assist with governance and control activities across Financial Crime operations.

  • Promote consistency of processes and reporting across EMEA teams and stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & Governance

  • Build strong relationships across Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Business functions.

  • Support governance forums through meeting coordination, documentation, and action tracking.

  • Communicate process changes, business requirements, and project updates to stakeholders at all levels.

  • Contribute to cross-regional collaboration and alignment of Financial Crime processes and controls.


Essential Skills & Experience

  1. Proven experience as a Business Analyst, MI Analyst, Change Analyst, or Project Analyst within Financial Services.

  2. Strong SQL skills with the ability to independently extract, join, aggregate, and analyse data.

  3. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including reporting, data analysis, and automation.

  4. Experience supporting business change, transformation, regulatory, or operational improvement initiatives.

  5. Strong requirements gathering, process documentation, and business analysis capabilities.

  6. Experience producing MI reporting and presenting insights to management stakeholders.

  7. Understanding of Financial Crime operations including KYC, CDD, and associated regulatory requirements.

  8. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

  9. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  10. High attention to detail with a strong governance and control mindset.

Desirable Experience

  1. Financial Crime Middle Office (FCMO) experience.

  2. Reverse KYC, KYC remediation, or client outreach programmes.

  3. Regulatory change or Financial Crime transformation programmes.

  4. Process improvement, automation, and reporting optimisation initiatives.

  5. Experience supporting governance committees and senior management reporting.

  6. Experience within investment banking, corporate banking, or international banking environments.

How We Work:  

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.  

This is a fixed-term position located in London. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. For this role, a valid working permit for the UK is mandatory.  

Expectations regarding hybrid working: As we are a Service Provider and Consulting firm servicing clients, our policy for physically working from the office (which may be the clients' offices or our own offices depending on the client) aligns to what our clients' policies and expectations are and these vary. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita require. 

Who We Are:  

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.  

Our 3 offerings are:  

  • Managed Services  

  • Consulting & Solutions  

  • Technology  

To know more about Delta Capita and our culture click here: Working at DC - Delta Capita.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Design Engineer
jobs.description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! 

We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Digital IC Design Engineer to join our growing design and development team in Edinburgh. You will work within our High-Performance Mixed-Signal R&D division, which develops industry-leading SoCs for global consumer markets. You will be part of an organisation operating at the forefront of cutting-edge technology.  

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and develop new digital circuit architectures from concept, architecture, design, design integration through to production on advanced process nodes including development of block level testbenches  
  • Collaborate with a team of engineers with responsibility for the delivery of complex mixed-signal products and IPs   
  • Contribute to technical reviews and ensure IP quality using checklists  
  • Influence the growth of the team through supervision of junior engineers  

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s, Master's or Doctorate degree in Electrical Engineering (or related discipline) with an extensive proven background in digital CMOS circuit design  
  • Implementation of complex digital circuits and sub-systems in RTL using Verilog / SystemVerilog  
  • Understanding of digital system-level design, including use of standard bus protocols, bus architecture design and chip-level clock and reset architectures  
  • Verification of block-level digital designs   
  • Understanding of synthesis and timing analysis of digital circuits  
  • Good interpersonal skills, share technical expertise and knowledge, contribute to design reviews, work optimally to resolve conflicts  
  • Organised, detailed, and meticulous with strong communication skills  
  • Self-motivated with strong analytical and problem-solving skills  
  • Ability to work with a sense of urgency and thrive in a dynamic environment   

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • An understanding, appreciation, and passion for mixed signal engineering   
  • Experience working within UVM based verification environments  
  • Scripting and automation of design tasks  
  • Experience with AMBA, SPI, I2C protocols   
  • Lab and silicon validation skills; Experience of chip bring-up and debug from design perspective  
  • Good understanding of Linting, CDC and RDC tools  
  • Collaboration with DFT and Place and Route teams  
  • Board level interface standards and interface design  
  • Experience with clock generation circuits and handling multiple clock domains  
  • Experience with Power gating and low power design techniques  
  • Experience with ARM, RISC-V, or similar microcontrollers as well as memory controllers  
  • DSP filter design using MATLAB and signal analysis techniques  
    • This position is based in our Edinburgh office. It is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work from home, depending on business needs. Candidates must live within a commutable distance or be willing to relocate. 
     
    #LI-PD1
    #LI-Hybrid

    Export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit candidates who are nationals of certain embargoed countries from working in this position without Cirrus Logic first obtaining an export license.  Candidates for this role must be able to access technical data without a requirement for an export license. We are unable to sponsor or obtain export licenses for this role.

    At Cirrus Logic, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and we are committed to encouraging an open and collaborative culture where different approaches, ideas, and points of view are respected and valued. We aim to promote a workplace where everyone can contribute irrespective of race, colour, national origin, religion or belief, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or disability.

jobs.title: Kock extra vid behov
jobs.description:
LR Borgen

Vem söker vi?
Nu söker vi en passionerad kock som vill arbeta i ett team där serviceanda och lagarbete står i centrum. Med nyfikenhet och entusiasm och lyhördhet skapar du smakfulla och vällagade rätter med fokus på hållbarhet.

Om rollen
I tjänsten ingår bland annat dagligt arbete med egenkontroll, att ha god kännedom om allergener.
Mottagning av varor samt egenkontroll.
Vara lösningsfokuserad.
Arbeta över gränserna, så som salladsberedning, disk, städning samt bemöta och hjälpa gästerna i matsalen.

Om enheten
Enheten är en dynamisk arbetsplats med engagerade kollegor som tillsammans skapar en välkomnande miljö för kundens medarbetare och besökare. Här arbetar vi nära kunden och utvecklar löpande vårt erbjudande utifrån verksamhetens behov, med fokus på kvalitet, engagemang och god service i varje möte. Som en del av teamet bidrar du till att leverera
professionella tjänster som förenklar vardagen, stärker arbetsplatsupplevelsen och gör skillnad för kunden varje dag.
LR Borgen är en helt unik arbetsplats i den speciella miljön vid Trängslet.
Vi serverar militärer alla dagar på året, sommar som vinter. Då vi är en lägerrestaurang så har vi varierade öppettider beroende på beläggning

Vem är du?
• Du är över 18 år
• Du har utbildning inom hottel och restaurang med kockinriktning eller motsvarande
• Du har erfarenhet av restaurangarbete sedan tidigare
• Du har en förmåga att planera och strukturera arbetet effektivt
• Du tar genom din passion ansvar för att hålla en hög service- och kvalitetsnivå.
• Du ser din betydelse i nöjda gäster, är positiv, stresstålig,flexibel och har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera
• Du kan ta egna initiativ och är flexibel i din yrkesroll
• Du talar och skriver svenska
• B-körkort samt bil

Rekryteringen sker löpande så varmt välkommen in med din ansökan idag! Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via webben, ansökningar som kommer in på annat sätt behandlas inte. För mer information om hur Compass Group AB behandlar dina personuppgifter besök compass-grou.se/integritetspolicy.

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Softwareentwicklung Go / IoT & Energy
jobs.description:
Du willst die Energiewende nicht nur diskutieren, sondern aktiv mit Code vorantreiben?

Wir bei init Energy entwickeln die smarte Logik für intelligente Energiemanagement-Systeme. Kurz gesagt schreiben wir Algorithmen, die Batteriespeicher, E-Autos, flexible Stromverbraucher und Erzeugungsanlagen so steuern, dass sie möglichst kosteneffizient und netzdienlich arbeiten.

Um unser Entwicklerteam zu unterstützen, suchen wir ein motiviertes Tech-Talent, das Lust hat, smarte Geräte mit unserer Software zu vernetzen! Du musst noch kein Go-Profi sein – wenn du Programmiererfahrung hast, geben wir dir die Zeit, die Sprache bei uns zu lernen. Wichtig ist, dass du gerne Dinge praktisch umsetzt und zuverlässig arbeitest.

Aufgaben

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) bist du voll ins Team integriert und unterstützt uns bei echten Kernaufgaben:

  • Geräte-Integration: Du hilfst uns dabei, verschiedenste Hardware-Komponenten (z. B. Wechselrichter, Wallboxen und Wärmepumpen) an unsere Go-Anwendung anzubinden.
  • Schnittstellen & Datenflüsse: Du arbeitest an APIs und sorgst dafür, dass die Kommunikation zwischen den Geräten und unserem System reibungslos läuft.
  • Testing & Weiterentwicklung: Du testest neue Funktionen direkt in der Praxis und entwickelst unseren bestehenden Code weiter.
  • Troubleshooting: Du analysierst Fehler, nimmst kleinere Anpassungen im Code vor und arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Team an cleveren technischen Lösungen.

Qualifikation

  • Du studierst Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einen vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang.
  • Du hast erste Programmiererfahrung und idealerweise schon mal mit Go (Golang) gearbeitet – oder du hast große Lust, Go bei uns zu lernen!
  • Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Spaß daran, Dinge nicht nur theoretisch zu planen, sondern direkt in der Praxis umzusetzen.
  • Bonus (kein Muss!): Du interessierst dich für vernetzte Systeme (IoT) oder Energietechnik.

Benefits

Echter Impact & Praxisnähe: Keine Theorie-Projekte für die Schublade. Du arbeitest an echten Produkten im spannenden Zukunftsthema der intelligenten Energienetze.

Team & Verantwortung: Ein kleines, motiviertes Team, in dem du von Tag 1 an Verantwortung übernehmen und unglaublich viel dazulernen kannst.

Maximale Flexibilität: Wir wissen, dass dein Studium vorgeht. Deine Arbeitszeiten passen wir flexibel an deinen Vorlesungsplan an.

Klingt spannend?
Dann schick uns einfach eine kurze Nachricht mit deinem CV oder deinem LinkedIn. Ein langes Anschreiben brauchst du nicht!

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate (Denver, CO)
Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) - IT Infrastructure Services
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven IT Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have a direct influence on our success.

As an IT Infrastructure Engineer, you lead the efforts of maintaining and improving our global identity and access management platform as a coherent set of highly available services following our cloud-focused strategy. It is your responsibility to identify improvement opportunities, drive identity projects, and build a unified, scalable environment.

Based in Germany and the US, our IT Infrastructure Services team designs, implements, and manages global cloud and on-premises infrastructure solutions to provide Flix with internal business services such as identity and access management, security and compliance configuration, communication tools, file sharing, 3rd-level support, and infrastructure consulting.

About the Role

  • Integrate new internal and external applications into our identity infrastructure (e.g., SSO) following best practices
  • Work on projects to improve internal role-based access control concepts
  • Consult other teams and guide them to success, leveraging our services especially regarding identity and access management
  • Drive innovation and improve our services together with the team
  • Automate recurring tasks
  • Design the future IT infrastructure of Flix

About You

  • At least 3 years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID or similar identity and access management platforms
  • Advanced knowledge of modern authentication protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and SAML)
  • At least 3 years of scripting experience (ideally with Python)
  • At least 1 year of experience with IaC solutions (preferably Terraform)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to streamline infrastructure automation, troubleshooting, and daily operations
  • Basic experience using APIs
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus
  • Experience working with IaaS solutions is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React) or web technologies is a plus
  • Experience with M365 products (such as Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams) is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot) to join our Shopping team in Berlin. At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in helping us to let our consumers maximize value for their money by providing a world-class shopping rewards experience online and in-store, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Design and develop modern architectures using Java, AWS technologies, microservices, NoSQL & RDBMS, event-driven architectures, etc.
  • Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap.
  • Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
  • Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with 6+ years of experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side.
  • Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot.
  • Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems.
  • Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular.
  • Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts.
  • Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns.
  • Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for delivering clean code, unit/integration tests and maintainable documentation.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to support and mentor more junior members of a software development team.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
#LI-AK1

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.
