jobs.title: Lønbogholder til barselsvikariat – deltid
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med lønadministration, sans for detaljer og trives du med at være den, kollegaerne går til, når de har spørgsmål til løn og overenskomster?

Så kan det være dig, vi søger til et barselsvikariat i en veletableret produktionsvirksomhed i Langeskov.

 

Vi søger en lønbogholder på deltid, som kan blive en del af økonomifunktionen og være med til at sikre en korrekt og effektiv lønadministration for virksomhedens medarbejdere.

 

Om jobbet

Som lønbogholder får du en central rolle i virksomhedens lønteam, hvor du sammen med en lønbogholderkollega får ansvaret for den daglige lønadministration.

Du bliver en del af økonomiafdelingen, som består af ca. 8 medarbejdere inden for bogholderi og controlling, og du vil referere til Finance Manager.

Stillingen har en bred kontaktflade, og du kommer til at samarbejde med forskellige afdelinger i organisationen. Du bliver samtidig en del af en supportfunktion, hvor du bidrager med specialistviden inden for løn og hjælper kollegaer med at finde løsninger på løn- og overenskomstrelaterede spørgsmål.

 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Lønkørsel for timelønnede og funktionærer i lønsystemet Lessor

  • Registrering og bogføring af timer i ERP-system

  • Lønafregning og lønafstemning

  • Vedligeholdelse af stamdata

  • Sikre korrekt håndtering af overenskomster samt vejlede organisationen om løn- og overenskomstspørgsmål

  • Håndtering af refusionsansøgninger

  • Diverse indberetninger til Danmarks Statistik, pensionsselskaber og myndigheder

  • Ajourføring af lønrelaterede statistikker

  • Ad hoc-opgaver samt mulighed for at bidrage til øvrige opgaver inden for økonomi, HR og reception

 

Din profil

Vi søger dig, som har erfaring med lønadministration og gerne har arbejdet med ERP- og lønsystemer.

Du arbejder struktureret og grundigt og har en naturlig sans for detaljer. Du forstår vigtigheden af, at løndata er korrekte hele vejen gennem processen, og du tager ansvar for, at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs.

Da lønfunktionen har en bred kontaktflade i organisationen, er det samtidig vigtigt, at du har gode kommunikative evner. Du trives med at hjælpe og vejlede dine kollegaer og kan formidle regler og komplekse problemstillinger på en letforståelig måde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med lønadministration

  • Har kendskab til Lessor eller et tilsvarende lønsystem

  • Har erfaring med ERP-systemer

  • Har arbejdet med overenskomster

  • Er struktureret og detaljeorienteret

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og ansvarsbevidst

  • Trives med en bred kontaktflade og med at yde intern support

 

Virksomheden tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en solid og veletableret produktionsvirksomhed med base i

Langeskov, tæt på motorvejen.

 

Virksomheden tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Et spændende og alsidigt barselsvikariat

  • Deltidsansættelse

  • Fleksible arbejdstider

  • Mulighed for delvist hjemmearbejde efter endt oplæring

  • Sundhedssikring

  • Kantineordning

  • Aktiv personale- og idrætsforening

  • Fritvalgskonto

  • Feriefridage

  • Bonusordning baseret på virksomhedens samlede omsætningsmål

 

Om virksomheden

Virksomheden er en veletableret aktør i den nordeuropæiske stålbranche og har mere end 400 medarbejdere samt omfattende produktionsfaciliteter.

Virksomheden arbejder med kundetilpassede løsninger og har et stærkt fokus på medarbejdernes engagement og trivsel. Samtidig er bæredygtighed og den grønne omstilling centrale fokusområder, hvor stålets muligheder for genanvendelse spiller en væsentlig rolle.

Du bliver en del af en organisation, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og ansvarlighed er en naturlig del af hverdagen, og hvor økonomifunktionen spiller en vigtig rolle i at understøtte resten af organisationen.

 

Ansøgning:

Matcher ovenstående dine kvalifikationer, hører vi meget gerne fra dig. Send en ansøgning og CV på mail@vkconsulting.dk. Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når rette match er fundet. Ved evt. spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til VKCONSULTING på tlf. 70201512 alle hverdage. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

 

Bemærk, alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt og med stor diskretion. Med henvisning til reglerne omkring GDPR modtages ansøgninger kun via linket i stillingsannoncen. Kan du ikke uploade din ansøgning via ansøgningsknappen, bedes du kontakte os. Vores annonce bliver automatisk og løbende fornyet på jobportalerne, indtil stillingen er besat. En fornyelse af et stillingsopslag er dermed ikke et udtryk for genopslag, men blot en automatisk fornyelse af annoncen.

jobs.title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service

• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

As soon as possible / by agreement.

Please send

Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar

jobs.title: Asiakaspalvelupäällikkö, Antell Gateway, Vantaa
jobs.description:
Haemme lounasravintolaamme iloista, ratkaisukeskeistä ja aurinkoisen asiakaspalvelutaidon omaavaa Asiakaspalvelupäällikköä.

Haemme tehtävään moniosaajaa, jolla on vahva ammattitaito ja ymmärrys sekä keittiön että salin toiminnoista. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat asiakaspalvelu, salaattien ja lämpimien lisäkkeiden valmistaminen, vitriini- ja salaattituotteiden valmistamista, kassatyöskentelyä, astiahuoltoa, inventointia, raaka-aineiden tilaamista ja sekä muita ravintoloan yleisiä tehtäviä. Työskentelet toimipisteessä yksin.

Toivomme, että sinulla on tehtävään sopiva koulutus ja vahva kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä. Odotamme, että olet asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntihenkinen, ja haluat olla mukana kehittämässä ravintolan toimintaa ja palvelua.

Sinulla löytyy intohimoa ja näkemystä hyvän ruoan ja palvelun tekemiseen sekä asiakaslähtöistä että taloudellista ajattelutapaa. Sinulla on myös loistavat vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot asiakkaiden kanssa toimimiseen. Sinulla on hyvä paineensietokyky, ja olet tottunut työskentelemään nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa, kiireenkin keskellä. Pystyt kommunikoimaan asiakkaiden kanssa sujuvasti suomen ja englannin kielellä. Keittiötuntemus katsotaan eduksi. Edellytämme hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työtehtävän, ja saat tueksesi lämminhenkisen ja välittävän työyhteisön. Innostumme teknologioista, jotka auttavat arjessamme, joten saat ammattitaitosi rinnalle myös nykyaikaiset työkalut. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi.

Lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:

- monipuolisen päivätyön herkullisia makunautintoja hakevien asiakkaiden parissa
- osaamisen ja tehtävänmukaisen palkan, palkitsemme myös onnistumisista
- liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hierontaedun
- lakisääteistä laajemman työterveyshuollon 24/7
- työvaatteet ja työkenkätuen
- mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan kehittymiseen ja koulutuksiin

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa aluepäällikkö, yhteystiedot löydät ilmoituksen alaosasta.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä meille hakemuksesi sekä ansioluettelosi. Huomioithan, että aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Antell tekee aidosti hyvää! Antell tarjoaa herkullisia makunautintoja noin 60:ssä lounas- ja henkilöstöravintolassa ympäri Suomen. Arjen iloisten lounashetkien lisäksi tarjoamme asiakkaillemme ihania makuja ja elämyksiä kokouksissa ja muissa tilaisuuksissa. Haluamme olla mukana rakentamassa asiakkaidemme hyvinvointia. Osaamisemme ytimessä on monipuolinen, hyvää tekevä ja herkullinen ruoka. Syyskuusta alkaen olemme osa Sodexo-konsernia.

You will play a key role in identifying new business opportunities, managing the full sales cycle, and positioning our solutions effectively in the market. Strong network of C-level contacts within the gaming or gambling sector

Proven experience within Nordic iGaming markets, either in B2B sales/account management or a commercial B2C role

Demonstrated experience in developing and executing regional or global sales strategies

Solid understanding of marketing principles

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, complex, and evolving environment

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

Self-driven with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

Highly motivated with the ability to influence and inspire others

Hands-on, proactive approach with a strong sense of ownership

jobs.title: IT Service Manager to an international energy company, Espoo
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will work at the intersection of business operations and IT, taking end-to-end ownership of a portfolio of digital services and applications supporting large-scale hydropower operations. You will act as a crucial link between business stakeholders, architects, internal delivery teams, and external suppliers, ensuring that IT services remain secure, cost-efficient, reliable, and continuously evolving.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with a strong possibility of extension. The position offers a flexible hybrid work model (2–3 days a week at the office) and is based in Espoo. Occasional travel within the Nordic countries is expected.

We offer:
- High-impact ownership: Direct end-to-end responsibility for digital services supporting critical hydropower infrastructure
- Professional growth: A supportive, expert community where you are trusted to challenge yourself and develop your skills
- Hybrid work model: Flexibility to combine remote work with office presence (2–3 days a week at Espoo office)

Work tasks
- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of a portfolio of Hydro IT services and applications
- Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, translating operational needs into clear service roadmaps and action plans
- Drive service performance, availability, cybersecurity, compliance, and user experience
- Lead supplier collaboration, overseeing service quality, vendor commitments, contracts, and costs
- Prioritize development initiatives in close alignment with business owners, architects, and delivery teams
- Ensure all services align with internal IT service management standards, architecture principles, and continuity requirements

We are looking for

- A relevant academic background (Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field)
- Solid experience in IT service management, application management, or digital service delivery
- Good understanding of ITIL practices, agile development, and the lifecycle of business-critical applications
- Practical experience in supplier management, service governance, and cost tracking/budgeting
- Proactive, structured, and self-driven mindset with the confidence to take ownership of complex entities
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
- Full fluency in English (written and spoken)

It is considered a strong advantage if you have:
- Experience within the energy sector, operational technology (OT), or industrial digitalization
- Proficiency in Finnish or Swedish

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
We are always on the lookout for a talent with a growth mindset – are you the one?
Are you looking for new challenges and an opportunity to utilize your excellent problem-solving skills? Join our dynamic team of awesome professionals at Catalyst Systems, where we develop and manage world-class emission control solutions using selective catalytic reduction (SCR) for Wärtsilä engines. Our products reduce marine engine NOx emissions, enabling compliance with IMO Tier III standards and beyond.
We are seeking a Product Engineer to join our Catalyst Systems Products Technical Management team in Finland. The preferred location is Vaasa Finland, but Turku may also be considered. Please note that relocations costs and/or immigration support is not available for this position.
This position is an excellent opportunity for an early-career or mid-level engineer who wants to broaden their technical expertise and gain exposure to product management, technical documentation, customer support, and product development activities.

Your role and responsibilities:
* Product management and documentation.

* Create, maintain, and update product manuals and technical documentation.

* Collaborate with subject matter experts to gather and validate technical information.


Requirements for the position:
* B.Sc. or higher degree in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.

* Basic understanding of process and mechanical engineering principles.

* Experience in technical documentation and structured authoring environments (e.g., IXIA/IXIASOFT and familiarity with XML- or DITA-based documentation is an advantage.

* Familiarity with modern AI-powered tools and willingness to leverage them to improve efficiency in technical documentation, information management, and problem-solving.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Proactive, systematic, and organized approach to work.

* Strong communication and customer orientation skills.


Considered an advantage:
* Proficiency in Finnish and/or Swedish.

* Experience in the marine industry.

* Experience with SCR systems, other emission control solutions, and/or engines.

* Previous experience in technical support, product management, product engineering, or documentation-related roles.


Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact & next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadlinethrough our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

jobs.title: Service officeriksi Ivalon lentoasemalle
jobs.description:
Service Officeriksi talvisesonkiin Ivalon lentoasemalle

Erilainen työ kuin missään muualla – tule töihin Lapin lentoasemille!

Haemme tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavia määräaikaisia tuntityöntekijöitä Service Officer -tehtäviin Ivalon lentoasemalle talvisesonkiin. Työ sopii erinomaisesti lisäansioksi, opiskelujen oheen tai joustavaa työtä etsivälle.

Service Officerina toimit lentoaseman asiakaspalvelun etulinjassa. Työtehtäväsi painottuvat matkustajien ohjaamiseen asematasolla ja lentoaseman ulkoalueilla, missä huolehdit matkustajien turvallisesta ja sujuvasta liikkumisesta lentokoneiden sekä terminaalin välillä. Työskentelet osana lentoaseman tiimiä kansainvälisessä ympäristössä ja kohtaat päivittäin matkustajia ympäri maailmaa.

Toivomme sinulta:

- Reipasta ja positiivista asennetta
- Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- Englannin kielen taitoa
- Valmiutta työskennellä ulkona vaihtelevissa sääolosuhteissa
- Joustavuutta työvuorojen suhteen
- Nuhteetonta taustaa
- Englannin tai suomenkielen osaamista

Aiempi kokemus ilmailualalta ei ole välttämätöntä, sillä perehdytämme sinut tehtävään.

Tehtävään sovelletaan lakia yksityisyyden suojasta työelämässä. Valitulta edellytetään hyväksytty huumausainetesti osana työhöntulotarkastusta.

Määräaikainen tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava työsopimus alkaa marraskuussa ja päättyy maaliskuussa 2027. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä ainutlaatuisessa kansainvälisessä lentoasemaympäristössä osana ammattitaitoista ja hyvähenkistä työyhteisöä. Ivalon talvisesongissa pääset kokemaan lentoliikenteen vilkkaimmat hetket aivan tapahtumien ytimessä.

Palkkauksessa noudatamme Airpron yrityskohtaista työehtosopimusta.

Hakuaika auki 27.9.2026 asti.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Jukka Arponen, jukka.arponen@rtggh.fi.

Airpro mahdollistaa matkasi tuottamalla ilmailualan palveluita Suomessa Helsingistä Ivaloon. Yli 30 vuoden kokemuksella ja 1500:n omistautuneen ilmailualan ammattilaisen voimin varmistamme, että lentoliikenne ja matkustajat liikkuvat turvallisesti ja luotettavasti vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Joustavuus ja avoimuus ohjaavat yhteistyötämme – kumppanimme voivat luottaa siihen, että toteutamme lupauksemme. Airpro Journey on lupauksemme elää arvojemme mukaisesti: kannustamme, toteutamme ja kehitymme. Olemme samalla rohkeita muuttumaan, kokeilemaan ja oppimaan. Yhdessä luomme merkityksellisiä hetkiä. Your journey is our destination.

Airpro on osa Finavia-konsernia.

Seuraa meitä Tiktokissa, Instagramissa, Facebookissa ja Youtubessa: @airproofficial.

Kiinnostaako sinua, miten rekrytointimme etenee tai kuinka voit aloittaa urasi lentoasemalla? Tutustu kaikkiin mahdollisuuksiin ja vinkkeihin nettisivuillamme.

In English:

Service Officers for the Winter Season at Ivalo Airport

A job unlike any other – join us at one of Lapland's busiest airports!

We are looking for fixed-term, on-call hourly employees to work as Service Officers at Ivalo Airport during the winter season. This position is ideal for students, those seeking additional income, or anyone looking for flexible work.

As a Service Officer, you will be on the front line of customer service at the airport. Your main responsibilities will focus on guiding passengers on the apron and other outdoor airport areas, ensuring safe and smooth movement between the terminal and aircraft. You will work as part of the airport team in an international environment and meet travellers from around the world every day.

What we are looking for:

- A positive and proactive attitude
- Good customer service and communication skills
- English language skills
- Willingness to work outdoors in varying weather conditions
- Flexibility regarding working hours and shifts

Previous experience in aviation is not required, as we will provide full training and induction for the role.

In accordance with the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life, the selected candidate must provide an approved drug test result as part of the pre-employment health examination.

The fixed-term employment contract, under which the employee will be called in to work as needed, will begin in November and expire in March 2027. We offer an opportunity to work in a unique international airport environment as part of a professional and supportive team. During the winter season, Ivalo Airport is full of energy, and you will experience the excitement of Lapland's busiest travel period right at the heart of the action.

Salary is based on Airpros company-specific collective agreement.

Please submit your application by 27 September 2026.

For further information, please contact: Jukka Arponen, jukka.arponen@rtggh.fi.

Airpro enables your journey by providing aviation services across Finland. With over three decades of experience and 1,500 dedicated airport professionals, we ensure air traffic and passengers move safely and reliably every day of the year. Flexibility and transparency guide how we collaborate, knowing our partners can trust us to deliver. The Airpro Journey is our promise to live our values—We Cheer, We Deliver, We Grow—while being brave enough to change, to try, and to learn. Together, we deliver moments that matter. Your journey is our destination.

Airpro is part of Finavia Group.

Follow us on [Tiktok](https://www.tiktok.com/@airproofficial), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/airproofficial/), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/people/Airpro/61581464677417/) and [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@airproofficial).

Curious about our recruitment process or how to start your career at the airport? Discover the opportunities and steps on our website.

Through our values, we are committed to promoting equality and equal treatment, and to building an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to participate and be heard. We welcome people from all backgrounds to apply to become part of the Airpro team and join us on our shared journey. We stand firmly for fairness and respect, and we do not tolerate discrimination.

jobs.title: Vaski Group: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
**Työsopimuksen tyyppi:** vakituinen, kokoaikainen

**Sijainti:** Varastokatu 8, 05800 Hyvinkää

**Hakuaika päättyy:** 11.10.2026

Vaski Group etsii nyt kunnianhimoista **Regional Sales Manageria** rooliin, jossa pääset kehittämään asiakkuuksia, voittamaan uusia projekteja ja rakentamaan kasvua kansainvälisesti kehittyvässä teollisuuskonsernissa.

Vaski Group on nopeasti kasvava teollisten työstökoneiden valmistaja, joka on erikoistunut virtakiskomateriaalien (busbar) työstökoneisiin ja ohutlevyn työstöön tarkoitettujen tuotantolinjojen sekä isojen särmäyspuristimien myyntiin.

**Mitä tulet tekemään?**

Regional Sales Managerina toimit Vaski Groupin teollisuusasiakkaiden strategisena kumppanina ja vastaat myynnistä kokonaisvaltaisesti ensikontaktista aina toimitukseen saakka. Hankit aktiivisesti uusia asiakkuuksia, kehität olemassa olevia asiakassuhteita ja rakennat pitkäjänteisiä kumppanuuksia niin kotimaisten kuin myös kansainvälisten teollisuusyritysten kanssa.

Arjessasi työskentelet tiiviisti kentällä asiakkaiden tuotantoympäristöissä ja perehdyt syvällisesti heidän prosessein sekä tuotannon haasteisiin. Teet perusteellisia tarvekartoituksia, tunnistat kriittiset pullonkaulat ja muotoilet niiden pohjalta teknisesti kestävät, liiketoimintaa tukevat kokonaisratkaisut yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Työsi painottuu aluksi Suomen markkinaan ja kenttätyöhön asiakkaiden tehtailla, mutta vastuiden kasvaessa pääset mukaan kansainvälisiin asiakkuuksiin ja projekteihin nimetyllä alueella. Arjessa teet tiivistä yhteistyötä teknisen tuen ja myyntijohdon kanssa sekä seuraat aktiivisesti markkinaa ja investointitrendejä kehittääksesi omaa teknis-kaupallista osaamistasi.

**Millaista osaajaa etsimme?**

Olitpa myyntiurasi alkupuolella tai jo kokenut myyjä, jos sinulla on nälkää ja intohimoa asiakastyöhön, saatat olla etsimämme tekijä. Nautit aidosti myyntityöstä, jossa asiat eivät tipu syliin, vaan ne rakennetaan aktiivisesti: tartut puhelimeen, viet keskusteluja eteenpäin ja uskallat haastaa sekä auttaa asiakasta kohti parempia ratkaisuja.

Sinulla on korkea työmoraali ja selkeä omistajuus omasta tekemisestä. Viet asiat pitkäjänteisesti maaliin etkä tyydy puolivalmiisiin lopputuloksiin. Yhdistät liiketoiminnallisen ajattelun ja teknisen ymmärryksen käytännön myyntityössä ja toimit luontevasti osana tiimiä, säilyttäen samalla vahvan oman draivisi.

**Hakijalta odotetaan:**

- Vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemusta teknisestä B2B-myynnistä

- Osaamista CRM-järjestelmien erityisesti Hubspotin hyödyntämisestä myyntityössä

- Kykyä viedä pitkiä myyntisyklejä ja asiakasneuvotteluja itsenäisesti päätökseen myös kansainvälisessä ympäristössä

- Sinnikkyyttä, uteliaisuutta ja kunnianhimoista asennetta myyntityötä kohtaan

- Intohimoa asiakastyöhön sekä proaktiivista ja oma-aloitteista otetta

- Matkustusvalmiutta

- Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


**Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:**

- Kokemus kansainvälisestä myyntityöstä

- Kokemus investointihyödykkeiden myynnistä erityisesti teollisuuden koneista tai tuotantolinjaratkaisuista

- Ruotsin kielen osaaminen


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Vakaan, nopeasti kasvavan ja kansainvälisen työnantajan, joka toimii alansa edelläkävijänä ja tarjoaa mahdollisuuden työskennellä teknisesti vaativien huipputuotteiden parissa

- Vastuullisen ja itsenäisen myyntiroolin, jossa pääset toimimaan asiakkaiden strategisena kumppanina sekä kasvamaan ja kehittymään itse ratkaisumyynnin ammattilaisena

- Asiantuntevan tiimin tuen, jossa luottamus, tekemisen meininki ja pitkäjänteisyys näkyvät arjessa

- Kasvuyhtiömäisen ja start up -henkisen ympäristön, jossa sinulla on tilaa vaikuttaa ja rakentaa toimintaa kasvun mukana

- Kattavan etupaketin, joka sisältää sairauskulu-, matka- sekä työ- ja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutukset, hyvinvointi-, lounas- sekä puhelinedun


**Käytännön asiat:**

Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme Vaski Groupin palvelukseen. Perehdytys tehtävään tapahtuu pääosin Hyvinkään toimipisteellä, minkä jälkeen työskentely on joustavaa ja pitkälti itsenäistä. Työtä voi tehdä sieltä käsin, missä se parhaiten sujuu, kunhan sinulla on valmius matkustaa tarpeen mukaan Vaskin toimipisteille tai asiakkaille Suomessa ja ulkomailla.

Tehtävässä aloitus on viimeistään tammikuun 2027 alussa.

**Rekrytointiprosessin kulku:**

- Su 11.10. hakuaika tehtävään päättyy

- Rekrytoiva esihenkilö **Mikko Fiskaali** (Sales & Marketing Director, Vaski Group) tavattavissa Alihankintamessuilla Tampereella 29.9. - 1.10.2026 välisenä aikana, mikäli haluat lyhyesti esittäytyä ja esittää kysymyksiä tehtävään liittyen

- Vko 42-43 aikana aTalentin ensimmäisen vaiheen videohaastattelut

- Vko 44 lähtien Vaski Groupin ensimmäisen kierroksen haastattelut jatkoon kutsuttujen ehdokkaiden kanssa

- Vko 45 lähtien Vaski Groupin toisen kierroksen haastattelut ja tämän jälkeen rekrytointipäätökset


**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Vaski Groupin globaalia kasvutarinaa!**

Lähetä ansioluettelosi sekä motivaatiokirjeesi PDF-muodossa suomen kielellä viimeistään sunnuntain 11.10. aikana aTalentin hakujärjestelmän kautta osoitteessa: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/384820/create/.

Huomioithan, että emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse, vaan käsittelemme ainoastaan hakujärjestelmän kautta saapuneet hakemukset. Haluamme varmistaa, että kaikki hakijat voivat osallistua prosessiin tasavertaisesti ja huomioimme tarvittaessa yksilölliset esteettömyystarpeet. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten ethän jätä hakemista viime hetkeen.

**Yhteystiedot:**

Lue lisää Vaski Groupista ja muista avoimista työmahdollisuuksista osoitteessa: https://atalent.fi/en/vaski-group.

Rekrytoiva esihenkilö Mikko Fiskaali (Sales & Marketing Director) on tavoitettavissa tehtävää liittyvissä kysymyksissä hakuajan puitteissa **torstaisin 24.9., 1.10. ja 8.10. klo 15.00-17.00** välisenä aikana numerosta 050 3122 855 tai sähköpostitse mikko.fiskaali@vaski.com. Huomioithan, että soittoajat täyttyvät nopeasti.

Tehtävää ja hakuprosessia koskevissa kysymyksissä voit olla myös yhteydessä aTalentin Managing Recruitment Consultant Kiira Dahlströmiin (044 902 0238, kiira.dahlstrom@atalent.fi).

jobs.title: Construction - Contracts Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The main duties and responsibilities of the Contracts Manager are outlined as follows: Work as part of a team in the delivery of one or more projects at any one time, embracing the ethos of a “one team” culture. Ensure Health, Safety, Environmental & Sustainability standards, policies and procedures are always adhered to on-site. Instil a positive Health and Safety culture within the team in their thinking and actions. Work closely with all key stakeholders including clients, client representatives and third-party agencies. Ensure a positive experience for the client and their representatives instilling an ethos of collaboration and cooperation. Provide single point of contact to the client as the Contractors’ Representative for projects and instill confidence to the customer in your actions and ability to deliver projects for them successfully. Facilitate the co-ordination role of the PSDP for live projects with internal and external designers. Represent the company as PSCS on live sites within your remit and co-ordinate all required documentation to be present on-site and up to date. Conduct regular Health and Safety inspections on live sites as well as safety interventions instilling a leading-by-example culture. Ensure best practice programme management techniques are used such as Lean Construction and Last Planner. Monitor programme performance including risk and opportunities. Mitigate/reduce risk where possible and manage opportunities. Report on the monthly performance of your programme to the framework manager including performance against programme, budget and HSQE. Lead the team in the procurement of supplies and sub-contracts on time and within budget. Manage cashflow on projects and ensure interim payment applications are submitted on-time to the client. Build and promote industry-leading teams by providing training and mentoring of staff including setting out development plans for your team. Provide an active involvement in resource management and recruitment within your team as a hiring manager. Provide assistance, oversight and guidance from time to time on tendering opportunities for new upcoming projects. Present on project performance and any initiatives from time-to-time as may be required. Respond to and address any client and stakeholder complaints in a timely manner. Obtain client satisfaction surveys and provide any feedback on how to improve our client satisfaction. Seek to improve the project delivery process by providing lessons learned feedback and innovative solutions for adoption on future projects. Keep appraised of the latest standards and technology through continuous professional development (CPD). Other duties as required from time to time. Knowledge, Skills and Experience:

jobs.title: Construction - Process Hydraulic Design Engineer - Senior Position
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Main Duties and Responsibilities: Strategic Design Role This role is a technical delivery-focused position, operating with a high degree of autonomy while working under the direction of the Regional Process & Hydraulic Design Lead. The Senior Engineer is responsible for Coordinate and deliver defined packages of work, coordinating with other disciplines, and supporting intermediate level and junior engineers. Develop high-impact design initiatives that enhance project outcomes and organisational capability. Establish and refine consistent, efficient, and high-quality design workflows across all projects. Line Management & Talent Development Mentor, coach, and develop engineers and designers at all levels, enhancing technical capability, decision-making, and leadership skills. Provide effective line management to the design team, including performance management, and design task control. Promote a culture of innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement within the design function. Support coordination of design tasks within the design team, including supporting workload planning, and resource control. Support and collaborate engineers and designers at all levels enhancing technical capability, decision-making and informal mentoring to junior team members. Foster a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture that prioritises technical excellence, professional development and informal mentoring to junior team members. Technical Design, Engineering & Equipment Assessment Oversee and develop detailed technical assessments of process and mechanical equipment, ensuring appropriate specification, performance, and integration into system designs. Manage of technical interfaces across MEICA disciplines, coordinating input from Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Control & Automation teams to produce fully integrated, clash-free design solutions. Work closely with ACC (Advanced Control & Communications) teams to develop intelligent, data-rich P&IDs and ensure accurate control-system integration within the design. Develop and review process and hydraulic calculations across chemical, physical, and biological treatment processes. Produce and review technical deliverables, including: Process & Mechanical Design Reports Concept site Layouts Intelligent P&IDs and PFDs Equipment selection and specifications Whole Life Cost Assessments Hydraulic & process calculations Hydraulic Profiles Energy balances Control philosophies and automation logic inputs Motor & Instrument Lists Constructability Assessments Construction Sequence Narratives Process Impact Plans (PIPs) Interface Registers and Decision Logs Development of efficient, safe, and future-proofed site layouts, ensuring adequate space planning, operability, maintainability, and construction access.

jobs.description:

We are seeking a Design Lead for the Process & Hydraulic Engineering discipline for a regional role in the UK. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in delivering water and wastewater infrastructure projects from concept through to construction, commissioning, and operations. You will take ownership of developing robust engineering design solutions that meet client requirements and ensure successful project outcomes through to process commissioning. Working as part of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, you will operate within a collaborative “one-team” culture while actively developing your own technical skills and leadership experience. While your primary focus will be on Process, Mechanical, and Hydraulic Design, you will also engage with and manage inputs and deliverables from other engineering disciplines, including Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Control & Automation (MEICA), as well as civil and structural engineering. This role offers exposure to a broad range of multi-disciplinary engineering challenges, providing a strong platform for professional growth and career progression. You will also have the opportunity to develop client relationships, lead design discussions, and contribute to integrated, high-quality project delivery across all stages. Main Duties and Responsibilities: Strategic Design Leadership This role is a technical delivery-focused position, operating with a high degree of autonomy while working under the direction of the Head of Process & Hydraulic Engineering. The Process & Hydraulic Design Lead is responsible for Manage, Coordinate and deliver defined packages of work, coordinating with other disciplines at Regional level, and supporting Senior, intermediate level and junior engineers. Develop and maintain a coherent design vision aligned with business objectives and long-term strategic goals. Prioritise and lead high-impact design initiatives that enhance project outcomes and organisational capability. Establish and refine consistent, efficient, and high-quality design workflows across all projects. Promote a culture of innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement within the design function. Team Leadership, Line Management & Talent Development Provide effective line management to the design team, including workload planning, performance management, and resource allocation. Mentor, coach, and develop engineers and designers at all levels, enhancing technical capability, decision-making, and leadership skills. Identify skills gaps and deliver structured development plans to build a high-performing, multidisciplinary team. Foster a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture that prioritises technical excellence and professional development. Technical Design, Engineering & Equipment Assessment

jobs.title: Technical Standards Engineer
jobs.description:

The Technical Standards Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and controlling maintenance standards, procedures, and technical documentation that support safe, compliant, and efficient aircraft maintenance operations. Acting as a key link between operational teams, Safety, and Compliance functions, the role ensures that technical requirements are clearly communicated, consistently applied, and effectively managed across the organisation. The position also supports continuous improvement and key organisational change. Responsibilities • Assist in amendments of the organisation’s procedures and manuals (MOE, including the associated procedure(s)) with due consideration of EASA/UKCAA regulatory requirement and any other applicable regulatory requirements. • Responsible for assisting PAML Managers and Supervisors to complete effective root cause and corrective actions in relation to safety occurrences, information security events/vulnerabilities and findings raised as a result of compliance audits or internal reporting scheme output. • Responsible for compliance with and promotion of the Safety Policy and Objectives. • Assist in the timely closure of appropriate group containment and corrective actions because of safety occurrences, audit findings or information security events/vulnerabilities. • Responsible for standardising processes and procedures across all sites within PAML group and the wider Ryanair network. • Responsible for the assessment of alternative tools and management of technical documentation system • Responsible for the assessment of proposed C/S & S/S individuals and composition of the application for company approval to be reviewed and accepted by the Compliance Department. • Responsible for review of OJT applications in accordance with UK/EU Part 66 • Drive Continuous improvement within PAML group and PAML management of change process • Work in accordance with company manuals and procedures, including: - Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE) - Technical Standards Manual (TSM) - Safety Management Manual (SMM) • Navigate and utilize engineering systems including: - Boeing fleet technical documentation systems - Digital technical document libraries - Technical Services Query dashboards • Promote and apply human factors principles throughout all duties Key Skills & Competencies • Strong knowledge of aviation regulatory requirements (EASA/UK CAA Part 145 & Part CAMO) would be a distinct advantage • Attention to detail and high standards of documentation accuracy • Effective communication and problem-solving skills • Ability to work independently and as part of a team • Strong safety mindset and awareness of human factors Experience & Qualifications • Experience in aircraft maintenance or technical support environment • Knowledge of document control/revision in a technical/regulated environment • Familiarity with MyBoeingFleet, Microsoft Office • Knowledge and experience of using AMOS

jobs.title: HR Systems & Integration Specialist, Helsinki
jobs.description:
About the role

As an HR Systems & Integration Specialist, you will act as a vital bridge between IT, HR and the broader business. In this highly technical, hands-on role you will actively configure systems and manage integrations rather than just coordinating them, working closely with a supportive local and Nordic IT team.

You are offered
- A key role in shaping the future HR technology landscape during an exciting integration phase.
- Close collaboration with a supportive local and Nordic team.
- A flexible hybrid work model with 3 days in the office and 2 days remote.

Work tasks

As an HR Systems & Integration Specialist you work in a technical and hands-on role focused on managing, developing, and configuring the HR technology landscape, ensuring seamless system integrations and data flows across the organization.
- Own and develop the HR technology landscape, including architecture, integrations, workflows, and data flows.
- Ensure systems are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with business and technology strategies.
- Manage application lifecycle activities, including updates, testing, deployments, and operational reliability.
- Translate HR and business requirements into effective technical solutions.
- Drive data quality, integration governance, and compliance with security standards.
- Coordinate with vendors, developers, infrastructure, and security teams.
- Maintain technical documentation and architectural transparency.

We are looking for

- Degree in IT, HR systems, or a related field.

jobs.description:
Pispan kotihoidossa on asiakkaita noin 130 neljässä eri hoitotiimissä. Moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistä arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä. Kotihoidon tavoitteena on edistää asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaista perusturvallisuutta, kuntoutumista sekä arjessa selviytymistä.

Lähihoitajana teet tärkeää työtä kohdatessasi asiakkaan hänen omassa kodissaan ja mahdollistamalla hänen selviytymisensä arjessa. Työsi on itsenäistä, liikkuvaa ja päivät ovat erilaisia. Kotihoidossa tehtäviisi kuuluu mm. lääkehoito, kirjaaminen sekä muut monipuoliset ja ihmisläheiset hoito- ja hoivatyöt. Jokapäiväisessä käytössämme on myös työtä tukevaa teknologiaa, kuten lääkeautomaatteja ja kuvapuhelimia.

Miksi hakea meille?
Saat meillä hyvän perehdytyksen sekä tuen työkavereilta ja esihenkilöltä.
Pystyt vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi, jotta vapaa-ajan ja työn yhdistäminen olisi mutkatonta.
Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut kuten vuosittaisen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassilla, työnantajan lounasedun ja tyhy- sekä Virkisty Vapaalla ry:n toimintaa.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?
Olet nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja (sosiaalihuolto) tai perushoitaja.
Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea.
Sinulla on B-luokan ajokortti, auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Käytössämme on leasing-autoja ja sähköpyöriä helpottamaan kulkemista asiakaskohteidemme välillä.
Sinulla on LOVe - lääkehoidon verkkotesti suoritettuna hyväksytysti (LOVe LOP, PKV, KIPU1, GER 1). Tarvittaessa voit suorittaa lääkehoidon osaamisen myös työpaikalla, heti työsuhteen alussa.
Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta.

Aloitus tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian. Tehtävä on määräaikainen 31.12.2026 asti. Koeaika on puolet työsuhteen kestosta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Lisäksi suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Pispa on rempseä ja huumorilla höystetty tiimi, joka ottaa avoimesti vastaan uusia työntekijöitä. Jätä hakemuksesi Kuntarekryssä heti, haastattelemme jo hakuajalla!

jobs.title: POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
jobs.description:
POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
The University of Helsinki, Department of Chemistry, invites applications for a postdoctoral or doctoral researcher position in photocatalytic radical chemistry at the newly established Lahdenperä Group. Initially, the position is fixed-term for 12-months with a possibility of an extension.
Position description
The successful candidate will join an organic chemistry research group at the Department of Chemistry located at Kumpula campus. The research group aims to develop new concepts for controlling radical reactivity in photocatalytic transformations. The project focuses on the development of new approaches for controlling radical reactivity through hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) at surfaces and interfaces.
The project will involve:
* Development and optimisation of photocatalytic radical transformations
* Mechanistic studies of radical reactions and detailed investigation of HAT processes.
* Surface functionalization and interface chemistry.
* Design and synthesis of organic molecules.

The postdoctoral researcher will additionally be expected to contribute to the supervision of students and participate in future funding applications.
Requirements
Postdoctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a PhD degree in chemistry or a closely related field by the start of employment, or be close to completion of their doctoral studies.
Consideration will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:
* synthetic organic chemistry.
* photocatalysis, radical chemistry, hydrogen atom transfer processes.
* reaction mechanism studies.
* flow chemistry.

The successful candidate should demonstrate the ability to conduct independent research and publish scientific results in international peer-reviewed journals.
Doctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in chemistry or a closely related discipline that qualifies them for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki.
Previous experience in organic synthesis, photochemistry, catalysis or related experimental chemistry is advantageous but not required.
Selected candidates for the interview process will be required to provide a copy of their university transcript before interview date.
For both positions
We are looking for candidates who are:
* highly motivated and scientifically curious.
* willing to develop new experimental skills.
* persistent and independent in tackling challenging research questions.

Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.
Salary and benefits
The salary follows the salary system of University salary system and is based on the researcher's qualifications, experience, and stage of doctoral or postdoctoral career.
For postdoctoral researchers, the starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
For doctoral researcher the starting salary will be approximately 2600–2800 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to the University of Helsinki. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from different gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities to apply for the position. You can read about the accessibility and inclusivity of our university via this link.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* Curriculum vitae, including a publication list (if applicable).
* A concise motivation letter describing your research interests, relevant experience, reasons for applying and career plans. Please indicate your desired starting date in the application.
* Degree certificate (PhD for postdoctoral applicants; Master's degree for doctoral researcher applicants).

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
The deadline for applications is October 16th, 2026.
Ideally, the selected candidate will start as soon as possible, although flexibility in the starting date can be arranged. Regardless, candidates who are unable to start immediately are still encouraged to apply. The selected applicants will be given support to apply for available grants or fellowships.
Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until a suitable candidate is found. Interviews may start before closing date 16.10.2026.
Additional information
Further information about the position can be obtained from Dr. Antti Lahdenperä, antti.sk.lahdenpera@helsinki.fi.

jobs.title: Tilkaldevikar søges til Opholdsstedet SAFE
jobs.description:
Opholdsstedet SAFE søger engagerede og fagligt kompetente tilkaldevikarer til arbejdet med børn og unge i alderen 9–17 år.

SAFE er et privat børn- og ungehjem, hvor vi tilbyder en tryg, struktureret og udviklingsstøttende hverdag for børn og unge, som blandt andet kan have erfaringer med omsorgssvigt, traumer, skolevægring, social kontrol, relationsvanskeligheder eller andre belastende livsomstændigheder.

Vores mål er at skabe stabile og forudsigelige rammer, hvor børnene og de unge mødes med respekt, nærvær og tydelighed, og hvor deres ressourcer, udviklingsmuligheder og individuelle behov er i centrum.

Vi arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt fundament med blandt andet mentalisering, anerkendende relationsarbejde, LØFT og ADL. I hverdagen arbejder vi målrettet med relationer, struktur, skolegang, fritid, selvstændighed, følelsesmæssig udvikling og sociale kompetencer.

Vores børn og unge er som udgangspunkt ikke kendetegnet ved udadreagerende adfærd, men flere har behov for voksne, som kan være rolige, stabile og vedholdende i relationen. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan være en tydelig og omsorgsfuld voksen, som kan skabe tryghed uden at presse, og som kan bevare overblik i forskellige situationer.

Om arbejdet

Som tilkaldevikar bliver du en del af den daglige pædagogiske indsats og vil blandt andet skulle:

  • skabe trygge og stabile relationer til børnene og de unge

  • støtte den enkelte i hverdagsstruktur, skole, fritid og sociale relationer

  • arbejde målrettet med individuelle mål og delmål

  • deltage i aktiviteter, måltider og praktiske opgaver i huset

  • støtte børnene og de unge i ADL og udvikling af selvstændighed

  • arbejde mentaliserende og anerkendende i kontakten

  • dokumentere fagligt og præcist i vores journalsystem

  • samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse

  • følge husets faglige procedurer og pædagogiske retningslinjer.

Arbejdstiden kan ligge på både hverdage, aftener, nætter, weekender og helligdage. Der kan forekomme længere vagter afhængigt af husets behov.

Hvem søger vi?

Det er vigtigt for os, at du har en relevant faglig baggrund. Vi søger derfor primært dig, som er uddannet eller under uddannelse inden for det pædagogiske eller socialfaglige område, eksempelvis som:

  • pædagog

  • pædagogisk assistent

  • socialrådgiver

  • anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelse.

Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du har erfaring med eller kendskab til børn og unge, som har været udsat for omsorgssvigt, traumer eller andre sociale belastninger.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • kan arbejde relationsorienteret og professionelt

  • har ro, tålmodighed og tydelighed

  • kan arbejde struktureret og ansvarligt

  • kan følge aftaler, handleplaner og procedurer

  • kan indgå i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde

  • kan dokumentere fagligt og reflekteret

  • er fleksibel i forhold til vagter.

Introduktion og SAFE Akademiet

Som ny medarbejder eller vikar bliver du tilbudt et struktureret introduktions- og kompetenceforløb gennem vores eget SAFE Akademi.

SAFE Akademiet består af 8 faglige moduler, som skal sikre, at alle medarbejdere arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt grundlag og har kendskab til vores målgruppe, metoder, dokumentationskrav og arbejdsgange.

Inden din første introduktionsvagt skal du have gennemført og bestået de første to moduler. Herefter starter du med introduktions- og følgevagter, hvor du bliver introduceret til huset, børnene og de unge samt vores daglige pædagogiske praksis.

De resterende moduler skal gennemføres inden for en fastsat tidsfrist efter ansættelsen.

Den tid, du bruger på at gennemføre SAFE Akademiet, er betalt arbejdstid.

Vi tilbyder

Hos SAFE får du:

  • et meningsfuldt arbejde med børn og unge

  • en grundig introduktion til målgruppen og huset

  • kompetenceudvikling gennem SAFE Akademiet

  • betalt tid til gennemførelse af de faglige moduler

  • mulighed for løbende vagter

  • et fagligt miljø med fokus på udvikling, refleksion og samarbejde

  • mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel i børn og unges hverdag.

Ansættelsesproces

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale, og stillingerne besættes, når vi har fundet de rette profiler.

Som led i ansættelsesprocessen indhenter Opholdsstedet SAFE straffeattest og børneattest for alle medarbejdere, inden ansættelsen kan gennemføres.

Send gerne dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning, hvor du beskriver din uddannelsesbaggrund, relevante erfaring og motivation for at arbejde med vores målgruppe.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Population Genomics
jobs.description:
About the position

A 4-year position as PhD Research Fellow in Population Genomics is available at the Natural History Museum (NHM), University of Oslo. The 4-year fellowship includes 25% career-enhancing work, such as curation, teaching, supervision, research support and public outreach.

The project is supervised by Dr. Andrew Foote (NHM).
The PhD project will reconstruct the colonisation of high latitudes by North Atlantic killer whales (Orcinus orca), to better understand how populations responded to past climatic warming at the Pleistocene–Holocene transition. Range expansions and demographic change leave signatures in the genome, including changes in genetic diversity and in how genetic variation is distributed within and among populations. These signatures are not uniform along the genome, but depend on local genomic parameters such as mutation and recombination rate.

The candidate will quantify changes in genetic diversity and variation through time, and investigate how these patterns vary across the genome. The project will combine an existing dataset of approximately 200 contemporary genomes with a new time series of ancient killer whale genomes generated within the project. The tasks will include ancient DNA laboratory work, bioinformatic processing of Next Generation Sequencing data, and population genomic analyses, including demographic inference.
The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The selected candidate will be enrolled in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. Within two months of commencing the position, the candidate must submit a PhD agreement, including a plan for the required doctoral courses and a project description. For more information about the programme, see: http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/   


Qualifications / Requirments 

You must have:
•    An MSc degree in evolutionary biology, population genetics, bioinformatics, or a related field.
•    Research experience in population genetics or population genomics.
•    Experience with bioinformatic analysis of Next Generation Sequencing data, including command-line work in a high-performance computing environment.
•    Programming or scripting skills (e.g., R, Python, bash).
•    Excellent written and verbal communication ability in English. English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirement, see: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8 

Desirable qualifications (in ranked order):
•    Experience with ancient DNA laboratory work.
•    Experience with demographic inference, coalescent methods, or population genetic simulations.
•    Strong interest in evolutionary responses to past climate change

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows, according to the Norwegian educational system:
•    The average grade for courses included in the Bachelor's degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
•    The average grade for courses included in the Master's degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
•    The Master's thesis must have grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
See: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7 

The evaluation of applicants will focus on the following:
•    Relevance and quality of the MSc thesis
•    Relevance and quality of scientific publications (not necessarily expected at this level)
•    Grades at relevant university-level courses (population genetics, evolutionary biology, bioinformatics, statistics, programming, wet-lab molecular techniques)
•    The fit of the applicant's career plan, interests, and skills as formulated in the cover letter (see How to apply below)
•    Personal suitability (incl. collaborative skills) and motivation for the position
•    An interview, including a 15 minute presentation of your MSc thesis (only short-listed candidates)


What are we looking for in you?

•    Honesty and high standards for scientific integrity
•    Ability to give and receive scientific criticism in a constructive manner
•    A positive attitude and drive for learning skills, methods and theory
•    Ability to work in a structured manner, facilitating teamwork
•    Ability to prioritise and complete work tasks
•    Ability to work independently, as well as collaboratively in an international and interdisciplinary research environment
•    Careful and well-documented approach to laboratory and computational work

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


How to apply

The application must include (as separate and numbered documents):

1.    Cover letter with a statement of motivation and research interests
2.    CV summarizing education, positions and academic work, scientific publications, and other relevant experience
3.    Statement explaining how a PhD in population genomics will fit into the applicant’s career plan (max 1 page)
4.    Copies of educational certificates and transcripts of records (as a single PDF)
5.    Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
6.    Names and contact details of 2-3 references (i.e., name, affiliation, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number). The references will be contacted if necessary. Letters of recommendation are therefore not required.

Applicants should deliver the application with the requested attachments through our electronic recruiting system. Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge. Click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


We can offer you

•    Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development. 
•    Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
•    Onboarding program for new employees.
•    Good welfare schemes.
•    A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
•    Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse (SPK), which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
•    Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
•    Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow (position code 1017) in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund (SPK).


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway’s most comprehensive natural history collection. For almost 200 years, specimens of animals, fungi, plants, rocks, minerals and fossils have been collected, studied and preserved here. The museum is located at Økern and in the beautiful Botanical Garden, which is not only popular for recreation, but is a scientific collection in itself.

jobs.title: Passionate about brewing and eager to learn and grow together with us?
jobs.description:
FLO continues to expand, new opportunities are constantly emerging across the company. For the right person, this role can be the beginning of an exciting career with us. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your technical skills, take on more responsibility and potentially move into other roles as the company grows. Based at our production facility in the countryside outside Oslo, you’ll become part of an ambitious and hands-on production team where quality, craftsmanship and continuous improvement are at the heart of what we do.

 

The role

Reporting to our Head of Production, you’ll be involved throughout the brewing and production process – from brewing and quality control to carbonation, filtration and kegging. Your key responsibilities will include:

 

  • Brewing Operations: Execute brewing processes according to recipes and established procedures, ensuring excellent quality and consistency in every batch.
  • Quality Control: Perform quality testing using equipment such as the Anton Paar Alcolyzer, pH meters, Dissolved Oxygen meters and CO₂ measurement devices.
  • Carbonation: Manage and fine-tune beverage carbonation to achieve the desired specifications.
  • Kegging & Filtration: Operate kegging and filtration equipment, ensuring our products meet the highest standards.
  • Cleaning & Sanitation: Carry out thorough Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) procedures for tanks, hoses, carbonation units, pumps, the brewhouse and other production equipment in accordance with our SOPs.
  • Production Data: Accurately record and update production and quality data in our ERP systems Odoo.
  • Packaging Support: Support packaging operations when required and work closely with colleagues across production.

You’ll also play an active role in keeping our workplace clean, safe, organized and efficient – and we want you to contribute ideas. We believe the people closest to production are often the ones who see the best opportunities for improvement.

 

Who are you? You’re someone who takes pride in your work and cares about the details that make the difference between a good product and a great one. Ideally, you have formal education in brewing, beverage production, food science or a related field, combined with some practical experience from a brewery or similar production environment. However, we’re also interested in people with the right technical understanding, attitude and desire to learn. We think you’ll thrive at FLO if you: 
 

  • Have a genuine interest in brewing and beverage production
  • Have relevant education and preferably some practical brewing or production experience
  • Are technically minded, practical and comfortable working hands-on
  • Understand the importance of hygiene, accuracy and consistency
  • Take ownership and responsibility for your work
  • Enjoy working as part of a team
  • Are curious and always looking for ways to improve
  • Want to continue learning and developing professionally
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-moving company where things evolve as we grow

Why FLO?

FLO AS is an ambitious company with exciting plans for the future. We are investing in our growth, our production and, importantly, our people. Joining us now means becoming part of that journey. For the right person, there will be significant opportunities to learn, develop and progress within the company. As FLO grows, new positions and responsibilities continue to emerge, creating opportunities for internal promotion and career development. 

 

You’ll be joining a company you can build a career with. Our production facility is located in a rural area outside Oslo. Due to the location, having access to a car is strongly recommended. Candidates must already have the legal right to live and work in Norway. Applicants residing within the EU/EEA who are eligible to work in Norway are welcome to apply.

 

If you want to learn, develop and be part of building something exciting, we’d love to hear from you: Whether you already have brewing experience or are early in your professional brewing career, this could be your opportunity to take the next step. We’re looking for someone who wants to master the craft, contribute to the team and develop alongside a company with big ambitions. Add Persona is managing the recruitment process on behalf of FLO AS. If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are warmly welcome to get in touch with us. We look forward to hearing from you!

 

Come brew with FLO – and be part of what we’re building.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

FLO is a leading company in beverage development and production, known for our innovative approach, high quality standards, and strong customer partnerships. As a dedicated co-packer, we produce private-label beverages for customers in Norway, across the Nordic region, and in international markets, as well as manufacturing products for other brand owners.

 

FLO operates from modern, high-quality facilities at Sollihøgda. Today, we are a team of 29 employees with diverse professional backgrounds, united by a shared drive: to create together, deliver quality, and have fun along the way. We value diversity, continuous development, and a start-up mindset built on the belief that nothing is impossible. At FLO, success is not only about the results we achieve, but also about how we achieve them – as a team that supports, challenges, and celebrates together.

jobs.title: Anæstesisygeplejerske til elektiv kirurgi – primært i dagtimerne
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din anæstesifaglighed i et elektivt hospital med korte patientforløb, tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og primært arbejde i dagtimerne?

Capio Privathospital Odense søger en anæstesisygeplejerske til en fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen.

 

En arbejdsdag med anæstesi og opvågning

Du bliver en del af vores anæstesiteam og arbejder cirka 75 % med anæstesi og 25 % i opvågningen. Vi varetager elektiv kirurgi inden for blandt andet ortopædkirurgi, rygkirurgi og mave-tarmkirurgi.

Arbejdet ligger mandag til fredag, primært i dagtimerne og med enkelte vagter frem til kl. 20.00.

Hos os arbejder læger, sygeplejersker og øvrige faggrupper tæt sammen om sikre, effektive og trygge patientforløb. Vi er et mindre hospital med korte beslutningsveje, hvor der er mulighed for at få indflydelse på både hverdagen og den fortsatte udvikling af området.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen

  • Primært arbejde i dagtimerne på hverdage

  • Cirka 75 % anæstesi og 25 % opvågning

  • Elektive og veltilrettelagte patientforløb

  • Et fagligt stærkt og tværfagligt miljø

  • Grundig introduktion til hospitalet og vores arbejdsgange

  • Synlig ledelse og korte beslutningsveje

  • Løn efter DSR-overenskomst samt sundhedsforsikring

  • Personaleparkering under hospitalet

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er uddannet anæstesisygeplejerske

  • Arbejder fagligt sikkert og selvstændigt

  • Trives med både anæstesi og opgaver i opvågningen

  • Bidrager til et godt samarbejde og hjælper, når dagens program kræver fleksibilitet

  • Møder patienter og kolleger med respekt, ro og hjælpsomhed

  • Har lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen af vores faglige praksis

Er du forholdsvis ny i specialet, hører vi også gerne fra dig. Det vigtigste er, at du har et sikkert fagligt fundament og lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Om Capio Odense

Capio Privathospital Odense er et elektivt hospital med fokus på patientsikkerhed, høj faglig kvalitet og gode patientoplevelser.

Vi arbejder ud fra værdierne ansvar, respekt, hjælpsomhed og fleksibilitet. For os handler en god kultur om, hvordan vi samarbejder i hverdagen og løser opgaven sammen omkring patienten.

Har du lyst til at høre mere?

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning. Send dit CV og nogle få ord om, hvorfor stillingen interesserer dig.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Ved ansættelse indhenter vi børneattest og straffeattest.

jobs.description:

- kykyä työskennellä tavoitteellisesti sekä itsenäisesti että verkostoissa

- arvopohjaisen ja ihmisläheisen työyhteisön, josta löytyy monipuolista osaamista ja yhteistyötä

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - NLP
Sairaanhoitaja, Tyks Psykiatrian varahenkilöstö, Turku
jobs.description:
Nyt siihen tarjoutuu mahdollisuus, kun meillä on haettavana sairaanhoitajan toimi Psykiatrian tulosryhmän keväällä perustetussa varahenkilöstössä!

Psykiatrian tulosryhmään perustettiin 11 sairaanhoitajan uusi varahenkilöstö keväällä -26, jonka tavoitteena on vastata akuutteihin poissaoloihin psykiatrian eri osastoilla. Tarkoituksena on lyhytaikaisten sijaisuuksien paikkaaminen ammattitaitoisella ja psykiatrista kokemusta omaavilla sairaanhoitajilla.

Tehtäväsi

Varahenkilöstössä työskentelevät sairaanhoitajat muodostavat oman yksikön eli nimettyjä kotiosastoja varahenkilöillä ei ole. Varahenkilöt varataan Respa-varausjärjestelmän avulla eri yksiköihin ja toimintaa koordinoivat varahenkilöstön osastonhoitaja yhteistyössä osastojen esihenkilöiden ja vuorovastaavien kanssa. Sairaanhoitajat työskentelevät 3-vuorotyössä ja heillä on käytössä autonominen työvuorosuunnittelu. Osastot sijaitsevat Tyks kantasairaalan alueella Kompassisairaalassa ja rakennuksessa 11 sekä Mäntymäen sairaala-alueella Kupittaan sairaalassa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset mukaan rakentamaan ja kehittämään psykiatrian tulosryhmän keväällä 2026 perustettua varahenkilöstöä, jonka tehtävänä on tukea psykiatrian osastoja akuuteissa henkilöstötarpeissa. Työssäsi saat hyödyntää psykiatrista osaamistasi monipuolisesti eri osastoilla ja tutustua laajasti psykiatrian toimintaympäristöihin sekä erilaisiin potilasryhmiin.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi autonomisen työvuorosuunnittelun avulla sekä työn, jossa kehittämiselle, uuden oppimiselle ja ammatilliselle kasvulle on aitoa tilaa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Jos nautit vaihtuvista työyhteisöistä ja pystyt heittäytymään erilaisiin työympäristöihin, siedät epävarmuutta sekä koet erilaisten potilasryhmien kanssa työskentelyn ammatillisesti antoisaksi, niin tämä paikka on juuri sopiva sinulle.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen sairaanhoitajan laillistus.

Lisäksi toivomme kehittämis- ja kehittymismyönteisyyttä, sillä tavoittelemme toimivaa ja pysyvää uutta rakennetta psykiatrian osastojen tueksi.

Lisäksi edellytetään hyvää suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa. Ruotsin kielen taidosta on etua.

Eduksi luetaan kokemus psykiatrisesta osastohoidosta.

Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta ja innostut monipuolisesta työstä psykiatrian eri osastoilla, hae mukaan rakentamaan psykiatrian varahenkilöstön toimintaa. Odotamme hakemustasi!
