Avain Asunnot on yksi Suomen nopeimmin kasvavista asuntojen ja asumisen palvelujen tuottamiseen erikoistuneista yhtiöistä. Nyt etsimme Helsinkiin myynnillisestä työstä ja asumisesta innostunutta **vuokrakohteiden välittäjää,** olisitko se sinä?

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

Vuokravälittäjänä tärkein tehtäväsi on löytää asiakkaillemme heidän tarpeitaan vastaava koti. Vastaat Avain Asuntojen vuokrakohteiden osalta mm. asuntojen markkinointiin liittyvien tietojen päivittämisestä eri järjestelmiin, asiakkaiden kontaktoinnista puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse, asuntonäyttöjen järjestämisestä sekä sopimusneuvotteluista.

Työskentelet Helsingin toimipisteeltä käsin ja vastaat erityisesti pääkaupunkiseudun ja lähikuntien alueen kohteista. Pääset liittymään osaksi vuokrauksen viiden hengen tiimiä, jossa kollegasi työskentelevät muualla Suomessa. Avain Asuntojen Helsingin toimistolla työskentelee kuitenkin useampia myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutiimin jäseniä joiden kanssa pääset tekemään yhteistyötä. Tehtävässä raportoit vuokrauspäällikölle ja pääset tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä myös esimerkiksi markkinointitiimin kanssa.

Vastaat yhdessä tiimin kanssa pääkaupunkiseudulla sijaitsevien kohteiden vuokrauksen lisäksi myös kohteista muualla Suomessa, kuten esimerkiksi Lahdessa ja Turussa. Näiden paikkakuntien osalta näytöt voidaan usein järjestää paikallisten kumppaneiden avulla, mutta arvostamme joustavuutta ja liikkuvuutta eri paikkakuntien välillä tarpeen mukaan.

**Millaista osaajaa etsimme?**

Avain Asuntojen vuokravälittäjäksi sopii vahvat kommunikointitaidot omaava henkilö, jolla on tuloshakuisen työotteen lisäksi aito halu löytää ratkaisuja asiakkaidemme asumiseen liittyvissä kysymyksissä. Arvostamme innostunutta ja määrätietoista asennetta uuden oppimiseen sekä halua menestyä yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.

Sinulla voi olla kaupallinen koulutus tai opintotausta joltain muulta alalta – Avain Yhtiöt tukee henkilöstönsä kehittymistä esimerkiksi alan tutkintojen suorittamisessa työn ohessa.

**Sinulta odotamme:**

- Aiempaa kokemusta tuloksekkaasta myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutyöstä

- Oma-aloitteista ja tavoitteellista työskentelyotetta sekä ketterää ongelmanratkaisukykyä monipuolisissa asiakastilanteissa

- Asiakaslähtöistä palveluasennetta ja joustavuutta työaikoihin esimerkiksi asuntonäyttöjen järjestämistä silmällä pitäen

- Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa sekä MS Office -ohjelmien käyttökokemusta

- B-ajokorttia sekä omaa autoa


**Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:**

- Aiempi kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä tai kiinteistöalalta

- LVV- tai LKV-tutkinto


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan tehtävänkuvan, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi. Työnantaja tarjoaa mahdollisuuden suorittaa esim. LKV-tutkinnon työn ohessa

- Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten lounas-, liikunta-, ja työmatkaedun, kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä erilaiset henkilökunnan yhteiset tilaisuudet ja virkistystapahtumat. Lisäksi mahdollisuuden hyödyntää Tahkon loma-osaketta viikoksi vuosittain

- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan lisäksi kuukausittain maksettavan myyntiprovision

- Lämminhenkisen, yhteen hiileen puhaltavan ja avoimeen keskusteluun kannustavan työkulttuurin ja työyhteisön, jossa otetaan aidosti huomioon erilaiset kehitysideat!


**Käytännön asiat**

Tehtävänkuva on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme Avain Vuokra-asunnot Oy:n palvelukseen. Työpisteesi sijaitsee Kalasataman toimistolla, ja työ edellyttää pääosin liikkumista pääkaupunkiseudulla ja sen lähialueella. Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian. Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Tarkempi aloituspäivä sovitaan erikseen valitun kanssa. Palkka tehtävässä koostuu kiinteästä kuukausipalkasta sekä myynnin provisioista.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Kuopion alueelle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Kuopion alueelle. Aloitus on mahdollisimman pian, joten toivomme hakemustasi pikaisesti.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


**Edellytämme sinulta**

- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä

- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti


Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi.

jobs.description:
Ansøgningsfrist: 23. oktober 2026

 

Er du serviceminded, ansvarsbevidst og kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt? Vi søger lige nu servicemedarbejder til rengøring hos to af vores kunder i Helsingør.

 

Som vores nye kollega vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver være kontorrengøring og øvrige faciliteter. Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har en positiv indstilling, er omhyggelig og ønsker at levere en god service.

Din oplæring vil bestå af sidemandsoplæring, hvor du grundigt bliver introduceret til arbejdsopgaverne og de enkelte lokationer. Efter oplæringsperioden vil du arbejde selvstændigt med ansvar for dine daglige opgaver.

 

Arbejdstider

På den ene lokation udføres rengøringen uden for kundens normale arbejdstid. Arbejdet skal derfor enten være afsluttet inden kl. 08.00 eller påbegyndes efter kl. 16.00.

  • 4,75 timer ugentligt

  • Fleksibel arbejdstid inden for de angivne rammer

Den anden lokation er døgnåben, og rengøringen kan udføres på det tidspunkt, der passer bedst. Der er afsat 30 minutter dagligt, svarende til 2,5 timer ugentligt.

For at kunne arbejde på lokationen er det et krav, at du gennemfører kurset "Pas på banen". Kurset kan gennemføres på én dag og kræver, at du kan forstå dansk eller engelsk.

Kurset består af:

  • En online del på cirka 1 time

  • En fysisk undervisningsdag hos Banedanmark i Ringsted

 

Skab værdi med din service

Vi ønsker at levere den bedste service til vores kunder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og fokuseret på kvalitet i dit arbejde.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, gerne kontorrengøring, men det er ikke et krav

  • Er serviceminded, hjælpsom og positiv

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorienteret

  • Har sans for detaljen og leverer et højt kvalitetsniveau

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Er villig til at gennemføre "Pas på banen"-kurset

 

Vi tilbyder

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaverne

  • Selvstændigt arbejde med fleksible arbejdstider

  • Arbejdstøj og nødvendige arbejdsredskaber

  • Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og god service

 

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og eventuelt en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt via linket "Ansøg nu" senest d. 23. oktober 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Service Manager Nedzhati Nizamiev Hasanov på mail: nedzhati.hasanov@dk.issworld.com 

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Office Coordinator (part-time), Nordic Semiconductor Finland, Tampere
jobs.description:
About the role

In this part-time role, you will be the heart of our Tampere office, ensuring a welcoming environment for employees and guests. Working closely with our Oulu-based support team, you will manage daily logistics, coordinate fun social events, and keep our workspace organized.

You are offered a highly flexible part-time schedule (40-50%, about 2 days a week) that can be distributed across the week to fit your lifestyle. Enjoy a respectful, stress-free work environment where work-life balance is truly prioritized.

Work tasks
- Coordinate daily office operations and maintain a welcoming, tidy environment
- Organize office social events, staff gatherings, and traditional "fika" moments
- Prepare meeting rooms, including catering, cleanliness, and checking AV/IT equipment
- Manage office supplies, general procurement, and incoming/outgoing deliveries
- Welcome visitors and provide general front-desk support
- Act as the main point of contact for facility maintenance, cleaning, and equipment vendors

We are looking for

- A proactive, empathetic, and highly organized approach to work
- Fluent English skills and at least B-level (good) Finnish skills
- Experience in service-minded roles such as retail, hospitality, or customer service
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools

It is meritorious if you have
- Basic knowledge of AI tools and Canva
- Norwegian and/or Swedish language skills

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process. To join us in a part-time role, youll need another main activity that covers at least 50% of your time. That could be studies, another job, running your own business, parental leave, or something similar.

jobs.title: Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør til kørsel med transportsneglemaskine
jobs.description:
Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør søges til opstilling og kørsel med transportsneglemaskine.
Der findes kun én maskine til dette formål i Nordeuropa og du skal lære at betjene, opstille og fremstille sneglespiraler til vores egen produktion og salg.

Du vil blive oplært af folk med flere års erfaring og undervejs lære at svejse, bruge skærebrænder, vinkelsliber og flere andre smedemæssige opgaver. Det tager ca. 1-2 år at bliver rigtig dygtigt til at betjene maskinen og der vil være meget manuelt smede- og opstilling og vedligeholdelses arbejde, hvor du bliver sort på hænderne.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har tålmodighed og gåpåmod også selvom arbejdet driller og ikke lykkedes første gang. (Vigtigt!)

  • Du er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og har en positiv indstilling til teamwork.

  • Du er klar på at arbejde i et lille sammensluttet team med erfarne og gode kollegaer, hvor der er mulighed for at få råd, hjælp og vejledning i forhold til dine opgaver og udarbejdelse af transportsnegle.

  • Arbejdet kan til tider kræve god fysik.

  • Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Mulighed for at lære en helt speciel niché inden for smedefaget som kun få i verden er gode til.

  • Mulighed for gode lønvilkår som ufaglært.

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med fast arbejdstid.

  • Løn der matcher dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • En arbejdsplads, der vægter samarbejde og godt kollegaskab højt.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og specialisering inden for transportsnegle.

  • Mulighed for at deltage i spændende fremtidige projekter og udvikling af maskiner inden for udarbejdelse af snegle.

Arbejdstider:
Mandag til onsdag kl. 7.00-15.30, torsdag 7.00-14.45, fredag 07.00-14.30

Om Arni Maskinfabrik.

Lille familievirksomhed med 8 ansatte placeret ved Eskilstrup på Falster. 
Vores speciale er Transportsnegle, udarbejdelse af sneglevindinger og profilvalsning.
Besøg gerne vores hjemmeside eller Facebook for at se eksempler på vores projekter.
https://arni.dk/
https://www.facebook.com/ArniMaskinfabrik

Virksomheden fyldte 90 år i 2025 og gennemgår i disse år en opdatering hvad angår lokaler og maskiner.

Ansøgning:
Send ansøgning og CV til Søren Lund på e-mail: sl@arni.dk
Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter når den vi finder den rette.

Med venlig hilsen

4863 Eskilstrup

Tlf.: 54436312

Nous recherchons un(e) Tech Lead Data Engineer capable de trouver des solutions innovantes et robustes à l'ensemble des problématiques Data.
Vous aurez la charge de :
- Assurer la mise en œuvre de l'accès, du référencement et de la qualité de la donnée
- Assurer l'industrialisation, la supervision et l'intégration des solutions
- Rédiger les normes de développement
- Participer à la rédaction du manuel d'exploitation
En tant que Tech Lead, vous savez :
- Vous présenter et promouvoir des architectures data face au client
- Identifier et comprendre les besoins métiers
- Former, encadrer et faire évoluer les consultants juniors
- Participer à la réponse aux appels d'offres (avant-vente)

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

En tant que Tech Lead Data Engineer vous maîtrisez :
- Le langage SQL
- Un langage objet (Python, JAVA, Scala)
- Un framework de calcul distribué
- Un bus de messages: Kafka, RabbitMQ
- Des Outils d'alimentation de données: Talend, Matillion, Stambia
- Des Moteurs de recherche: suite ELK (ElasticSearch, Logstash, Kibana), SolR, services Cloud
- Le Stockage des données: stockage objet et/ou distribué (HDFS, deltalake ou blob/S3)
- L'intégration continue (Git, JUnit, SonarQube, Jenkins)
- Un cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) ou une distribution Big Data (Hortonworks, Cloudera, Datastax)
- Les concepts de la modélisation relationnelle et non-relationnelle
Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une université, vous justifiez d'une expérience professionnelle d'au minimum 5 ans dans un contexte projet Data. Rigoureux(se), proactif(ve) et autonome vous restez en veille technologique et êtes force de proposition. Vous êtes capable de prendre de la hauteur et vous adapter aux enjeux du projet.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Model Capabilities
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has been at the cutting edge of AI since before ChatGPT launched. The job of the Model Capabilities team is to keep us there. We own the model layer of Notion AI: integrating frontier models as they ship, keeping inference reliable and economical at scale, and building new capabilities that other teams take advantage of.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Bring new frontier models into production quickly, making them available for our users and our engineers.

 - Make inference reliable: better error categorization, self-healing retries, and cross-provider failover.

 - Own observability for the model layer, driving down both time to detection and time to fix.

 - Build new model-level capabilities and help product teams adopt them.

 - Act as connective tissue across Notion's AI teams: find the gaps, unblock people, and make sure fixes land with the right owner.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Comfort with a moving frontier: The model landscape changes monthly. You keep up with it, form your own view of what's real, and stay pragmatic about what's worth adopting now.

 - AI fluency as a practitioner: You use AI tools seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

 - Production AI systems experience: You've built and operated systems on top of LLM APIs, not just prototyped with them. You understand token economics, streaming, tool calling, context limits, and how each of these fails in production.

 - Measurement before conviction: You don't ship a prompt or model change on vibes. You define what "better" means, build or use the evaluation to test it, and are willing to be proven wrong by your own data.

 - Cost and performance instincts: You treat latency and dollars as product qualities, not afterthoughts, and you can reason about the tradeoff between them and output quality.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 – $300,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Senior PM Consultant – Fund Migration (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior PM Consultant – Fund Migration

We are looking for a Senior Fund Migration Consultant with a strong track record of delivering complex fund migration programmes end to end, from initial scoping through to post-migration stabilisation, across the full spectrum of asset servicing functions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end delivery of complex fund migration programmes, covering initial scoping, planning, execution, conversion, operational readiness, and post-migration stabilisation.
• Act as the primary project contact for clients, fund management companies, custodians, transfer agents, administrators, portfolio managers, brokers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, decision-making, and escalation throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Define and maintain detailed project plans, migration roadmaps, wave plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, runbooks, stakeholder maps, governance materials, and status reporting dashboards.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams across fund administration, transfer agency, custody, middle office, fund accounting, client service, legal, compliance, technology, and operations to deliver against agreed scope, time, cost, and quality objectives.
• Oversee key migration activities including data readiness, data validation, file delivery, reconciliation, operating model design, service model changes, testing, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.
• Chair working groups, steering committees, and governance forums, providing concise updates, recommendations, and decision papers to senior stakeholders.
• Identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues relating to data quality, system functionality, resource availability, client dependencies, regulatory constraints, and project scope.
• Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across migration methodology, documentation, controls, and reusable delivery frameworks.
• Support Client Service Delivery Managers in identifying service model impacts and ensuring changes are captured appropriately in service level agreements and handover documentation.

Requirements

• 5 to 10 years of consulting or project delivery experience within financial services, asset servicing, fund administration, or investment management.
• Demonstrable track record of delivering large and complex fund migration programmes as a consultant, including administrator transitions, fund conversions, launches, mergers, or liquidations.
• Strong understanding of investment funds and asset servicing operating models: fund administration, transfer agency, custody, middle office, fund accounting, and client service processes.
• Proven experience managing migration plans, conversion events, data validation, reconciliations, testing, cutover readiness, and post-implementation stabilisation.
• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, challenge, and build trusted relationships with senior clients, internal partners, and external service providers.
• Strong governance discipline, including experience preparing executive-level status reporting, steering committee materials, RAID logs, project plans, runbooks, and decision papers.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, competing priorities, and dependencies while maintaining delivery discipline and attention to detail under pressure.
• Fluent in English, mandatory; French and/or German would be an important advantage.
• Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, or equivalent) is a valued plus.

We are seeking a Senior Adviser / Assistant Manager to join our Regulatory & Strategy team

Join a growing team working at the intersection of regulation, strategy and transformation. You will help financial institutions navigate complex EU and Luxembourg regulatory requirements, from licensing and market entry to target operating models, governance and regulatory gap assessments, while translating regulatory change into practical business solutions and supporting engagement with supervisory authorities.

What you will be working on

• Manage Regulatory & Strategy projects, with limited involvement from senior management, across topics such as licensing and authorisation, market entry, target operating model and governance design, regulatory impact and gap assessments, remediation, business model assessments and financial forecasting
• Conduct impact analysis on evolving EU and Luxembourg regulatory frameworks and supervisory expectations, including MiFID II/MiFIR, CRR/CRD, PSD2/PSD3/PSR, DORA, MiCA, EMIR, MAR and the broader EU and Luxembourg financial services framework, to identify key challenges and opportunities for banks, investment firms, payment service providers, e-money institutions and PSFs alike

What we look for

• A Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Finance or Physics
• 3-5 years of experience in the financial sector and/or in consulting, ideally with exposure to regulatory, strategy or transformation projects
• Excellent analytical capabilities and a pragmatic mind-set

KPMG is where you will find the right opportunities to advance your career and the widest available range of possibilities so you can grow professionally. Make a real impact, join a diverse team of leading experts, work with global clients, and discover technological solutions.

KPMG is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. Our recruiting decisions are based on your experience and skills.

jobs.title: Group General Counsel - International Company (m/f)
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Group General Counsel

Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, with dotted reporting line to the Board.
Contract: permanent, full-time (40 hours per week). Location: Luxembourg, hybrid, with regular international travel.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support

• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.

2. Corporate, M&A and governance

• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.

3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation

• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.

4. High risk industry, trust and safety, and content compliance

• Advise on the legal and regulatory framework applicable to adult oriented and creator monetization platforms, including age assurance and identity verification, performer consent and record keeping obligations, nonconsensual intimate image takedown, CSAM prevention and reporting, and content moderation and appeals.
• Design and maintain creator terms, model releases, content licences, revenue share arrangements and agency and management arrangements.
• Advise on advertising, affiliate and performance marketing arrangements, influencer marketing rules and consumer protection requirements in the EU, the UK and the US.
• Manage intellectual property, including trademarks, copyright enforcement and anti-piracy programmes.

5. Payments, financial crime and sanctions

• Own the legal side of the group's payments stack, including acquirer and payment service provider agreements, alternative payment methods, payout and creator disbursement arrangements and merchant of record structures.
• Advise on card scheme rules as they apply to high risk and adult merchant categories, including high brand risk and integrity risk registration programmes, prohibited content rules, chargeback thresholds and remediation plans.
• Advise on PSD2 and strong customer authentication, electronic money and payment institution perimeter questions, and the implications of the EU instant payments and payment services reform.
• Own the group's KYC, AML, CTF and sanctions framework, including creator onboarding, transaction monitoring, and screening against EU, UK, US OFAC and other relevant measures.

6. Commercial and employment

• Negotiate the group's material commercial agreements, including technology, content, distribution, partnership and vendor agreements.
• Support the people function on employment law across multiple jurisdictions, including contracts, contractor classification, incentive schemes and internal investigations.

3 Required profile

The following are requirements (must-haves):

• Law degree from an EU or EEA or UK university.
• Admission in good standing to the bar of an EU or EEA Member State or UK.
• A minimum of 20 years of PQE legal experience, of which at least 10 years in a senior in house legal leadership role (General Counsel, Head of Legal or equivalent).
• Demonstrable experience of building and leading an international in house legal team across diverse jurisdictions.
• A track record of leading cross border M&A transactions in the US, UK and/or EU jurisdictions.
• Corporate governance experience in complex international structures.
• Recognised privacy certification (IAPP CIPP/E or equivalent) and hands on ownership of a GDPR compliance programme.
• Direct working knowledge of the EU/UK digital regulatory framework, including DSA, DMA, OSA, the AI Act, AVMS.
• Substantive experience in high risk regulated industries, and specifically in adult entertainment or creator platform compliance.
• Substantive experience of payment processing and billing for high-risk merchant categories.
• Experience in entertainment and media.
• Tax, KYC/AML and sanctions experience in a regulated or high risk environment.
• Experience advising founders, C level executives and Boards in a venture backed, high growth environment.
• English at level C (native/bilingual/proficient user).

The following are advantages (nice to haves):

• Postgraduate business qualification (MBA or equivalent).
• Formal training or certification in AI
• Recognised corporate governance certification (e.g. ILA CGO).
• Qualification or formal training in international taxation and in corporate compliance.
• Experience of a Luxembourg holding structure and of Luxembourg corporate and employment law.
• Additional languages, in particular Spanish, French, Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish.
• Prior experience in a matrix organisation or in the country or regional unit of a multinational group.

4 Personal attributes

• Commercial and pragmatic. Comfortable taking a risk-based position and defending it to the Board.
• Comfortable operating hands on in a lean team while also delegating and developing others.
• Able to work across cultures and time zones, and to hold credibility with founders, investors, regulators and counterparties.
• Willing to work in a business whose content categories include adult material.

5 Terms

• Contract: permanent (contrat à durée indéterminée), governed by Luxembourg law.
• Working time: full time, 40 hours per week, flexible arrangement.
• Place of work: [LuxCo address], Luxembourg, with hybrid working and regular travel, principally to London.
• Remuneration: gross annual salary between EUR 150,000 and EUR 250,000.
• Start date: as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Tech Lead - Digital Transformation Factory Vie

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Professionnels
Home Office Oui

Votre job en bref

Au sein de la Digital Transformation Factory Vie, vous portez la vision technique des solutions digitales du domaine Vie et accompagnez l'équipe dans la conception, le développement et l'exploitation de solutions robustes, sécurisées, simples et maintenables.
En tant que point de référence technique, vous veillez à la cohérence des choix réalisés avec les besoins métier, l'écosystème IT, les standards de l'entreprise et les principes d'architecture. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, les Business Analysts, le Product Owner, les architectes et les équipes d'exploitation, tout en conservant une dimension opérationnelle avec environ 50 % de votre activité consacrée au développement, selon les priorités de l'équipe.

Ce qui vous attend

Type de contrat : CDI
Type d'emploi : temps plein

• Vision et architecture : définir les orientations techniques locales en cohérence avec l'architecture d'entreprise et les architectes solution, promouvoir des solutions simples et maintenables, et garantir la cohérence entre les frontends Angular, les services REST backend .NET, les microservices de support et les échanges Kafka.
• Analyser en amont les impacts, dépendances et risques techniques, documenter les décisions structurantes et contribuer à la roadmap technique.
• Consulter les architectes et débattre avec eux de toute décision ayant un impact sur plusieurs applications ou équipes.
• Qualité logicielle : garantir la qualité des développements, la conformité aux standards techniques et la maîtrise de la dette technique ; intégrer les risques techniques et accompagner leur résolution.
• Réaliser des revues de code, prototypes et preuves de concept, intervenir sur les développements structurants ou complexes, veiller au respect des quality gates SonarCloud et promouvoir les tests automatisés.
• Accompagnement de l'équipe : faire progresser les membres sur les pratiques de développement et DevOps, contribuer au recrutement et à la montée en compétence, accompagner les choix de conception et d'implémentation, faciliter les décisions collectives et arbitrer lorsque nécessaire.
• Industrialisation : assurer une veille technologique, maintenir et améliorer les pipelines d'intégration continue dans Azure DevOps Services et collaborer sur les processus de déploiement continu gérés dans Jenkins.
• Garantir un niveau d'observabilité adapté grâce aux logs, métriques, tableaux de bord et alertes, et participer aux mises en production nécessitant l'intervention de l'équipe technique.

Ce que nous attendons

• Diplôme supérieur en informatique ou en ingénierie logicielle.
• Expérience significative en développement logiciel dans l'écosystème .NET et avec Angular, ainsi que dans un rôle de point de référence ou de leadership technique incluant l'accompagnement de développeurs.
• Très bonne maîtrise de C#, de .NET et de son écosystème, notamment EF Core et SQL Server, idéalement sur une version récente telle que .NET 10.
• Très bonne maîtrise d'Angular et de TypeScript.
• Bonne connaissance de Git, des revues de code et des stratégies de gestion des branches, notamment Gitflow.
• Expérience dans la conception d'API, de microservices, d'architectures distribuées et de solutions de messaging avec Kafka.
• Maîtrise des enjeux de performance, de scalabilité, de résilience applicative, de sécurité et d'observabilité.
• Expérience d'Azure DevOps Services pour l'intégration continue et connaissance de Jenkins pour le déploiement.
• Leadership technique, pragmatisme, autonomie, écoute et esprit d'équipe ; capacité à communiquer, coacher, décider et gérer plusieurs priorités sans posture autoritaire.
• Français et anglais courants ; l'allemand et le luxembourgeois constituent des atouts.
• Une expérience dans les secteurs financier, assurantiel ou de la gestion de patrimoine constitue un atout.

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u oglasu.
Osoba koja nije podnijela pravovremenu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz oglasa, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na oglas.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan/na je u prijavi na oglas pozvati se na to pravo, odnosno priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), dužan/a se u prijavi na oglas pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na oglas dužan/a je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.  Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete iz oglasa bit će proveden usmeni razgovor, a o vremenu i mjestu održavanja usmenog razgovora, kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem kontakt broja telefona odnosno mobitela ili e-mail adrese iz prijave.

O rezultatima oglasa kandidati/kinje će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem.    
  
VODNE USLUGE d.o.o. pridržavaju pravo poništiti ovaj natječaj u bilo kojem trenutku, bez posebnog obrazloženja.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

jobs.title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. jobs.title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
jobs.description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

jobs.title: Servicetekniker - Hele Danmark
jobs.description:
Hvad kan du forvente?

Tesla søger serviceteknikere til vores lokationer i Aalborg, Aarhus, Greve, Hillerød, København-Kastrup, Køge, Odense, Ribe og Søborg.

Arbejd på verdens mest avancerede bil. Få praktisk erfaring med banebrydende elbiler og teknologi, der er med til at forme fremtidens transport.

Stillinger til forskellige erfaringsniveauer – vi finder den rette rolle til dig. Uanset om du er en erfaren tekniker eller er i starten af din karriere, matcher vi dig med en stilling, der passer til dine kompetencer og dine udviklingsmål.

Samarbejde frem for individuelle mål. Vi er ét team med en fælles vision. Succes skabes gennem samarbejde – ikke konkurrence.

Det, du ser ovenfor, er kun begyndelsen!

Er du nysgerrig efter at vide mere? Her er et indblik i, hvad der ellers venter:

  • Invester i din udvikling: 3 ugers intensiv oplæring samt 13 dages årlig efteruddannelse. Vi giver dig de bedste forudsætninger for succes fra første dag og tilbyder løbende uddannelse, så du på sigt kan blive Tesla Master Technician.

  • Forudsigelige arbejdstider: Faste arbejdstider uden forventning om overarbejde.

  • Rene og moderne værksteder: Fuldt udstyrede arbejdsområder med alt det værktøj, du har brug for.

  • Rejsemuligheder: Udbyg dine kompetencer ved at støtte Teslas globale mission.

  • Værktøj: Alt specialiseret Tesla-udstyr stilles til rådighed.

  • Bliv en del af vores succes: Modtag RSU'er (Restricted Stock Units/begrænsede aktieenheder) som belønning for dit bidrag.

Er du klar til at dykke endnu dybere?

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Diagnosticere og reparere den nyeste teknologi: Arbejd med de nyeste elbiler og softwaresystemer – ingen arbejdsdage er ens.

  • Samarbejde med forskellige teams: Arbejd tæt sammen med mobile teknikere, virtuelle supportteams, feltspecialister og øvrige supportfunktioner for at sikre, at alle køretøjer fungerer optimalt.

  • Lær gennem praksis: Udvikl dine kompetencer gennem løbende uddannelse og praktisk erfaring med verdens mest avancerede biler.

  • Støt Teslas mission: Spil en vigtig rolle i at holde vores biler på vejene og hjælpe kunderne med at opleve fremtidens transport.

  • Kundekontakt: Opbyg gode relationer ved at forklare reparationer, besvare spørgsmål og sikre en god kundeoplevelse.

  • Vær på forkant med udviklingen: Få tidlig adgang til nye funktioner, værktøjer og opdateringer, efterhånden som Tesla fortsætter med at udvikle sig.

Kvalifikationer

  • Gode kommunikationsevner: Du kan kommunikere klart og professionelt med både kunder og kolleger om mange forskellige emner.

  • Holdspiller: Du brænder for samarbejde og kontinuerlig forbedring.

  • Gyldigt kørekort: Du skal have et gyldigt kørekort i det land, hvor du søger stillingen.

  • Arbejdstilladelse: Du skal have ret til at arbejde i Danmark.

Lige muligheder og tilgængelighed

Tesla er en arbejdsplads med lige muligheder for alle. Alle kvalificerede ansøgere vil blive vurderet uden hensyn til forhold som f.eks. veteranstatus eller handicap eller andre forhold, der er beskyttet af gældende national eller lokal lovgivning.

Tesla er desuden forpligtet til at tilbyde rimelige tilpasninger til personer med handicap. Hvis du har behov for særlige hensyn på noget tidspunkt under ansættelsesprocessen, bedes du informere din rekrutteringsansvarlige.

Hvis du har behov for en skærmlæser eller anden tilgængelighedsteknologi, kan du hente en gratis kompatibel skærmlæser via Teslas hjemmeside, hvor der også findes en trinvis vejledning. Har du spørgsmål om tilgængelighed eller behov for særlige tilpasninger, kan du kontakte Tesla via den angivne ADA-kontaktadresse.

Beskyttelse af personoplysninger

Beskyttelse af persondata har høj prioritet hos Tesla. Vi indbygger databeskyttelse i vores produkter og betragter det som en central del af vores forretning. Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan Tesla indsamler og behandler dine personoplysninger i forbindelse med din ansøgning, kan du læse Teslas erklæring om beskyttelse af personoplysninger for jobansøgere (Tesla Talent Privacy Notice).

jobs.title: Mecánico / Service Technician - Relocation - Northen Europe
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Join Tesla: Bring Your Skills to Northern Europe

Do you want to help build a world of amazing abundance? At Tesla, that’s our mission.

We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made and as a Service Technician, you’ll help deliver an equally groundbreaking service experience to our customers.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and make a real impact in one of the world’s most sustainable and tech-forward regions? We have open roles across Northen Europe.

Why Move to Northen Europe? 

Relocating to Europe isn’t just a career move, it’s a life upgrade. Here’s what you gain:

  • Top-Tier Quality of Life: Consistently ranked among the happiest and safest countries in the world, clean air, green spaces, and safe cities.

  • Sustainable Living: Live in a country where EVs are the norm, public transport is excellent, and sustainability is woven into daily life.

  • Strong Tech & Innovation Ecosystems: Work at the heart of Europe’s clean energy and tech revolution, with access to cutting-edge tools, R&D and global collaboration.

What You’ll Do

Your Role: Service Technician at Tesla

  • Service, repair and improve: Use Tesla-specific software and advanced diagnostic tools to maintain and repair all Tesla vehicles.

  • Ensure top quality: Fix it right the first time. You’ll inspect vehicles with care before return and pre-delivery, because excellence is non-negotiable.

  • Collaborate ,across teams: Work with local and regional colleagues to share knowledge, solve complex issues, and continuously improve the service experience.

  • Grow with us: Access ongoing training, hands-on workshops, and a blended learning program to develop your technical and leadership skills. Your expertise helps shape the future of Tesla service.

What You’ll Bring

 We’re Looking For:

  • Technically experienced: Proven background in vehicle service, repair, or maintenance - automotive, aviation, marine, or industrial.

  • Team player: You thrive in diverse, collaborative environments and value shared success.

  • Flexible & adaptable: Comfortable working in shifts and across time zones to support global operations.

  • Clear communicator: Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and respectfully.

  • Safe to drive: Valid driver’s license required (for test drives and vehicle handling).

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • A workplace that values you: Safe, clean, innovative, and fun, where your voice matters and your growth is prioritized.

This Is More Than a Job. It’s a Move to the Future.

If you're a skilled technician ready to bring your expertise to a place where sustainability, innovation, and quality of life go hand in hand, apply now.

Join Tesla. Build the future. Live the future.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran status and disability status, protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

For quick access to screen reading technology compatible with this site click here to download a free compatible screen reader (free step by step tutorial can be found here). Please contact ADA@tesla.com for ADA related questions or to request ADA accommodations.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice .

Support Engineer I (NYC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC (SoHo) office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.

jobs.title: SKI LIFT OPERATOR
jobs.description:

PLEASE SEND YOUR CV TO: EURES.SELECCIO.SOC@GENCAT.CAT REFERENCE: SKI LIFT OPERATOR IF YOU ARE ATTENTIVE, RESPONSIBLE, STRONGLY CUSTOMER-SERVICE AND SAFETY-ORIENTED, AND LOOKING FOR A ROLE ENSURING SMOOTH, COMFORTABLE, AND SAFE ACCESS FOR OUR GUESTS ACROSS THE ENTIRE SKI RESORT, WE WANT TO MEET YOU! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: BOARDING AND UNLOADING ASSISTANCE: HELP SKIERS AND SNOWBOARDERS SAFELY BOARD AND UNLOAD FROM CHAIRLIFTS, GONDOLAS, OR SURFACE LIFTS, PAYING SPECIAL ATTENTION TO CHILDREN, BEGINNERS, AND INDIVIDUALS WITH REDUCED MOBILITY. ACCESS AND QUEUE CONTROL: VERIFY THAT GUESTS ACCESS LIFTS WITH A VALID SKI PASS AND MANAGE WAITING AREAS IN AN ORDERLY, SMOOTH, AND FRIENDLY MANNER. SITE MAINTENANCE: CLEAR SNOW AND ICE FROM LOADING AND UNLOADING RAMPS, ENSURING THAT PLATFORMS REMAIN LEVEL, SAFE, AND OBSTACLE-FREE THROUGHOUT THE OPERATING DAY. INTERNAL COORDINATION: PROMPTLY REPORT ANY DETECTED MECHANICAL ANOMALIES TO THE TECHNICAL TEAM OR CENTRAL DISPATCH, AND COLLABORATE WITH THE SKI PATROL TEAM DURING WEATHER OR SAFETY INCIDENTS. CANDIDATE PROFILE: EDUCATION: HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA OR EQUIVALENT QUALIFICATION, BASIC KNOWLEDGE OF OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH AND SAFETY IS A PLUS. EXPERIENCE: PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE IN CUSTOMER SERVICE, TOURISM, OR OUTDOOR PHYSICAL WORK IS APPRECIATED (PRIOR SKI LIFT EXPERIENCE IS NOT REQUIRED, AS ROLE-SPECIFIC TRAINING WILL BE PROVIDED). LANGUAGES: FLUENT SPANISH, KNOWLEDGE OF CATALAN, FRENCH, OR ENGLISH IS A PLUS FOR INTERACTING WITH LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL GUESTS. KEY STRENGTHS: STRONG FOCUS AND SENSE OF RESPONSIBILITY, A FRIENDLY AND EMPATHETIC ATTITUDE, EASE IN OPERATING BASIC CONTROL PANELS AND MANUAL TOOLS, GOOD PHYSICAL FITNESS, AND A WILLINGNESS TO WORK OUTDOORS UNDER CHANGING HIGH-MOUNTAIN WEATHER CONDITIONS. jobs.title: Tarjoilukeittiön keittiötyöntekijä Keisarinnaan
jobs.description:
**Oletko se ihminen, jonka ansiosta Keisarinnan tarjoilukeittiö toimii?**

Me uskomme, että jokaisessa keittiössä on yksi ihminen, joka pitää langat käsissään. Hän huomaa, jos jokin asia on jäämässä tekemättä. Hän pitää huolen siitä, että asiat tapahtuvat ajallaan. Hän löytää sujuvamman tavan tehdä asioita ja nauttii siitä, kun arki rullaa – ei siksi, että hän juoksisi sinne tänne, vaan siksi, että hänen työnsä sujuu hyvällä mielellä. Nyt etsimme tätä ihmistä meille.

**Kototiimi kasvaa vauhdilla – ja tarvitsemme kasvun mahdollistajan keittiöön**

Tällä hetkellä Kototiimillä on kaksi hoivakotia (kurkkaa www.kototiimi.fi). Kolmas avaa ovensa lokakuussa. Kasvun mukana lisääntyvät myös asiakkaat, tarjoiltavat ateriat ja välipalat, tiski, herkkujen tarve ja juhlien suunnittelu jne. Siksi tarvitsemme Keisarinnan keittiöön avainhenkilön – ihmisen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus pysyy hallinnassa.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain osa keittiötä. Olet Keisarinnan sydän.

**Mitä työsi käytännössä on?**

Työsi tärkein vastuu on saada päivittäiset ateriat turvallisesti ja kauniisti tarjolle (ateriat tulevat valmiina eli emme valmista lounasta ja päivällistä), pitää keittiö siistinä, suunnitella välipaloja ja leivonnaisia sekä huolehtia, että tarvikkeita on riittävästi. Toki myös keittiön omavalvonnasta huolehtiminen on vastuullasi. Huolehdit siitä, että tarjoilukeittiö toimii täsmällisesti, ajallaan ja laadukkaasti. Sinulle tarkkuus ei ole rasite, vaan tapa tehdä työtä. Toimit myös osana Keisarinnan tiimiä. Perehdytät, neuvot ja kehität toimintaa aterioiden ja keittiön näkökulmasta yhdessä muiden kanssa. Haluamme, että osaaminen kasvaa koko tiimissä – ei vain yhdellä ihmisellä. Kaikki auttavat toisiaan, koska meillä yksi asia yhdistää kaikkia: **Ketään ei jätetä yksin.**

**Me innostumme ihmisistä, jotka kehittävät.**

Ehkä huomaat usein miettiväsi:\_"Tämän voisi tehdä vähän fiksummin."\_Silloin saatat viihtyä meillä erinomaisesti. Emme etsi ihmistä, joka vain ylläpitää nykyisiä toimintatapoja. Etsimme ihmistä, joka uskaltaa kysyä, voisiko tämän tehdä paremmin. Kasvavassa yrityksessä mikään ei ole valmiiksi kiveen hakattua. Juuri siksi pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, millaiseksi Kototiimin Keisarinna rakentuu.

**Millainen sinä olet?**

Pidät järjestyksestä. Nautit siitä, että asiat ovat järjestyksessä ja tehtynä ajallaan. Rakastat työskennellä keittiössä. Vaikka meillä et valmista ruokaa alusta asti, pidät leipomisesta ja muusta värkkäämisestä ruoan ympärillä.

Sinulla on kokemusta keittiötyöstä, leipomisesta ja keittiöhygieniasta. Tai ehkä polkusi on ollut aivan toisenlainen. Meille tärkeintä on asenne.

**Mitä saat meiltä?**

Saat vakituisen työn yrityksessä, joka kasvaa voimakkaasti ja jossa omaan työhön voi oikeasti vaikuttaa. Saat vastuuta, luottamusta ja mahdollisuuden rakentaa toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Saat työyhteisön, jossa autetaan toisia, iloitaan onnistumisista ja tehdään töitä yhteisen tavoitteen eteen. Ja mikä tärkeintä – saat työn, jolla on valtava merkitys asiakkaillemme.

Vaikka et työskentelisi päivittäin asukkaidemme kanssa, vaikutat siihen, että heidän arkensa toimii. Kun keittiö toimii hyvin, koko hoivakotiyhteisö toimii hyvin.

**Jos tunnistit itsesi...**

...älä jää miettimään, täytätkö jokaisen kohdan. Jos ajattelet, että voisit olla juuri se ihminen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus toimii vähän paremmin, haluamme kuulla sinusta. Tule rakentamaan Kototiimin seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta. Meillä tärkeimmät työt eivät aina näy ulospäin – mutta niiden vaikutus näkyy joka päivä.

jobs.title: Doctoral researcher in computational weld mechanics
jobs.description:
Do you want to build a research career in computational weld mechanics? Join LUT University as a doctoral researcher and become part of an international research team developing advanced simulation methods for welded high-strength steel structures.

What your work will be like

Your work will focus on the analysis of local heat-affected zone (HAZ) behaviour in welded high-strength steels through computational weld mechanics (CWM) and phase-transformation modelling.
The research combines thermo-metallurgical and phase-transformation modelling, simulation of microstructural evolution in weld heat-affected zones, and modelling of local mechanical properties such as hardness, strength and strain-hardening behaviour. In addition, the work includes experimental characterisation of welded joints using microstructural, thermal and mechanical measurements and the validation of predictive models for performance-driven design of welded structures.

You will contribute to the development of next-generation simulation methods capable of accurately predicting local property variations in welded high-strength fossil-free steel structures.

You will be part of the Welding Technology Unit and the Steel Structures Unit at the LUT School of Energy Systems. Approximately 25 researchers are involved in these units, which collaborate closely with national and international partner universities, such as University of Oulu (Finland), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Sweden) and Chemnitz University of Technology (Germany).

What we expect from you

You have a master's degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in a relevant field such as mechanical engineering, materials engineering, welding engineering, computational mechanics, or another relevant discipline, and the ability and motivation to complete the doctoral studies within their normative duration (i.e. four years).

A solid background in numerical modelling, materials science, solid mechanics, finite element methods, programming, and/or welding technology is considered beneficial. Success in this position requires the ability to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively within our international research community. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required for performing the duties of this role.

We expect a willingness to travel, as the position includes project-related travel within Finland, participation in international conferences, and opportunities for research mobility with partner universities in Europe.

The selected candidate must submit an application for the right to complete doctoral studies with all required appendices to the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of the employment relationship.

What we offer

At LUT, you will have the opportunity to develop your scientific expertise and research skills. Our experienced supervisors will guide you, and you will benefit from professional development opportunities.

The position is based at the Lappeenranta campus, and you are expected to be regularly present on site.

The employment relationship will start with a one-year term (including a six-month trial period) and may be extended for up to three additional years, depending on the progress of your studies and research.

The work starts in December 2026. The start date is negotiable. Working hours are flexible, supporting work-life balance, with a total of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities.

The salary is determined according to the Finnish university salary system (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Interested? Please submit your application by 15 October 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+2h). Fill out the online application form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format:

- A cover letter describing your motivation and suitability specifically for this position, based on your expertise acquired during studies and potential prior work experience

- A curriculum vitae (CV) following the guidelines of the [Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity](https://tenk.fi/sites/default/files/2021-06/TENK_CV_template_2020.pdf)

- Scanned copies of your original bachelors and masters degree certificates and transcripts of records; if the original documents are not in English or Finnish, each document must be accompanied by an official certified translation into English (or Finnish). If the degree is unfinished, please provide an official estimate of your graduation.

- Contact details of two references (if available)

- A list of publications (if any)

Each attachment field accepts only one file. If you wish to submit multiple files, please combine them into a single PDF before uploading.

We will review applications on a rolling basis. Please ensure that your application includes all required documents and is submitted through the recruitment system.

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tuomas Skriko (tuomas.skriko@lut.fi, +358 50 470 6518) or Assistant Professor Antti Ahola (antti.ahola@lut.fi, +358 50 475 2825), preferably by email. You can also reach them by phone on 25 September 2026 and 9 October 2026 from 14:00 to 15:00 (UTC+2).

Read more about [LUT as an employer](https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/lut-employer) and the [LUT Doctoral School](https://www.lut.fi/en/research/doctoral-school).

Explore [information for international staff](https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/international-staff-and-visitors)
