jobs.title: Kreativ og engageret kantinemedarbejder til Campus Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Vi søger en kantinemedarbejder, der brænder for arbejdet i en kantine. Du behøver ikke være faglært, men det er vigtigt, at du har interesse for mad, service og samarbejde. Har du lyst til at være en del af et udviklende, solidarisk og omsorgsfuldt arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejdergruppen lægger vægt på trivsel og samhørighed?

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon har vi et ønske om at have levende campusmiljøer og at sætte vores studerende i centrum. Der er mange internationale studerende på Campus Kalundborg, hvorfor kommunikation på engelsk er en del af dagligdagen.

Alle campusser på Absalon har tilknyttet en kantine, hvor studerende og ansatte hver dag har mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid. Kantinerne har et stort fokus på, at deres arbejde ikke kun er madproduktion og salg. Kantinen er det uformelle samlingspunkt på campus og altid et rart sted at være. Vi er løbende i dialog rundt om buffeten i kantinen og har dialogmøder med de studerende. Dette gør vi for at sikre at det måltid, som vi serverer for de studerende, falder i deres smag, og giver dem lyst til at samles i vores kantinemiljøer.

Din profil
Du skal som kantinemedarbejder på Campus Kalundborg være serviceminded, arbejdsom og have lyst til at bidrage positivt til hverdagen i kantinen. Erfaring fra kantine, køkken eller servicefag er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Derudover skal du have lyst til at være i et miljø med mange glade studerende. Vi synes derfor, at det er vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

Bæredygtigt fokus. Du har erfaring med at være i en kantine, hvor der er fokus på økologi, bæredygtighed og at madspild bliver mindsket. Derudover har du lyst og evne til at dele dine gode ideer, samt suger til dig, når du selv har mulighed for at opnå ny viden.

Besidder overblik og fleksibilitet. I en hektisk hverdag, hvor der er mange opgaver at planlægge og følge op på, formår du at træffe velovervejede beslutninger, omsætte dem til handling og samtidig bevare overblikket. Din tilgang til opgaverne er systematisk, og du løser dem med nøjagtighed og omhu. Du udviser ansvarsfølelse, er serviceminded og engageret både i forhold til opgaverne og i samarbejdet med andre. Du omfavner forandringer og møder dem med en positiv indstilling.

Gode samarbejdsevner. Du evner at arbejde sammen med mange forskellige mennesker på tværs af faggrupper. Du har også evner og lyst til en hverdag, der rummer det brede arbejdsmarked, hvilket fx omfatter kolleger, der er ansat i virksomhedspraktik.

Erfaring med LEAN som arbejdsredskab. Du har med egne øjne set eksempler på, hvordan det ved hjælp af LEAN er muligt at frigive tid og ressourcer til andre vigtige gøremål i en travl hverdag.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • taler og skriver dansk og engelsk
  • har kendskab til Microsoft 365 på brugerniveau
  • gerne har erfaring fra lignende stillinger i en kantine eller et køkken.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som kantinemedarbejder er dine opgaver følgende:

Deltage i kantinens drift, som kræver evnen til at jonglere med flere opgaver samtidig. Du hjælper med den daglige produktion, klargøring af buffet, lettere køkkenopgaver, opfyldning, oprydning, opvask, udbringning af mødeforplejning og betjening af gæster i kantinen.

Udvikling i dagligdagen spiller en afgørende rolle, hvor du aktivt bidrager til at udvikle arbejdsgange og udtænke innovative metoder til anvendelse af appelsinskræller eller broccolistokke i vores stræben efter et endnu mere bæredygtigt fokus.

Sørge for kursister og gæster er afgørende på vores campus, hvor vi afholder kurser og konferencer for både interne og eksterne virksomheder og organisationer. Under disse begivenheder spiller du en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at kursister og gæster får passende forplejning til rette tid, hvilket bidrager til en førsteklasses serviceoplevelse.

Du får ansættelsessted på vores Campus i Kalundborg, men på sigt skal du forvente at have en ugentlig dag i vores kantine i Holbæk.

Dine kolleger
Kantinerne på Absalon er en del af Facility Service. Vi arbejder i teams og selvom vi er spredt på forskellige campusser, samarbejder vi på tværs og går op i at skabe holdånd og fællesskab, uanset om du arbejder i Kalundborg, Slagelse, Vordingborg eller på en af de øvrige campusser.

I kantinen på Campus Kalundborg er vi et team bestående af en elev, to medarbejdere og en leder. Vi går op i kvalitet, at der er en uformel omgangstone, og så skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er ufaglært, ligger en forventet månedlig løn mellem 24.200 kr. og 24.900 kr. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 16% For dig der er faglært, ligger en forventet månedlig løn mellem 26.100 kr. og 26.300 kr. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 15% eller 18,4% alt efter din uddannelsesbaggrund. Alt efter erfaring og baggrund kan der evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest den 1. december 2026
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte kantineleder Søren Loui Frydensberg, der kan træffes dagligt fra kl. 13.00 - 15.00 på tlf.: 7248 2253 eller mail skre@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 13. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale d. 21. oktober og 2. samtale d. 22. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer
jobs.description:
**OPEN CALL FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST FOR SECONDED NATIONAL EXPERTS AT THE EUROPEAN CHEMICALS AGENCY (ECHA), HELSINKI**

Seconded National Experts (SNEs) are drawn from the civil services of EU countries. They bring their unique skills and knowledge to ECHA for a period of time before taking the experience acquired during their stay at the Agency back to their home administration.

ECHA offers job opportunities for **Seconded National Experts (SNEs)** in the following profile:

**Profile Reference:** ECHA/SNE/2026/002

**Profile Title:** Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer

**1\. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS**

Candidates for secondment must:

· Have current employment in the national, regional or local public sector or international civil service. Alternatively candidates may be employed in a non-profit or voluntary sector;

· Hold a university degree in a field relevant to the areas of work described in this call;

· Be a national of an EU or EFTA Member State or a candidate country as decided by the Council;

· Be able to communicate in written and spoken English as this is the working language of ECHA.

**2\. SECONDMENT**

The secondment will be subject to an exchange of letters between the Head of People and Development of ECHA and the applicants employer. The duration of the first secondment is a maximum of one year. This period may be renewed for a maximum of three additional years.

Seconded National Experts remain in the service of their employer throughout the period of their secondment. The sending organisation must continue remunerating the SNE, who will thus benefit from social security coverage. During their secondment, SNEs will receive subsistence allowances and reimbursement of expenses as set out in the Rules on the secondment of national experts to the European Chemicals Agency (Decision ED-0050).

The SNE Rules

**3\. PROFILE**

**Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer; ref.: ECHA/SNE/2026/002**

Our ideal candidate is a communications professional with experience gained working in a national authority, national ministry, European institution or European agency. Comfortable in a changing environment, you are adaptable, resilient and have good interpersonal and networking skills. You are curious about developments in your field and communications more broadly.

The Unit is responsible for ECHAs communications activities, including press relations, external and internal communications, social media, digital communications and its website. We focus on delivering professional proactive, clear and strategic communications services, that support the Agency's activities and promote ECHAs work and achievements.

**Job description**:

The Seconded National Expert will work in the Communications Unit – G3.

The Communications Officer will contribute to the Units daily interaction with internal and external stakeholders. The jobholder will also be responsible for relations with internal business areas on specific regulatory topics in support of ECHAs external communications strategy. The role for this profile will be assigned according to the Units needs and the jobholders competencies.

Duties will include, depending on needs:

**External Communications:**

Drafting press releases, briefings, speeches etc.;

Developing content for ECHAs website;

Dealing with press queries, interviews and briefings;

Supporting senior management with media appearances;

Organizing and supporting events for external stakeholders;

Support the production of webinars and videos;

Support the management of the Agency's corporate communication channels and social media presence; ,

Acting as a spokesperson when required; and

Working with colleagues across ECHA to determine communication priorities and key messages to be delivered to internal and external stakeholders.

**Internal Communications:**

Cooperating with colleagues in determining communications priorities;

Content development for ECHAs Intranet;

Organizing and supporting internal staff events; and

General support to internal communication initiatives.

**Project Work**

The Unit is responsible for a number of ECHA wide projects, where input may be required, including:

Building a new website;

Implementing the new ECHA corporate identity;

ECHAs 2027 Conference – 20-21 May 2027;

ECHAs 20th Anniversary 1 June 2027-31 May 2028;

Chairing the EU Agencies Heads of Communications & Information Network – 1 March 2027-28 February 2028;

**Requirements:**

Successful completion of a full course of university studies attested by a degree, where the normal duration of university education is three (3) years or more.

Of your total professional experience, at least one (1) year must be in a field or fields relevant to the areas of work mentioned above e.g. for example, external/internal communications or stakeholder relations.

Only qualifications issued by EU Member State authorities or EEA authorities and qualifications recognised as equivalent by the relevant EU or EEA Member State authorities will be accepted.

**Selection criteria:**

If you meet the requirements set out above, you will be assessed on the basis of the following selection criteria. The candidates who are judged to be the most suitable on the basis of the selection criteria will be invited to a (remote) interview.

The following will be considered as **assets**:

· Ability to communicate effectively in English at all levels both orally and in writing;

· Experience of working in a communications/stakeholder relations function in a complex regulatory environment; and

· Demonstrated understanding of the link between your current experience, the Communications Officers role and ECHAs strategic priorities.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Full Professor in Business Analytics (tenure track) / Biträdande professor (nivå 1), biträdande professor (nivå 2) eller professor inom affärsanalytik (tenure track)
jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

Hanken School of Economics invites applications for a tenure-track position in Business Analytics at the level of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Full Professor

starting on 1 January 2027, or as otherwise agreed, by 1 September 2027 at the latest. The position is based in Helsinki within the subject of Statistics, which is part of the Department of Finance and Economics.

The position is part of Hankens tenure-track system and is open to researchers with the potential for an outstanding academic career. If the position is filled at the Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to advance through evaluations that consider merits across all relevant areas in accordance with [Hankens tenure track guidelines](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system).

Hanken School of Economics is a research-oriented business school offering education in Swedish and English. The Statistics unit, which collaborates closely with Finance and Information Systems, conducts high-quality research on financial time series. The subject seeks to strengthen its teaching and research in the application of machine learning and business analytics. The subject offers education at the Bachelors, Masters, and doctoral levels.

The Department provides a strong research environment, reflected in the growing scope and breadth of its research activities. We value high-quality research with relevance to business and economics, as demonstrated by publications in highly ranked academic journals.

Requirements

The applicants will be reviewed based on their research, teaching, institutional service, and societal impact. Applicants for the current position are required to have a fluent command of both English and Swedish. Teaching in Swedish is expected as part of the position's responsibilities.

Applicants on the assistant professor level should hold a doctoral degree (or be near completion of their doctorate) with a quantitative research orientation (e.g., business analytics, data science, machine learning, management science, statistics, econometrics, quantitative economics, or applied mathematics). When evaluating the applicants qualifications, the main focus will be on the potential to conduct high-quality scientific research in key areas relevant to the position, including Business Analytics and the potential to provide high-quality teaching.

In addition to the requirements for an assistant professor, applicants for the associate professor level are expected to have demonstrated internationally high levels of research within the scientific field of the position, high levels in teaching and contributed through institutional service and societal impact.

Applicants for full professor must demonstrate that she or he is an internationally recognised researcher with continued internationally high levels of research within the scientific field of the position. A professor is also expected to demonstrate continued high levels in teaching, institutional service and societal impact. In addition, academic leadership, experience of PhD supervision, experience and success in applying competitive research funding, international research cooperation, academic expert assignments, and experience of service within an academic department, faculty and / or university are expected.

Academic staff at Hanken are expected to carry out and supervise scientific research, provide high-quality academic teaching, closely follow the advances of their field, and participate in service to Hanken, the academic community, and society.

The full-time position has an annual working time of 1612 hours. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. Teaching tasks are allocated based on the curriculum needs of the subject and by considering relevant own expertise.

Salary

The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (includes employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions). The exact salary level depends on the recruited individuals qualifications and performance. Hanken will support the selected employee with a start-up research budget, and additional research, travel and teaching development grants can also be applied for. Hanken rewards excellence in both research and teaching.

For more Information

For additional information, please contact Chair of the Department Committee, Professor Anders Löflund, anders.loflund@hanken.fi.

General instructions for applicants are provided [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process). Also, read more about Hanken as an employer [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/node/2413861).

Recruitment process and timeline

The application deadline is October 18th, 2026. Candidates will be interviewed online shortly after the application deadline. Short-listed candidates will be invited to on-site campus visits including an interview and research presentation.

How to apply

The application is to be addressed to the Rector and application materials should include:

- Cover letter in which the applicant specifies the position for which they are applying (professor, associate professor, or assistant professor)
- CV (proposed content [here](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)), including list of publications.
- Personal statement, which includes a description of past research and its scientific quality, academic impact, plans for future research and a description of the candidates service to the department and university and a description of the candidates societal impact.
- List of publications (with the most significant publications highlighted; maximum 10 for full professor applicants and maximum 5 for associate and assistant professor applicants. Applicants at the associate professor and full professor levels should additionally submit up to five publications for assessment.

VENNissä on paikka auki positiiviselle, määrätietoiselle, ratkaisukeskeiselle ja kehitysmyönteiselle ravintola-alan ammattilaiselle. Meillä työt tehdään täydellä sydämellä, hymyä ja naurua unohtamatta.

jobs.title: Udlejningsmægler i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Er du vores næste udlejningsmægler i Aarhus?

Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor endnu en dygtig udlejningsmægler til vores afdeling i Aarhus. Bemærk at stillingen som udgangspunkt er et barselsvikariat af 10-12 måneders varighed, men med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse.

Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

  Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og er som udgangspunkt et barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Der vil være weekendarbejde, som på nuværende tidspunkt er hver 3. weekend.

Det er et krav, at du har kørekort, da en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår ude på fremvisninger. Når du ikke er på farten, har du din daglige base på vores kontor på Trindsøvej i Aarhus.

 Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til Aarhus og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

·         Energisk, positiv og klar til nye udfordringer

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Er du vores nye udlejningsmægler? Send din ansøgning til job@lejeboligmaegleren.dk med emnet "Udlejningsmægler, Aarhus". Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV.

Har du spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller os, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores afdelingsdirektør Niels Juul Jørgensen på tlf. 4040 2489 eller mail nju@lejeboligmaegleren.dk.

jobs.title: Kalankäsittelijä, fish processer to Föglö, Åland Islands for Fish Industry, +6 months, AX- Föglö
jobs.description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for fish processer(s) to Föglö, Åland Islands.

The job involves many different functions at the fish factory: killing, gutting, "cleaning" the fish, "collecting" roe, packing, lifting heavy boxes, among other tasks. If you have forklift skills, you can also drive a counter balance forklift. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. At Nordic Trout/Bolt.works, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
The work requires decent general strength, endurance, and proactivity. Previous experience in fish processing jobs is a plus but not necessary. You will receive orientation to the job. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. Finnish hygiene passport will be needed but we can train it for the right person. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5hr/week
- Salary: approx. 12-13 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Contract length: approx. 6 months, with good possibility to continue further as permanent employment
- Start date: Sometime during October
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has small grocery store, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car/bus. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Etsimme nyt kalankäsittelijää Föglöön, Ahvenanmaalle.

Työtehtävät pitävät sisällään monipuolisia toimintoja kalatehtaalla: kalan teurastusta, perkausta, "putsaamista", mädin keruuta, pakkaamista sekä raskaiden laatikoiden nostelua. Jos sinulla on trukin ajotaitoja, voit ajaa myös vastapainotrukkia. Työskentelyolosuhteet ovat viileät (noin +2 – +6 °C), joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Nordic Troutilla / Bolt.worksilla pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todella yhteisöllistä "työperhettä".

Kelle työ sopii?
Työ vaatii kohtalaista yleiskuntoa, kestävyyttä ja oma-aloitteisuutta. Aiempi kokemus kalankäsittelystä on plusa, mutta ei välttämätöntä – saat työhön perehdytyksen. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka nauttii luonnon läheisyydestä, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella saaristossa. Hygieniapassi vaaditaan, mutta voimme kouluttaa sen oikealle henkilölle. Sinun tulee pystyä kommunikoimaan englanniksi sujuvan tiimityöskentelyn takaamiseksi.

- Työaika: 20–37,5 t/vk
- Palkka: n. 12–13 €/h kokemuksesta riippuen
- Sopimuksen kesto: n. 6 kuukautta, hyvä mahdollisuus jatkua vakituisena työsuhteena
- Aloitus: Lokakuun aikana
- TES: Elintarvikealan työehtosopimus
- Työsuhde: Bolt.worksin kautta

Tietoa työpaikasta ja käytännön järjestelyistä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupunkipalveluita: saarella on pieni ruokakauppa, kirjasto ja kuntosali, kun taas muut palvelut löytyvät Maarianhaminasta (35 min lautalla + 30 min autolla/bussilla). Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee majoituksen lähellä ja Maarianhaminaan kulkee bussi. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: yleensä asut toisen työntekijän kanssa kaksiossa. Vuokra on noin 300–450 €, ja se voi sisältää tai olla sisältämättä sähköä/vettä asunnosta riippuen (saat tarkat tiedot työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout on Suomen kalatoimialan suurin toimija sekä edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, tukkukaupassa, tuonnissa, viennissä ja kasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuotta panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin ja työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändi tarjoaa laajan valikoiman herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Hae paikkaa pian: tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

The hotel has recently undergone a major renovation, including a brand-new reception area, restaurant, kitchen and conference facilities. Today, it offers a modern and welcoming environment where quality, comfort and guest satisfaction are at the center of everything we do.

At Restaurant HØST, we celebrate Nordic food traditions through carefully selected ingredients, seasonal menus and authentic flavors. We believe great meals bring people together, and we strive to create experiences that make our guests feel truly welcome.

• Ensure consistency, presentation and quality in every service
• Contribute ideas for menu development and seasonal offerings
• Follow HACCP procedures and maintain high hygiene standards
• Assist with food preparation, ordering and kitchen organization
• Work closely with colleagues in both the kitchen and front-of-house teams

Who We Are Looking For

• Ability to work efficiently in a busy kitchen environment
• A positive attitude and strong teamwork skills
• Flexible, reliable and willing to contribute wherever needed

What We Offer

• A modern and recently renovated workplace
• Opportunity to work with quality ingredients and seasonal menus
• A supportive and friendly team environment
• Varied working days with opportunities for professional development
• The opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of Restaurant HØST
• Competitive salary and employment conditions

If you are looking for your next opportunity in Norway and would like to work in a professional kitchen surrounded by beautiful nature, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of the team at Frich’s Hotel Surnadal.

  • Directing, training, and supervising kitchen staff on shift

  • Maintaining strict kitchen cleanliness, hygiene routines, and Danish food safety standards

  • Serving as the main kitchen contact point for FOH during service

  • Managing rush periods and high-volume delivery tickets calmly and efficiently

Requirements

  • Experience with pizza OR experience with management is required (experience managing a pizza kitchen is a strong advantage)

  • Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills

  • Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours

  • Comfortable working full shifts on your feet

  • Ready and available to work evening and weekend shifts

  • Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus)

What We Offer

jobs.title: Erfaren Kok / Kitchen Lead – Rays Chicken på Gamma Bar (Nordvest)
jobs.description:
Dansk Version - English version below

Erfaren Kok / Kitchen Lead – Rays Chicken på Gamma Bar (Nordvest)

Lokation: Gamma Bar, Nordvest, København

Ansættelsesform: Deltid / Fuldtid (Aftener og weekender)

Løn: 165 – 185 kr./time (baseret på erfaring)

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt

Om Rays Chicken

Hos Rays Chicken tager vi fried chicken seriøst. Vi laver ekstra sprød, kærnemælksmarineret fried chicken krydret med vores egen hemmelige krydderiblanding, som vi serverer for et livligt og fyldt Gamma Bar i København Nordvest.

Vi lægger i øjeblikket fundamentet for spændende fremtidig vækst og søger en dedikeret kok, der har lyst til at være en central del af den rejse.

Rollen

Vi søger en erfaren og pålidelig køkkenprofil, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift, opretholde en høj madkvalitet og bevare overblikket under travle perioder.

På de mere rolige vagter i starten af ugen har du fuld frihed og selvstændighed til at preppe og køre køkkenet alene. På de travle aftener styrer du servicen og leder køkkenets medhjælpere og opvaskere.

Vigtigste ansvarsområder:

  • Mise en place og service: Daglig klargøring, madlavning, fritering, anretning og sikring af en høj standard.

  • Selvstændige vagter: Ansvar for at drive køkkendriften solo på ugens tidlige vagter.

  • Teamledelse: Vagtplanlægning, instruktion og supervision af køkkenmedhjælpere og opvaskere.

  • Lager og indkøb: Styring af varebeholdning, varebestillinger, varemodtagelse samt daglig kontakt med leverandører.

  • Hygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed: Holde orden i køkkenets systemer og strengt overholde danske standarder for fødevarehygiejne og egenkontrol.

  • Digitale bestillinger: Effektiv betjening af takeaway- og online bestillingsplatforme.

  • Menuudvikling (Bonus): Vi ønsker aktivt at videreudvikle vores menu. Selvom det ikke er et krav, er interesse for opskriftsudvikling og kreative input et stort plus!

Hvem er du?

  • Erfaring: Minimum 3 års professionel køkkenerfaring.

  • Selvstændighed: Tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt uden direkte supervision og med stærke beslutningsevner.

  • Tempo og overblik: Meget velstruktureret og organiseret, og motiveres af at arbejde hurtigt og slå uret under travle perioder.

  • Fysisk form: Kan trives med at arbejde fulde vagter på benene.

  • Tilgængelighed: Klar og parat til at arbejde aften- og weekendvagter.

  • Kommunikation: Gode engelskkundskaber (dansk er en kærkommen bonus).

  • Passion: En ægte kærlighed til fried chicken og comfort food i høj kvalitet.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Timeløn mellem 165 og 185 kr./time baseret på erfaring.

  • En afslappet, lokalt forankret stemning på Gamma Bar i det kreative Nordvest.

  • Mulighed for at præge de daglige arbejdsgange og få indflydelse på fremtidige menu-tiltag i takt med, at konceptet udvider sig.

Sådan ansøger du

Send dit CV samt en kort motiveret ansøgning om, hvorfor du er det rette match for Rays Chicken til:

  • E-mail: work@diamondslice.dk

  • Emnefelt: Rays Chefs

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

------------------

English Version

Location: Gamma Bar, Nordvest, Copenhagen

Employment Type: Part-time / Full-time (Evenings & Weekends)

Pay: 165 – 185 DKK / hour (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as possible

About Rays Chicken

At Rays Chicken, we take fried chicken seriously. We make extra-crispy, buttermilk-brined fried chicken seasoned with our proprietary secret spice mix, serving the vibrant, packed crowd at the popular neighborhood spot Gamma Bar in Copenhagen Nordvest.

We are currently laying the groundwork for exciting future growth, and we are looking for a dedicated chef who wants to be an integral part of that journey.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and dependable kitchen professional who can take charge of daily kitchen operations, maintain high standards of quality, and keep a cool head during busy periods.

On slower early-week shifts, you will have full autonomy to prep and run the kitchen independently. On busier nights, you will lead the service and direct kitchen support staff.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Food Prep & Service: Daily mise en place, cooking, frying, plating, and ensuring high food quality.

  • Independent Shifts: Running kitchen operations solo during early-week shifts.

  • Team Leadership: Scheduling, guiding, and overseeing kitchen helpers and dishwashers.

  • Stock & Orders: Managing inventory, placing orders, receiving deliveries, and liaising with daily suppliers.

  • Hygiene & Safety: Keeping kitchen systems organized and strictly upholding Danish food safety and sanitation standards.

  • Digital Orders: Operating takeaway and online delivery platforms efficiently.

  • Menu Input (Bonus): We are actively looking to develop our menu. While not a strict requirement, an interest in recipe testing and creative input is a big plus!

What We Are Looking For:

  • Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional kitchen experience.

  • Independence: Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills.

  • Pace & Mindset: Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours.

  • Stamina: Comfortable working full shifts on your feet.

  • Availability: Ready and available to work evenings and weekends.

  • Communication: Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus).

  • Passion: A true love for fried chicken and high-quality comfort food.

What We Offer:

  • Hourly wage between 165 and 185 DKK/hour, commensurate with experience.

  • A relaxed, community-driven atmosphere at Gamma Bar in creative Nordvest.

  • Opportunity to shape operational routines and influence future menu offerings as the concept expands.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter telling us why you’d be a great fit for Rays Chicken to:

  • Email: work@diamondslice.dk

  • Subject line: Rays Chefs

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you!

Alle har relevant erfaring og bidrar med et stort nettverk.

Vi er Bemanningsxperten – vårt navn forplikter

Se vår hjemme side for mer info.

jobs.title: Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technician
jobs.description:
Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy is establishing its Finnish operations in Hyvinkää for the import, storage, logistics, sales and rental of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.

The Hyvinkää site includes approximately 10,000 m² of operating and storage area, approximately 300 m² of covered shed/workshop space, and additional container-based storage.

We are recruiting two Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technicians to support and manage the daily handling, inspection, maintenance, storage and inventory control of scaffolding equipment.

This is a technical logistics role requiring previous experience with scaffolding, construction equipment or comparable technical products.

Main responsibilities

\- Receiving, unloading and checking incoming deliveries.

\- Identifying scaffolding components and verifying quantities against shipment documents.

\- Inspecting equipment for damage, wear and defects.

\- Carrying out maintenance, repair and basic metalwork where required.

\- Organising scaffolding equipment in the yard, covered areas and storage containers.

\- Maintaining stock and inventory records.

\- Preparing and loading customer deliveries.

\- Maintaining tools, workshop and storage areas.

\- Supporting the development of warehouse and maintenance processes.

\- Following occupational safety and company procedures.

International coordination

The role includes regular communication with Affix manufacturing, sourcing, supply-chain and back-office teams outside Finland, including teams in India. Coordination may relate to shipments, packing lists, product codes, quality issues, damaged equipment, stock discrepancies, replacement components and delivery planning. Previous experience working with international manufacturing, logistics, sourcing, supply-chain or back-office teams is therefore important.

Required experience and skills

\- Relevant experience with scaffolding, construction equipment, structural-metal products or comparable technical equipment.

\- Experience in inspection, maintenance, repair, warehousing or logistics.

\- Ability to identify components and understand product compatibility.

\- Experience maintaining stock or inventory records.

\- Ability to read shipment and product documentation.

\- Sufficient English for daily international communication.

\- Ability to work independently and perform physically demanding work.

Considered an advantage

\- Experience with Ringlock, Cuplock or similar scaffolding systems.

\- Scaffolding-industry experience.

\- Metalworking or welding skills.

\- Forklift experience.

\- Experience with warehouse-management systems.

\- Car driving licence (Category B).

\- Experience in international import, export or container logistics.

Pre-employment requirement

\- A drug test will be conducted before a final job offer is made.

What we offer

\- Permanent, full-time employment.

\- A key role in establishing Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy's Finnish warehouse, maintenance and logistics operations.

\- International cooperation with Affix teams abroad.

\- Employment terms in accordance with Finnish legislation and the Commerce Sector Collective Agreement.

jobs.title: Operatiivinen päällikkö Ocean Bus Helsinkiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme innostunutta operatiivista päällikköä, joka haluaa olla mukana rakentamassa toimintaa alusta lähtien. Työ on monipuolista ja vauhdikasta: päivät ovat erilaisia, ja pääset vaikuttamaan toimintaan niin maalla kuin vesillä.

**Tehtävä**

Operatiivisena päällikkönä vastaat päivittäisen toiminnan turvallisuudesta, sujuvuudesta ja laadusta. Johdat tiimiä, suunnittelet toimintaa ja huolehdit siitä, että amfibiobussimme on liikennöintivalmiina.

Olet keskeisessä roolissa Ocean Busin Helsingin-toiminnan käynnistämisessä ja pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten toiminta kehittyy. Koska organisaatio on pieni, tehtäväkenttäsi on laaja ja osallistut tarvittaessa myös käytännön työhön.

Kokemusta henkilöstön johtamisesta ja operatiivisesta toiminnasta

Käytännönläheistä, vastuullista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

Mutkatonta asennetta ja valmiutta tarttua tehtäviin siellä, missä apua eniten tarvitaan

Varmuutta ja myönteistä otetta esihenkilötyöhön sekä kykyä saada tiimi mukaan

Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa; ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi

Joustavuutta työskennellä iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin erityisesti huhti-lokakuun sesonkikaudella

D- tai DE-luokan ajokortti, digitaalinen ajopiirturikortti ja ammattipätevyys (koodi 95) ja/tai vesiliikenteessä tarvittava pätevyys katsotaan eduksi

Tekninen osaaminen on suuri etu: osaat tunnistaa vikoja, tehdä pieniä huoltoja ja korjauksia sekä koordinoida ulkopuolisilla korjaamoilla tehtäviä töitä

**Tehtäviisi kuuluu**

Päivittäisestä toiminnasta, resursoinnista ja työvuorosuunnittelusta vastaaminen

Kuljettajien, oppaiden ja muun henkilöstön johtaminen, tukeminen ja motivointi

Operatiiviseen työhön osallistuminen

Amfibiobussin ajaminen maalla tai vesillä, jos sinulla on siihen tarvittava pätevyys

Voimassa olevien turvallisuusvaatimusten ja sisäisten ohjeidemme noudattamisesta huolehtiminen

Huoltojen ja säännöllisen kunnossapidon suunnittelu ja seuranta

Operatiivisten haasteiden ratkaiseminen ja nopea reagointi odottamattomiin tilanteisiin

Turvallisen ja onnistuneen kokemuksen varmistaminen sekä asiakkaille että henkilöstölle

**Tarjoamme**

Poikkeuksellisen työympäristön sekä maalla että vesillä

Keskeisen roolin Ocean Busin Helsingin-toiminnan käynnistämisessä

Hyvät mahdollisuudet vaikuttaa toimintaan ja kehittää sitä

Ocean Busin Tukholman ja Göteborgin tiimien sekä Stromman tuen ja kokemuksen

Vauhdikkaan työn innostuneiden työkavereiden kanssa

Palkkauksen ja työehdot sopimuksen mukaan

Perehdytämme sinut kattavasti toimintaan, turvallisuusohjeisiin ja amfibiobussin tekniikkaan. Ennen liikennöinnin alkua työskentelet tiiviisti Tukholman ja Göteborgin kokeneiden kollegoidemme sekä Stromman Helsingin tiimin kanssa.

jobs.title: ERP Service Manager – Wärtsilä
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day operational cadence of Wärtsiläs ERP Application Development (Minor Enhancements). Following a major ERP transformation, our development machinery is accelerating, and we need a hands-on ERP Service Manager to act as the key operational glue between internal business workgroups and our external development partner.

You will manage the daily operations of enhancement requests, keeping monthly planning cycles, 1-month sprints, and SAP release dates strictly on track. Your primary focus will be supporting Wärtsilä's organization in operational delivery and ensuring our external offshore partner achieves high throughput and quality.

What can we offer to you
- Permanent and full-time work contract as Academic Work consultant at Wärtsilä
- Salary: about 4,000–6,000 EUR/month based on your background and skillset. For highly experienced candidates, a higher salary level may also be negotiated.
- Impactful role: You will play a central part in running the critical ERP development engine of a global listed company.
- Flexibility: We offer a possibility to hybrid work. Preferred office is Helsinki, but offices also in Turku and Vaasa.
- International environment: Opportunity to work in a diverse, global team and continuously improve ways of working.

Work tasks

You will ensure that the development engine runs like clockwork, driving operational accountability across functional teams and external vendor resources.
- Overseeing daily operational development activities and sprint cadences across functional workgroups (e.g., Sales, Logistics, Finance).
- Managing the operations for enhancement requests (ServiceNow) delivery from planning to release.
- Supporting the monthly planning sessions, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release readiness checks.
- Serving as Wärtsilä's operational interface toward the external application development lead and offshore development team.
- Managing the development team capacity based on agreed allocations.
- Tracking the application development KPIs to continuously optimize throughput.

We are looking for

Mandatory requirements:
- Strong track record in a Service Manager, Delivery Manager, or similar operational lead role within IT or ERP environments.
- Hands-on experience with agile delivery methodologies, sprint management, and release cadences.
- Proven capability in managing external IT service providers and vendor deliverables.
- Excellent written and spoken English language skills.

Considered as an advantage:
- Experience in working with Indian offshore development partners and managing cross-cultural vendor environments.
- General understanding of SAP environments (e.g., S/4HANA, Fiori, BTP) and release management concepts.
- Finnish language skills.

Who succeeds in this role:

You are an organized, resilient, and proactive coordinator who takes full ownership of outcomes. You possess the assertiveness to challenge vendors on deliverables while remaining a constructive, supportive partner to internal stakeholders.

Recruitment timeline:
- Interviews with Academic Work: Weeks 39-40
- Interviews at Wärtsilä: Week 41
- Final decisions: Weeks 41-42

Practicalities
- Location and remote work policy: Primarily Helsinki (Salmisaari), but Vaasa or Turku are also possible. Hybrid model.
- Background checks: The selected candidate will undergo a standard security clearance (turvallisuusselvitys) by Finnish Security Intelligence Service.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING
jobs.description:
PRODUCTION OPERATOR – ROLLING & AUTOMATIC WELDING

Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

About the position

We are looking for a reliable and motivated Production Operator to join our production team. You will work with rolling of metal components and operation of an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine. You do not need to be a qualified welder or have a formal vocational education. The most important things are a good technical understanding, a willingness to learn, attention to quality and the ability to work safely and responsibly.

Your main responsibilities

Ø  Operate rolling machines and production equipment.

Ø  Operate and monitor an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine.

Ø  Set up and make minor adjustments to machines and equipment.

Ø  Monitor the production process and ensure stable production.

Ø  Carry out basic dimensional and visual quality checks.

Ø  Identify deviations and report problems to the team leader or supervisor.

Ø  Keep your workplace clean, organized and safe.

Ø  Follow company procedures for quality, safety and production.

What we are looking for

You do not need to be formally trained as a welder or have a vocational qualification. We are looking for someone who:

Ø  Has experience from manufacturing, metalworking, machine operation or a similar production environment – experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ø  Has a good technical understanding and enjoys working with machines.

Ø  Is practical, reliable and willing to learn.

Ø  Can work independently but also contributes positively to the team.

Ø  Has a strong focus on quality and safety.

Ø  Is comfortable with repetitive production tasks and physical work.

Ø  Can understand basic instructions, measurements and simple technical information.

Ø  Is able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Training and introduction

Full training will be provided. You will receive a structured introduction to the machines, production processes, quality requirements and safety procedures. Previous experience with automatic welding or rolling is therefore not essential.

What we offer

A stable position in a modern production environment.

Thorough training and support from experienced colleagues.

A practical and varied working day.

A workplace where safety, quality and teamwork are important.

Good opportunities to develop your technical skills and take on more responsibility over time.

Competitive salary and employment conditions according to qualifications and experience.

Working environment

You will become part of a team where we value cooperation, respect and a good working atmosphere. We believe that good production results are created by people who work together, help each other and take responsibility for their work.

Working hours

The position is day shift and 37 hours / week

Location

Tcomp | Tjæreborg Kompensatorfabrik A/S,  Kærvej 19, 6731 Tjæreborg, Denmark

 

How to apply

If you are interested in working in Denmark and believe this could be the right opportunity for you, we would like to hear from you. Please send your CV and a short application explaining your experience and motivation.

Applications should be sent to: ng.sandberg@tcomp.dk

Application deadline: 10-10-2026

Start date: 19-10-2026

About us

Tcomp is a Danish manufacturing company based in Tjæreborg, near Esbjerg. We specialize in metal production and manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and reliable solutions for our customers.

We are a hands-on company where teamwork, safety and respect for each other are important parts of everyday life. We believe that good results are created by skilled and committed people working together.

Important information for international applicants

This position is based in Denmark. Candidates from EU/EEA countries and Switzerland are welcome to apply. Candidates who require a residence and work permit must meet the applicable Danish immigration requirements.

jobs.title: Vil du bli en del av Ramudden Rådgivning?
jobs.employer: RAMUDDEN NORGE AS AVD TRØNDELAG SØR
jobs.description:
Ramudden Rådgivning ser etter en ny kollega til vår avdeling i Trondheim. Avdelingen jobber hver dag for å legge til rette for trygg og effektiv gjennomføring av arbeid på og langs vei. Nå søker vi etter deg som ønsker en variert arbeidshverdag og som motiveres av å bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som konsulent i Ramudden Rådgivning vil du jobbe med planlegging og utarbeidelse av løsninger for arbeid på og langs vei. Sikkerhet står sentralt i arbeidet, og løsningene du utarbeider skal bidra til å ivareta både de som utfører arbeidet og de som ferdes i området.

Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Utarbeidelse av arbeidsvarslingsplaner
  • Utarbeidelse og oppfølging av gravesøknader
  • Trafikkplanlegging

Hvem er du?

Erfaring fra lignende stilling eller bransje er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For oss er det viktigste at du er motivert for å lære, tar ansvar for egne oppgaver og bidrar til et godt samarbeid med både kolleger og kunder.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er opptatt av å levere god service og høy kvalitet
  • Er opptatt av sikkerhet i arbeidet
  • Tar initiativ og følger opp oppgaver på en god måte
  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig, både selvstendig og i team
  • Har god arbeidskapasitet og klarer å prioritere når det er mye å gjøre
  • Er komfortabel med å bruke PC som arbeidsverktøy og setter deg raskt inn i nye systemer

Hva vi tilbyr

  • Solid opplæring og gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Gode kollegaer og et faglig sterkt miljø
  • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Vil du bli en del av laget?

Vi vil gjerne høre fra deg!

Send inn søknad, eller ta kontakt dersom du har spørsmål om stillingen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.title: Semestervikariat för närvårdare, Majbergets servicehem (Borgå)
jobs.description:

Majbergets servicehem är ett servicehus med dygnet runt vård, där det huvudsakligen bor äldre med minnessjukdomar. Vi har sammanlagt 60 boenden i fyra olika grupphem. Vi gör miljön och deras omgivning så hemtrevlig som möjlig samt tar i helhet hand om deras välmående. Vi erbjuder dig trevliga kolleger och omsorgsfull introduktion. Vi satsar på arbetshälsa och säkerhet.

Vi uppskattar din förmåga att möjliggöra en personlig och god vardag för våra boenden genom att beakta deras individuella behov och önskemål. Vi förutsätter flexibilitet, en ansvarsfull attityd, samarbetsförmåga och en förmåga att fungera som medlem i en multiprofessionell arbetsgrupp. Vi uppskattar också erfarenhet av arbete med äldre, men det är inte en nödvändighet, eftersom just du kan vara vårt nya, stigande vårdproffs!

Om du identifierade dessa egenskaper hos dig själv, ta tag i den här intressanta möjligheten!

**Behörighetsvillkor** är närvårdarexamen eller tidigare primärskötarexamen samt registrering i registret över yrkesutbildade personer inom socialvården (JulkiSuosikki). I uppgifterna krävs goda muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i finska eller svenska. Om det inte finns sökande som uppfyller behörighetsvillkoren beaktar vi också närvårdarstuderande i rekryteringen. För studerande förutsätter vi ett studieutdrag.

Anställningsvillkoren följer arbets- och tjänstekollektivavtalet för social- och hälsovårdssektorn (SH-avtalet. Arbetet görs i två skift. De uppgiftsrelaterade lönerna för behöriga närvårdare är 2746,46 euro/månad, uppgiften tillämpas prövotid.

I uppgiften krävs vaccinationsskydd enligt smittskyddslagen § 48 samt tuberkulosutredning enligt smittskyddslagen § 55. I arbetsavtalsförhållanden som är längre än tre månader ska den som anställts förete ett straffregisterutdrag enligt lagen om tillsynen över social- och hälsovården (741/2023) innan arbetet påbörjas.

Sänd din ansökan så fort som möjligt, men senast 7.10.2026 kl. 13.00. Vi intervjuar och anställer redan under ansökningstiden. Närmare upplysningar ger chef för Majbergets servicehus Mathilda Rosenqvist, tel. 040 358 9922 eller mathilda.rosenqvist@itauusimaa.fi.

jobs.title: Machinist, Bluefors Oy
jobs.description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish high-tech company based in Helsinki, working in the field of quantum technology. The company designs and manufactures cryogenic measurement systems used in research and technology development around the world.

As a Machinist at Bluefors, you will manufacture a variety of precision components from materials such as copper, aluminum, brass, stainless steel, and POM plastic. The work is varied and includes producing small batches as well as implementing different machining solutions.

We value a careful and quality-oriented approach, an interest in machining, and a willingness to develop your skills in the role. Previous experience in CNC machining is important, but you do not need to have all the required skills from day one.

Your Responsibilities

As a Machinist, you will work as part of the Bluefors production team, manufacturing components for quantum technology systems. Your responsibilities will include operating and setting up CNC milling machines and manufacturing a variety of components in small batches. You will machine materials such as copper, stainless steel, brass, aluminum, and POM plastic. You will read and interpret technical drawings and machining programs and work accordingly. In addition, you will measure the components you manufacture, inspect their quality, and ensure that they meet the required specifications. You will also contribute to maintaining a clean, organized, and safe working environment and ensuring smooth production.

Requirements

- Previous experience in CNC machining and basic knowledge of machine operation and setup
- Ability to read and work according to technical drawings
- A careful and precise approach to work, with an interest in producing high-quality results
- Willingness to learn new skills and develop as a machinist
- Good teamwork skills and a proactive attitude

We Also Consider the Following an Advantage

- Experience with 5-axis machining and DMG Mori milling machines
- Familiarity with Heidenhain controls
- Experience with Mastercam or other CAM software
- Experience machining copper, brass, or other non-ferrous metals, as well as precision components
- Previous experience in small-batch production or in the technical manufacturing industry

The position is full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, working in a two-shift system. The shift cycle consists of three weeks: two weeks on the day shift (Monday to Friday) and one week on the evening shift (Monday to Thursday, with Fridays off). The evening shift runs from 2:00 PM to midnight.

The selected candidate will initially be employed by Barona Teollisuus Oy on a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of continuing in a longer-term position.

If you are interested in the position and would like to develop your skills as a Machinist as part of the Bluefors production team, submit your application today using the link provided in the job advertisement. We will review applications throughout the recruitment process.

For more information about the position, please contact Ari Kumlander by email at ari.kumlander@barona.fi. Please note that, due to data protection regulations, applications cannot be submitted by email.

jobs.title: Rustfri Smed
jobs.description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.
