jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

  • Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million
  • Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics
  • Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
  • Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements
  • Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
  • Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
  • Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance
  • Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

  • Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option
  • Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
  • The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently
  • The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers
  • The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
  • The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications
  • A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

  • A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development
  • A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
  • Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
  • Good opportunities for both professional and personal development
  • Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance
  • A good canteen scheme and active staff association
  • An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.title: Data Scientist for Department of Biology
jobs.description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Bliv vores nye servicemedarbejder til Orana i Rynkeby og Engbo i Kerteminde
jobs.description:
Coor søger en dedikeret servicemedarbejder til rengøring, hvor du er med til at sikre rene omgivelser.

Der er tale om 2 pladser, Orana i Rykeby og Engbo i Kerteminde.

Vi forventer:

  • du har rengøringserfaring fra tidligere job

  • du er mødestabil, omhyggelig og kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • serviceminded og empatisk

Arbejdssted og arbejdstider:

  • Sted: Engbo Kerteminde og Orana Rynkeby Fyn

  • Antal timer: 28

  • Arbejdstid: Mellem 05.00 og 12.30

Hos Coor får du:

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn i henhold til Serviceoverenskomsten (DI og 3F). Ved at arbejde på Serviceoverenskomsten er du sikret, at arbejde under lovlige og ordnede forhold. Vi stræber efter at arbejde efter de nyeste arbejdsprincipper, så vi sikrer, at du ikke slider unødigt på din krop når du arbejder hos Coor.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring: Du er sikret pension fra første arbejdsdag, og hvis du får brug for hurtig behandling hos fx fysioterapeut, kan du benytte sundhedsforsikringen.

Hvad sker der herfra? Vi afholder løbende samtaler og fjerner opslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger på mail og opfordrer dig til at undlade foto på dit ansøgning/CV, da vi foretrækker en upartisk rekrutteringsproces.

jobs.title: Medarbejder til HR, administration eller sociale medier
jobs.description:
AT El- og Entreprise ApS søger en ny kollega, der kan hjælpe med at få hverdagen på kontoret til at fungere. Stillingen kan tilpasses dine kompetencer og interesser, uanset om du især har erfaring med HR, administration eller sociale medier.

Dine opgaver kan blandt andet være at koordinere samtaler og hjælpe med onboarding af nye medarbejdere, håndtere administrative opgaver og korrespondance eller planlægge og udarbejde indhold til vores sociale medier. Vi aftaler det nærmere indhold af stillingen sammen med den rette kandidat.

Vi forestiller os, at du arbejder struktureret, kommunikerer klart og trives med både selvstændige opgaver og samarbejde med andre. Erfaring fra en håndværks- eller entreprenørvirksomhed er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV

ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΑΝΑΤΙΘΕΝΤΑΙ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΠΡΟΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΟ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗΣ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ. ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΕΙ ΕΙΔΙΚΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΓΙΑ ΝΑ ΙΣΙΩΣΕΙ ΛΑΜΑΡΙΝΕΣ, ΝΑ ΔΙΟΡΘΩΣΕΙ ΤΟ ΠΛΑΙΣΙΟ ΚΑΙ ΝΑ ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΕΙ ΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΦΑΝΕΙΑ ΓΙΑ ΒΑΦΗ, ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΖΟΝΤΑΣ ΤΗΝ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΝ ΑΙΣΘΗΤΙΚΗ ΤΟΥ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΟΣ. , ΓΝΩΡΙΖΕΙ ΝΑ ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΕΙ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ ΟΠΩΣ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ, ΑΝΥΨΩΤΙΚΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΤΙΚΟ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟ. ΕΠΑΛΗΘΕΥΕΙ ΟΤΙ ΟΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΕΣ ΕΧΟΥΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΤΥΧΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΤΙ ΤΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΑ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΗ ΓΙΑ ΧΡΗΣΗ.   , EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

jobs.title: ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΕΑΣ ΣΕ ΑΡΧΙΤΕΚΤΟΝΙΚΟ ΓΡΑΦΕΙΟ
jobs.description: ΑΡΧΙΤΕΚΤΟΝΙΚΟ ΓΡΑΦΕΙΟ ΣΤΗ ΠΑΦΟ ΖΗΤΑ ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΕΑ ΓΙΑ ΠΛΗΡΗ ΑΠΑΣΧΟΛΗΣΗ. Η ΘΕΣΗ ΠΕΡΙΛΑΜΒΑΝΕΙ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΤΟΥ ΓΡΑΦΕΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΤΟΝΙΣΜΟ ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ. ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΑ: - ΥΠΟΔΟΧΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΛΕΦΩΝΙΚΗ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ - ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΗΣΗ EMAILS ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΛΟΓΡΑΦΙΑΣ - ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΡΑΝΤΕΒΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ - ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΕ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΕΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΓΡΑΦΕΙΟΥ - ΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΑΡΧΕΙΟΘΕΤΗΣΗ , ΑΠΑΡΑΙΤΗΤΑ ΠΡΟΣΟΝΤΑ: - ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΩΝ - ΓΝΩΣΗ Η/Υ (WORD, EXCEL, EMAIL) - ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ - ΕΥΧΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PANAYIOTA PANAYI , ppanayi@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: Η ΕΤΑΙΡΕΙΑ M.P ARCHITECT L.L.C ΜΕ ΕΔΡΑ ΤΗΝ ΠΑΦΟ ΖΗΤΑ ΝΑ ΕΝΤΑΞΕΙ ΣΤΗΝ ΟΜΑΔΑ ΤΗΣ ΑΡΧΙΤΕΚΤΟΝΑ ΓΙΑ ΣΥΜΜΕΤΟΧΗ ΣΤΟΝ ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΜΟ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΝ ΥΛΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΑΡΧΙΤΕΚΤΟΝΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΩΝ.  ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΑ ΘΕΣΗΣ: ΑΡΧΙΤΕΚΤΟΝΙΚΟΣ ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΜΟΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΜΕΛΕΤΩΝ ΕΚΠΟΝΗΣΗ ΑΡΧΙΤΕΚΤΟΝΙΚΩΝ ΣΧΕΔΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗΣ ΤΕΚΜΗΡΙΩΣΗΣ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΜΕ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΥΣ, ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΕΡΓΟΛΑΒΟΥΣ ΣΥΜΜΕΤΟΧΗ ΣΤΗ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΑ ΑΔΕΙΟΔΟΤΗΣΗΣ ΕΡΓΩΝ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΕΡΓΩΝ ΚΑΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΕΞΕΛΙΞΗ ΠΡΟΟΠΤΙΚΕΣ ΕΠΑΓΓΕΛΜΑΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΞΕΛΙΞΗΣ ΑΝΤΑΓΩΝΙΣΤΙΚΟ ΠΑΚΕΤΟ ΑΠΟΔΟΧΩΝ Η ΕΤΑΙΡΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΦΕΡΕΙ ΣΥΓΧΡΟΝΟ ΚΑΙ ΔΗΜΙΟΥΡΓΙΚΟ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ , ΑΠΑΡΑΙΤΗΤΑ ΠΡΟΣΟΝΤΑ: ΠΤΥΧΙΟ ΑΡΧΙΤΕΚΤΟΝΙΚΗΣ ΠΟΛΥ ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΤΙΚΩΝ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΩΝ (AUTOCAD, SKETCHUP H ΠΑΡΟΜΙΑ) ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΗΣ ΓΛΩΣΣΑΣ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ ΕΠΑΓΓΕΛΜΑΤΙΣΜΟΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ  , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PANAYIOTA PANAYI , ppanayi@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΠΩΛΗΣΕΙΣ Ή ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  ΜΕ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΟ ΟΧΗΜΑ.  ΓΙΑ FULL-TIME + PART-T , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager-Multi Family Offices&Professional Intermediar (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries (M/F)

Luxembourg | req786

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Developer to join our team, focusing on Multi/Single Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and cultivating relationships with professional intermediaries and clients, driving business growth, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional service. The position is based in Luxembourg and you will report to the Head of Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries.

Your next challenge:

• Contribute to the growth strategy and to the development of the value proposition of the bank
• Conduct research to identify business opportunities with new customers
• Develop a growth strategy, foster and build both long-term and trustworthy customer relationships with professional intermediaries, including law firms, fiduciaries, and family offices (B2B and B2C)
• Maintain an extensive knowledge of the current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate possible commercial opportunities for the customers
• Collaborate across business lines to help you develop new business leads
• Attend and coordinate events (seminars, conferences)
• Make use of the internal CRM to keep track on your business development activities

Your skills:

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in a front function within the banking or financial services sector
• A strong international network of MFO/SFO & Professional Intermediaries
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance
• Solid understanding of wealth structuring, wealth management product and services
• Excellent interpersonal skills, an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to build sustainable relationships
• Proven negotiation skills and the ability to close deals
• A high level of integrity and ethics
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance.
• A relevant University background in Finance
• Fluent in English and French, any other language is seen as an advantage (for example : German, Italian)
• Strongly client- and results-oriented
• Rigorous, organized and methodical in customer approach actions
• Motivated to be part of a great team
• Willing and able to travel

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what's next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term)

BBH is currently recruiting a Depositary Services Senior Representative to join our dynamic Depositary Services team. In this key role you will be responsible for the coordination and performance of tasks relating to the supervision of assets of Real Estate, Private Debt and Private Equity funds. In addition, you will assess, analyze, and monitor risks and control issues for the products and services falling under the scope of the Depositary obligations.  You will have a high level of technical acumen and analytical skills in order to foster a solution orientated and consultative approach to performing our Depositary obligations

Key Responsibilities:

• Gather and review documentation received in relation to recordkeeping and verification of ownership of real assets (real estate, private debt, private equity, fund of funds) and proactively monitor the status and completion of those tasks and follow up to obtain required client documentation
• Build Strong relationships with Clients and have the knowledge and ability to explain the regulatory drivers behind these requirements
• Review and/or execute daily cash flow monitoring activities by gathering information and reviewing exceptions
• Support team in determining appropriate resolutions to new regulatory obligations.
• Monitor, report, define and document critical internal control processes.
• Formulate corrective actions, where applicable, to resolve identified exceptions.
• Coordinate internal and external projects in an efficient and thorough manner.
• Prepare and review documentation for regulators and external auditors
• Support Team on questions from clients, regulators, external auditors and/or BBH internal departments. Communicate clearly with business area contacts as well as other areas of the Bank
• Maintain effective working relationships at relevant levels with other departments
• Escalate within the team significant audit issues, set direction/communicate proposed manner of resolution of audit issues and concerns that have a significant impact
• Develop and maintain peer relationships to share best practices

Qualifications:

1. Education level and/ or experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting
• 2 to 4 years' experience working within the alternative funds industry or relevant business line experience
• Proficient Business level German skills are considered as an advantage

2. Knowledge and skills

• Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to present complex and sensitive issues
• Technical skills in alternatives and regulation
• Good knowledge in European and local regulatory requirements
• Demonstrates Microsoft Office skills (with emphasis placed on Excel proficiency).
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems
• Ability to identify, escalate and resolve a problem.
• Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written skills.
• Ability to manage time efficiently and effectively.
• Organizational skills and detail-oriented.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
• Ability to manage and inspire people

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn't meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development-so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice-creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often-pushing the boundaries of innovation.  As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

Valuation & Modelling (Senior) Manager - Infrastructure & Private Markets

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Valuation & Modelling (Senior) Manager - Infrastructure & Private Markets. What if it was you?

Who we are: We are the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg, providing audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice to a wide variety of clients. To make it happen, we count on the expertise of over 3,700 people from more than 94 different countries, who strive every day to reach excellence and team up to solve important problems through innovative solutions. We value diverse and singular career paths, embrace everyone's unique self and encourage our People to fuel their potential in a work environment that is inclusive, stimulating, and motivating.  

Your mission

A career in our Valuation & Modelling Services practice will provide you with the opportunity to work at the forefront of valuation, financial modelling, and investment analysis across private markets.

As part of the largest and most qualified dedicated valuation and modelling team in Luxembourg, you will advise leading alternative investment managers, institutional investors, infrastructure funds, private equity sponsors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, and multinational corporations on complex valuation and modelling matters throughout the investment lifecycle.
Recognised as a centre of excellence for portfolio valuation, our team delivers independent valuations and reviews of investment portfolios, businesses, complex securities, financial instruments, and intangible assets to support financial and investor reporting, regulatory compliance, governance, and strategic decision-making.

Our team also works closely with PwC Luxembourg's market-leading Assurance practice, supporting a broad range of valuation matters across audit engagements. This provides our professionals with unique exposure to valuation challenges across multiple asset classes, investment structures, and industries, while helping maintain the highest standards of quality, consistency, and professional rigour.
Our professionals come from diverse backgrounds, including leading asset managers, infrastructure investors, private equity firms, valuation boutiques, advisory practices, and audit firms. Together, we combine deep technical expertise with practical investment experience to help clients navigate increasingly sophisticated valuation challenges across infrastructure, private equity, venture capital, private debt, real estate, and other alternative asset classes.

Our multidisciplinary experience allows us to engage confidently with investment professionals, valuation committees, risk teams, boards of directors, external auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders to deliver robust, independent, and insightful analyses that support informed decision-making.

Be a part of our team where you will:

• Lead and oversee complex valuation and modelling engagements across private equity, infrastructure, venture capital, private debt, real estate, and other private market asset classes;
• Manage project teams and client relationships, ensuring high-quality delivery and exceptional client service throughout the engagement lifecycle;
• Review and challenge valuation analyses, financial models, methodologies, assumptions, and conclusions prepared by team members;
• Advise clients on complex valuation matters related to financial reporting, investor reporting, regulatory compliance, transactions, governance, and strategic decision-making;
• Lead discussions with investment professionals, boards, valuation committees, auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders;
• Apply and interpret valuation requirements under IPEV, IFRS, US GAAP, and Lux GAAP frameworks;
• Support audit engagements through the provision of valuation expertise and technical reviews;
• Develop thought leadership on emerging valuation practices, market developments, and industry trends;
• Coach, mentor, and develop junior professionals, helping them build strong technical and professional capabilities;
• Contribute to recruitment, performance management, and the continued growth of the team;
• Identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and develop new business opportunities;
• Support the preparation of proposals, pitches, thought leadership, and other business development initiatives;
• Collaborate across PwC service lines to deliver multidisciplinary solutions to clients;
• Drive innovation and continuous improvement in valuation methodologies, modelling approaches, and delivery processes;
• Contribute to the strategic growth and market positioning of PwC Luxembourg's Infrastructure & Private Markets Valuation & Modelling practice.

Let's talk about you. If you...

• Hold a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field;
• Possess strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with excellent command of English — German and French are strong assets, and any other European language is considered valuable;
• Have 6–11 years of professional experience in Valuation & Modelling, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Infrastructure Advisory, Portfolio Valuation, Audit, or a related field;
• Have relevant experience gained within a Big Four firm, professional services firm, specialist valuation boutique, asset manager, institutional investor, infrastructure fund, AIFM, pension fund, sovereign wealth fund, or investment firm;
• Have significant exposure to private capital investments, including private equity, infrastructure, venture capital, private debt, real estate, or energy transition assets;
• Experience in infrastructure valuation, project finance modelling, investment appraisal, transaction analysis, or asset-level financial modelling would be highly valued;
• Demonstrate advanced valuation and financial modelling capabilities, including complex capital structures and illiquid investments;
• Possess strong knowledge of IPEV Guidelines, IFRS, US GAAP, and/or Lux GAAP valuation requirements;
• Have experience leading engagements from proposal stage through execution and final delivery;
• Have successfully managed teams and coached junior professionals in a professional services or investment environment;
• Demonstrate a strong commercial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, develop client relationships, and contribute to business development initiatives;
• Have experience managing multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high quality standards;

Job Description

The Transport Manager acts as the operational backbone and system Subject Matter Expert (SME) for outbound transportation execution across the EMENA network at Avery Dennison. Reporting to the Head of Transportation, this role bridges strategic regional transport objectives with daily execution—overseeing both direct customer deliveries and internal site movements.
The position combines technical system ownership (TRAX TMS & QAD ERP), master data governance, order/lead-time investigations, carrier integration management, and operational standardization across all regional manufacturing plants and distribution centers.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Transport System Governance & Network Master Data

• Lead-Time & Schedule Administration: Configure, validate, and maintain transport lead-time matrices per shipping site, destination country, and individual ship-to customer location across EMENA.
• Order Cut-Off & Departure Execution: Establish and maintain order entry cut-off times and daily departure schedules to align plant dispatch capabilities with carrier collection slots.
• Routing & Execution Logic: Maintain and optimize TRAX routing rules, logic parameters, and ship-via assignment rules per ship-to destination.
• Carrier & Partner Onboarding: Manage system setup and integration parameters for new logistics service providers following carrier tender allocation or carrier switches; maintain manual partner addresses as required.
• Documentation & Carrier EDI: Setup specific delivery instructions per ship-to to ensure dynamic printing on Weight-Lists and seamless EDI transmission to carriers; configure specialized invoicing setups (e.g., single weight-list per order rule).
• Network Availability & Calendars: Update and govern site and customer holiday closures to prevent system tendering errors and inaccurate delivery commitments.

2. ERP Integration & Analytical Investigations

• Custom Shipping Setup: Configure specialized shipping requirements in QAD, including the setup of "special pallet packlist" rules per ship-to upon request from Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
• Lead-Time Root Cause Analysis: Conduct structured investigations into lead-time performance and anomalies (segmented by site, country, and ship-to) to resolve bottlenecks.
• Order Diagnostics: Lead end-to-end technical and operational investigations on delayed or stuck orders to identify system vs. operational execution root causes.

3. Outbound Network Governance & Service Excellence

• Oversee daily outbound freight flows, ensuring compliance with defined SLAs for customer deliveries and inter-site transfers.
• Track and report operational performance metrics (OTIF, OTD, weight-list compliance).
• Serve as the primary regional escalation contact for complex transport system failures, carrier delivery exceptions, and site logistics disruptions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Experience (CSR), Manufacturing Operations, Warehouse Logistics, and Carriers.
Please note it's a 24 month contract.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Systems Engineering.
• Experience: 5+ years of operational transportation management or logistics systems experience within a complex, multi-site European/EMENA environment.
• Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with TRAX TMS and QAD ERP transport modules (or equivalent enterprise TMS/ERP combinations); solid understanding of carrier EDI integrations and weight-list/invoicing documentation.
• Skills: Strong analytical capabilities (root-cause analysis on orders and lead-times), continuous improvement mindset, cross-functional communication.
• Languages: Professional fluency in English; additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Polish) are an advantage.

Additional Information

• Flexibility & On-site Perks: Embrace flexible work arrangements for white-collar roles. Enjoy a subsidized canteen, an annual gift for employees and children, and a mobile app that centralizes services, benefits, vouchers, and discounts.

To help us process your application quickly, please upload your CV in either PDF or Word format. We also kindly ask that you submit your resume in the same language as this job posting.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
As part of the Biotechnology Unit, and particularly the Bioformulation Group, you will contribute to the machine learning assisted structure-function study of soluble dietary fibres (galactomannans) isolated from underexplored leguminous seed bioresources in the framework of the ENTANGLE FNR funded project. You will develop clean label procedures to extract and isolate galactomannans from forage legume seed biomass such as alfalfa and clover. In addition, the successful candidate is expected to determine the technofunctional and prebiotic potential of native and enzymatically modified derivatives benchmarked to commercial biopolymer targets.

As a Postdoctoral Researcher, you will mainly be responsible for:
• Extracting, isolating and purifying galactomannans from forage legume seeds
• Enzymatically tailor the chemical structure and technofunctional profile of native galactomannans
• Determine the structure conformational, technological and prebiotic potential of the native and modified galactomannans and
• Promoting and disseminating your research work through high-quality scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals, oral and poster presentations in conferences, and patents.
If you are specialised in food biopolymers, colloids science, and/or food process engineering, with a strong foundation in soft-matter physics and a focus on understanding and tailoring structure–property–function relationships for innovative food applications, please apply and join our new and dynamic team.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The University's main Library, the Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), located in the heart of the Belval campus, is much more than a library: it is a hub of innovation and knowledge designed to foster research, learning, collaboration and outreach. Its building, a true architectural masterpiece, combines the restructuring of an old industrial hall with bold contemporary design, and spans 14,000 m², 10.7 km of shelving and more a thousand working spaces. It stands as a prestigious façade for Luxembourg and for the University of Luxembourg, reflecting the ambition and academic excellence of both the country and the institution. Equipped with modern infrastructure and advanced technologies, the LLC offers a unique environment where students, researchers, and professionals come together to create, share and innovate. Complementing the central role of the LLC in Belval, a library hub specialising in European law research is located in the Weicker building, benefiting from its proximity to European institutions and Luxembourg's financial district.

Your role
We are looking for a specialist in the Library's strategic growth area of research support and information skills training. Based in Belval, with the opportunity to offer support and training at our other campus locations in Luxembourg, the person will be involved in developing new innovative research support services around research data management, in collaboration with colleagues and senior managers. You will also contribute to developing the information skills training programmes in partnership with the learning and teaching centres of the University. You will help to promote the development of the Library's emerging research support services.
Key Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the development and implementation of research support services, policies, and future service planning
• Provide specialist support for the University's research activities, with a priority on research data management, and additional support around open science, open access, bibliometrics, and scholarly communication
• Assist with the development and management of institutional data and publishing repositories, e.g. contributing to efforts in data quality, compliance with funder requirements, and timely deposit of research outputs
• Support day to day operations of the Library's Research Support team, including responding to enquiries and maintaining service documentation
• Develop and deliver training, workshops, and one to one consultations for researchers, students - bachelor, master and doctoral, and academic research support staff
• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with researchers and students, as well as across the Library and research support services, to establish requirements and inform service delivery
• Promote all research support services of the Library
• Contribute to the development of Library policies and practices
It is anticipated that 80% of the role involves outreach and development of research support services, and 20% of the role involves developing and providing training in information skills topics, e.g. research data management, information literacy and use of digital tools.

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent professional experience in an academic, research, digital, or information-intensive environment
• 3+ years' experience in research support environments with a focus on research data management
• In depth knowledge in research data management and related trends
• Library and/or teaching experience is an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to engage diverse stakeholders and promote services
• A PhD is considered an asset
• Full proficiency in English; good knowledge of French or German would be an asset

Vous êtes en charge de la gestion des contrats d'assurance vie individuelle :

• Vous assurez la gestion administrative des contrats d'assurance vie du particulier tout au long de leur cycle de vie ;

• Vous êtes force de proposition pour l'amélioration continue des processus et de l'organisation du travail.

Vous êtes en charge des activités KYC / Compliance AML-FT

• Vous veillez à la bonne application de la politique Compliance du Groupe au sein de l'activité Vie ;
• Vous assurez la collecte, l'analyse et la mise à jour des informations et documents requis dans le cadre des obligations de connaissance client (KYC) ;
• Vous réalisez les revues périodiques des clients conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux procédures internes ;

• Vous participez aux projets de mise en conformité et aux évolutions réglementaires impactant l'activité ;

Votre profil

• Vous disposez d'une bonne connaissance des exigences réglementaires liées au KYC ainsi qu'à la lutte contre le blanchiment de capitaux et le financement du terrorisme ;
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais. La connaissance du luxembourgeois ou de l'allemand constitue un atout ;
• Vous êtes doté(e) d'un excellent sens de l'organisation et d'un esprit d'analyse développé ;
• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de discernement dans le traitement des dossiers ;
• Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités relationnelles et rédactionnelles ;
• Vous êtes orienté(e) client, qualité de service et recherche de solutions ;
• Vous faites preuve d'adaptabilité dans un environnement en constante évolution.

Nous offrons

• En rejoignant notre Groupe, vous bénéficierez, entre autres, des avantages suivants :
• Un environnement de travail multiculturel, apprenant et innovant ;
• Un système d'horaires flexibles ;
• Un restaurant d'entreprise à tarif préférentiel ;
• Une salle de sport avec coach ;
• Une conciergerie ;
• L'opportunité d'évoluer dans une fonction alliant expertise opérationnelle, relation client et conformité réglementaire ;
• Un cadre favorisant le développement des compétences et l'évolution professionnelle.

Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer excellence opérationnelle et maîtrise des enjeux réglementaires, en assurant à la fois une gestion efficace des contrats d'assurance vie et la conformité des dossiers clients aux exigences AML/KYC. Elle contribuera ainsi directement à la qualité de service offerte aux clients et à la maîtrise des risques de l'activité Vie.

En collaboration avec l'équipe pluridisciplinaire et les familles, tu veilles à offrir un accompagnement individualisé et de qualité.  

Tes missions:

• Accompagner les résidents et leurs familles
• Tu assures une prise en charge individualisée et bienveillante, tout en favorisant une relation de confiance avec les résidents et leurs proches.

• Tu réalises les soins d'hygiène relevant de ta fonction dans le respect de la dignité, du rythme et des capacités de chaque résident.

• Tu veilles au bon déroulement des accompagnements, observes l'évolution des besoins et transmets les informations utiles à l'équipe.
• Maintenir l'autonomie et favoriser la participation
• Tu proposes et encadres des activités adaptées et encourages les résidents à participer aux actes de la vie quotidienne selon leurs ressources.

Ton profil:

• Diplôme ou certificat d'agent d'accompagnement au quotidien reconnu au Luxembourg ;
• Expérience dans le domaine psychogériatrique ;
• Maîtrise d'au moins deux langues usuelles du Luxembourg, dont le luxembourgeois obligatoire ;
• Permis de conduire B.

Tes atouts:

• Expérience dans l'accompagnement de personnes atteintes d'une forme de démence ;
• Connaissance du fonctionnement de l'assurance dépendance ;
• Capacité à organiser ton travail et à gérer les priorités ;
• Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire ;
• Esprit d'initiative, flexibilité et capacité à faire face aux situations exigeantes ;
• Aisance dans les contacts humains et sens des valeurs et de l'éthique ;

• Toute langue supplémentaire constitue un avantage.Au-delà de tes compétences, nous recherchons une posture qui…

• place l'humain au cœur de ses actions.

• allie autonomie, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités.

Ce que nous offrons:

Rejoindre l'ala, c'est évoluer dans un environnement de travail humain, engagé et stimulant, où chaque collaborateur peut trouver sa place, développer ses compétences et contribuer concrètement à un accompagnement de qualité. jobs.title: Strategic Finance, Corporate
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a member of the Corporate Finance team, you'll own the consolidated view of Notion's financial performance — the corporate model, the monthly close-to-reporting cycle, and the numbers that reach our executive team, Board of Directors, and investors. You'll immediately take ownership of core corporate FP&A workstreams, which include the consolidated P&L forecast, the monthly budget-vs-actual and reforecast cycles, and the planning systems that produce them.

 

This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the consolidated corporate model and the monthly reporting cadence — close actuals, budget-vs-actual, and the rolling reforecast — and connect reported performance to the revenue, headcount, and spend drivers behind it

 - Maintain and evolve Notion's planning system, primarily Pigment: maintain the corporate model structure, run the monthly data loads and scenario snapshots, reconcile the P&L, headcount, and departmental views, and build new models and views as the business changes

 - Assist in preparing and delivering presentations that effectively communicate Notion's financial performance and outlook to Notion's executive team, Board of Directors, and investors

 - Raise the quality and scalability of our reporting infrastructure, using AI, automation, and stronger data workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and surface insights faster — challenging existing processes and data inconsistencies that get in the way

 - Work cross-functionally across Accounting, BizTech, People, and our Business Partnership (BP) Finance team to keep source data, mappings, and the chart of accounts aligned as operating complexity grows — tightening the handoffs between close and forecast along the way




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2-5 years of experience across Investment Banking, Private Equity, Big 4, or corporate FP&A / Strategic Finance at a high-growth SaaS technology company

 - Demonstrated ability to build and own rigorous financial models, ideally a three-statement or consolidated operating model for a recurring-revenue or SaaS business

 - Hands-on experience with an enterprise planning tool (Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive, Vena) or a clear track record of becoming fluent in new systems quickly

 - Strong analytical judgment and the ability to move from detailed data to a clear point of view on performance, risks, and opportunities

 - Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and communicate clearly with both financial and non-financial audiences

 - Ability to build finance processes from scratch and improve existing ones with a lens on long-term scalability and sustainability




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $150,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Data Foundations team builds and operates the batch and streaming infrastructure behind our product features, analytics, search, and AI experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to shape the next generation of this platform as Notion serves larger customers, expands globally, and supports more data-intensive products. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems, set direction, build and develop a high-performing team, and lead multi-quarter initiatives across our data lake, streaming, distributed-compute, governance, and reliability systems. You’ll stay close to critical technical decisions while creating clear ownership, growing engineers and technical leaders, and helping the team execute as one—partnering closely with Data Engineering, Data Product, Search, AI, Infrastructure, and Security.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set the direction for Data Foundations. Turn ambiguous company and customer needs into a clear multi-quarter strategy across the data lake, streaming, distributed compute, governance, and platform reliability—and align engineers and partner teams around it.

 - Build and develop a high-performing team. Attract strong engineers, set clear expectations, grow technical leaders, and create an environment of ownership, direct feedback, and accountability.

 - Lead the team’s hardest initiatives from idea to operation. Ensure complex work has strong technical ownership, de-risk architectures through prototypes, break work into shippable milestones, and coordinate execution across engineers and teams.

 - Make Notion’s data platform enterprise-ready. Guide the team toward durable foundations for external key management, data residency, access controls, lifecycle management, and governance without creating separate systems for every requirement.

 - Raise reliability, simplicity, and cost efficiency. Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps, establish clear service ownership, and lead migrations that make Kafka, Debezium, S3/Iceberg, Spark, EMR, Athena, and related systems easier to operate at scale.

 - Multiply the engineering organization. Establish reusable abstractions and paved paths, delegate meaningful ownership, raise the quality of technical decisions, and scale expertise through coaching, documentation, tooling, design reviews, and direct collaboration.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Deep data-platform expertise. You have designed and operated large-scale batch and streaming systems and can reason across storage, compute, ingestion, orchestration, serving, governance, and production operations.

 - Direction-setting leadership. You have led a Data Platform or infrastructure team through multi-quarter work—finding the right problems, defining a strategy, sequencing execution, and driving decisions with long-term consequences.

 - Team-building and talent development. You have attracted strong engineers, grown people across career stages, developed technical leaders, and created clarity when expectations or performance needed to change.

 - Hands-on engineering judgment. You stay close to critical systems and designs and know when to prototype, simplify, buy, build, or migrate. You can go deep while preserving ownership for the engineers leading the work.

 - Platform-product thinking. You understand the needs behind partner requests and turn repeated patterns into safe, ergonomic, self-serve capabilities rather than accumulating bespoke solutions.

 - Organizational influence. You create clarity across team boundaries, surface uncomfortable technical or organizational risks early, and help engineers do their best work through strong context, delegation, feedback, and coaching.

 - You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, move faster, and build more creatively.




THE SYSTEMS AND PROBLEMS YOU MAY LEAD

 - Evolving Notion’s data lake toward an S3 + Iceberg lakehouse with stronger governance, discoverability, schema evolution, and lifecycle controls

 - Scaling Kafka and Debezium-based streaming infrastructure that powers real-time product, analytics, and AI use cases

 - Improving Spark and distributed-compute performance, workload isolation, developer experience, and cost efficiency

 - Designing EKM, data residency, and compliant processing capabilities across Notion’s data estate

 - Creating clear platform interfaces and self-serve primitives for Data Engineering, Search, AI, and product teams




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Notion’s data infrastructure is no longer only an internal analytics layer. It increasingly powers customer-facing features, AI systems, enterprise controls, and high-volume product workflows. The team needs a leader who can see across these systems, build the technical leadership and operating culture required for that responsibility, and find the problems that matter before they become roadmap blockers. Success means Data Foundations has a strong, growing team with clear direction and dependable execution—and teams across Notion can build ambitious data-powered products faster without compromising customer trust.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $281,000 - $334,000 per year.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce & Payments
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

 

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

 

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.

Set the architecture and technical roadmap for agentic commerce, making Replit a single place to discover, buy, and manage the products and services businesses need.




YOU WILL:

 - Lead end-to-end purchasing experiences through Replit Agent: translate user intent into relevant options, communicate prices and terms, obtain appropriate authorization, execute purchases, and confirm fulfillment or provisioning.

 - Build extensible integrations with merchants, software vendors, and service providers so the platform can expand its commerce offering without rebuilding each workflow from scratch.

 - Build on existing Stripe and payments capabilities, extending payment integrations where needed to support new purchasing experiences rather than treating basic payment acceptance as a greenfield problem.

 - Design agent-facing APIs and tools with clear contracts, secure credentials, scoped permissions, spending limits, and appropriate confirmation for consequential actions.

 - Partner with product and security to support enterprise purchasing requirements such as role-based access, approval workflows, purchasing policies, and auditable transaction histories, while keeping simpler purchases easy.

 - Own the purchase lifecycle beyond checkout: provisioning and access, order and subscription state, receipts, renewals, cancellations, refunds, and reconciliation across providers.

 - Make agent-driven transactions reliable with idempotency, verified events, durable state, safe retries, and recovery from partial failures; evaluate whether workflows complete the authorized task without duplicate purchases or unintended spend.

 - Lead ambiguous initiatives across teams, define incremental milestones, stay hands-on with implementation, and raise the engineering bar through mentoring, design reviews, and production ownership.
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical leadership on complex customer-facing products or platforms, taking ambiguous initiatives from architecture through launch and production operation across multiple teams.

 - Strong hands-on engineering and system design skills, including API design, data modeling, distributed workflows, and thoughtful evolution of existing systems.

 - Experience building extensible third-party integrations and handling asynchronous events, duplicate requests, partial failures, and changing provider capabilities.

 - Strong product judgment: you can turn complex, multi-step workflows into simple user experiences and balance rapid delivery with correctness and long-term flexibility.

 - A security-conscious approach to authentication, authorization, credentials, sensitive data, and actions performed on a user’s or organization’s behalf.

 - Demonstrated ability to align engineering and cross-functional partners on technical direction, document decisions clearly, and drive execution without relying on reporting authority.

 - Experience mentoring engineers and improving the quality of architecture, implementation, and operations beyond your own projects.

 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools while taking responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of the code you ship.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building commerce platforms, marketplaces, purchasing or procurement systems, or products that connect buyers with multiple vendors.

 - Experience with agent tool calling, multi-step agent workflows, or evaluations for reliable execution of actions against external systems.

 - Familiarity with payment and purchase lifecycles, including authorization, checkout, subscriptions, fulfillment or provisioning, refunds, and reconciliation.

 - Experience building enterprise capabilities such as approval workflows, role-based access, purchasing policies, budget controls, or audit trails.

 - Experience with Stripe or other payment providers, developer platforms, or partner integration ecosystems.

 


BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience with emerging agentic-commerce protocols, MCP, or delegated authorization for agent-initiated transactions.

 - Experience integrating software and service catalogs, pricing and availability, entitlements, or automated provisioning.

 - Familiarity with recurring and usage-based costs, renewal management, international purchasing, or multi-provider transaction workflows.

 - These are additional strengths, not a checklist; prior experience spanning every commerce domain or payment provider is not expected.



WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call.

 - User control and trust: agents act within explicit authority, surface consequential choices, and make purchases and ongoing commitments understandable.

 - Consumer simplicity and enterprise readiness: straightforward experiences should coexist with the controls organizations need.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the experience from intent through purchase, fulfillment, and ongoing management.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on what exists, deliver incremental value, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.
   



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings
